title.ja: ハートゥム EP.91 : ボーイズグループ「PERSES」がスズキの唐揚げレモングラスライム和えに挑戦！ | ジューパーク
title.zh-TW: ハートゥム EP.91 : ボーイズグループ「PERSES」がスズキの唐揚げレモングラスライム和えに挑戦！ | ジューパーク

transcript.text: Today, we're here with PERSES! Oh wow! That's so smooth! But it didn't even pierce the skin. Damn it! I bought new knives just for this episode!
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ワン・ニー・ユー・カップ・パーセス・オホ・ニアン・マーク・テー・マイ・カオ・ヌア・ルーイ・チー・ハイ・スー・ミート・マー・マイ・プア・イーピー・ニー・ルーイ・ナ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Today , we 're here with PERSES ! Oh wow ! That 's so smooth ! But it didn 't even pierce the skin . Damn it ! I bought new knives just for this episode !

translations.ja: 今日はPERSESと一緒にいます！うわぁ、めっちゃ滑らか！でも全然皮すら切れてないじゃん。もう！このエピソードのために新しい包丁買ったのに！
translations.en: Today, we're here with PERSES! Oh wow! That's so smooth! But it didn't even pierce the skin. Damn it! I bought new knives just for this episode!
translations.ko: 오늘 저희와 함께할 그룹은 퍼세스(PERSES)입니다! 오 와우! 정말 부드럽네요! 하지만 피부도 뚫지 못했어요. 젠장! 이번 에피소드를 위해 새 칼을 샀단 말이에요!
translations.zh-TW: 今天我們邀請到 PERSES！噢哇！這刀切得真順！但它甚至沒割破皮。可惡！我為了這一集專門買了新刀子！
translations.id: Hari ini, kita bersama PERSES! Oh wow! Sangat mulus! Tapi itu bahkan tidak menembus kulit. Sialan! Aku membeli pisau baru khusus untuk episode ini!
translations.pt: Hoje, estamos aqui com o PERSES! Ah, nossa! Que suave! Mas nem chegou a perfurar a pele. Droga! Comprei facas novas só para este episódio!

transcript.text: Do you remember why you could swim? / There was something on my belly button.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: チャム・ダイ・マイ・ワー・タムマイ・トゥン・ワーイ・ナーム・ペン・マン・ミー・アライ・ユー・ティー・サドゥー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Do you remember why you could swim ? / There was something on my belly button .

translations.ja: なんで泳げるようになったか覚えてる？／おへそに何かついてたんですよ。
translations.en: Do you remember why you could swim? / There was something on my belly button.
translations.ko: 수영을 할 수 있었던 이유가 기억나나요? / 배꼽에 뭔가 있었어요.
translations.zh-TW: 你還記得你為什麼會游泳嗎？／我肚臍上有個東西。
translations.id: Apakah kamu ingat kenapa kamu bisa berenang? / Ada sesuatu di pusar saya.
translations.pt: Você se lembra do porquê de saber nadar? / Tinha alguma coisa no meu umbigo.

transcript.text: But there was this one time he dreamed about fish. Tell them about it. / You can tell them.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: テー・ミー・クラン・ヌン・ティー・カオ・ファン・トゥン・プラー・ラオ・ハイ・ファン・ノーイ・ラオ・ダイ・ルーイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: But there was this one time he dreamed about fish . Tell them about it . / You can tell them .

translations.ja: でも魚の夢を見たことがあるんだよね。みんなに話してみてよ。／話してもいいよ。
translations.en: But there was this one time he dreamed about fish. Tell them about it. / You can tell them.
translations.ko: 하지만 그가 물고기 꿈을 꾼 적이 한 번 있었죠. 그 얘기도 좀 해줘요. / 네가 직접 말해봐.
translations.zh-TW: 但有一次他夢見了魚。跟他們講講這件事。／你可以自己講。
translations.id: Tapi ada suatu ketika dia bermimpi tentang ikan. Ceritakan kepada mereka tentang hal itu. / Kamu bisa menceritakannya.
translations.pt: Mas teve aquela vez que ele sonhou com peixe. Conta para eles. / Você pode contar.

transcript.text: The fish said I looked good to a certain extent. / Damn! / Damn!
transcript.pronunciation_kana: プラー・ボーク・ワー・ポ・パイ・ワット・ダイ・ユー・チー・ハイ・チー・ハイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: The fish said I looked good to a certain extent . / Damn ! / Damn !

translations.ja: 魚に「まあそこそこ見られる顔だな」って言われたんです。／嘘でしょ！／なんてこった！555
translations.en: The fish said I looked good to a certain extent. / Damn! / Damn!
translations.ko: 물고기가 내가 어느 정도 괜찮게 생겼다고 했어요. / 젠장! / 젠장!
translations.zh-TW: 那條魚說我長得還可以。／靠！／靠！
translations.id: Ikan itu berkata bahwa penampilan saya cukup bagus sampai batas tertentu. / Sialan! / Sialan!
translations.pt: O peixe disse que eu era bonzinho até certo ponto. / Droga! / Droga!

transcript.text: So the fish said you looked good to a certain extent, and you believed it? / You really ask a lot of questions.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: コ・ルーイ・チュア・プラー・ワー・ドゥー・ディー・ポ・パイ・ワット・ダイ・タム・クエン・ジャン・ルーイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: So the fish said you looked good to a certain extent , and you believed it ? / You really ask a lot of questions .

translations.ja: それで魚が「そこそこイケてる」って言ったのを信じたの？／質問めっちゃ攻めてきますね555
translations.en: So the fish said you looked good to a certain extent, and you believed it? / You really ask a lot of questions.
translations.ko: 물고기가 어느 정도 잘생겼다고 하니까 그걸 믿었다고요? / 질문이 정말 많으시네요.
translations.zh-TW: 所以魚說你長得還可以，然後你就信了？／你問題真的很多。
translations.id: Jadi ikan itu bilang penampilanmu cukup bagus sampai batas tertentu, dan kamu mempercayainya? / Kamu benar-benar banyak bertanya.
translations.pt: Então o peixe disse que você era bonzinho até certo ponto e você acreditou? / Você faz muitas perguntas mesmo.

transcript.text: I was quite a naughty kid. I changed schools seven times. I don't know what was wrong with me, I was crazy. / Are you done being crazy now? / Not yet.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ポン・コ・ドゥー・ケップ・ドゥー・ケップ・ユー・ナ・プリアン・ローン・リアン・チェット・ホーン・ペン・バ・アライ・コ・マイ・ルー・バー・ハイ・バー・ヤン・ヤン・クラップ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I was quite a naughty kid . I changed schools seven times . I don 't know what was wrong with me , I was crazy . / Are you done being crazy now ? / Not yet .

translations.ja: 僕、結構やんちゃだったんですよ。学校を7回も転校して。何がおかしかったのか自分でも狂ってましたね。／で、今はもう狂気は治まったの？／まだです555
translations.en: I was quite a naughty kid. I changed schools seven times. I don't know what was wrong with me, I was crazy. / Are you done being crazy now? / Not yet.
translations.ko: 저는 꽤 말썽꾸러기 아이였어요. 전학을 일곱 번이나 다녔죠. 제가 뭐가 문제였는지 모르겠어요, 제정신이 아니었죠. / 이제 제정신으로 돌아왔나요? / 아직요.
translations.zh-TW: 我小時候挺調皮的。我轉過七次學。我不知道自己怎麼了，簡直瘋了。／你現在瘋完了嗎？／還沒。
translations.id: Aku dulu anak yang cukup nakal. Aku pindah sekolah tujuh kali. Aku tidak tahu ada apa denganku, aku gila. / Apakah kamu sudah berhenti menjadi gila sekarang? / Belum.
translations.pt: Eu era uma criança bem levada. Mudei de escola sete vezes. Não sei o que havia de errado comigo, eu era louco. / Você já parou de ser louco? / Ainda não.

transcript.text: Are you even going to switch bands? I'm scared you're going to want to switch groups.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ヤーク・プリアン・ウォン・ドゥアイ・マイ・ニ・グラオ・ワー・ヤーク・プリアン・ウォン・ジャン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Are you even going to switch bands ? I 'm scared you 're going to want to switch groups .

translations.ja: グループまで変えたくなったりしない？急にグループ変えたいとか言い出さないか心配なんだけど555
translations.en: Are you even going to switch bands? I'm scared you're going to want to switch groups.
translations.ko: 그룹을 바꾸기라도 할 건가요? 다른 그룹으로 옮기고 싶어 할까 봐 겁나요.
translations.zh-TW: 你們甚至打算換團嗎？我很怕你會想換組合。
translations.id: Apakah kamu bahkan akan pindah band? Aku takut kamu ingin pindah grup.
translations.pt: Você vai mesmo trocar de banda? Estou com medo de você querer mudar de grupo.

transcript.text: Is there any dish your family makes that you don't like, even though it tastes good? / I don't like Palo because the eggs aren't dark enough from the dark soy sauce. They don't let the sauce soak in, they just eat it.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ミー・アーハーン・ティー・バーン・タム・アーロイ・テー・マイ・チョープ・マイ・マイ・チョープ・パロー・プロ・カイ・マン・マイ・ダム・カオ・マイ・トム・ハイ・マン・カオ・ヌア・プア・キン・ルーイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Is there any dish your family makes that you don 't like , even though it tastes good ? / I don 't like Palo because the eggs aren 't dark enough from the dark soy sauce . They don 't let the sauce soak in , they just eat it .

translations.ja: 家族が作る料理で、美味しいのに好きじゃないものってある？／カイパロー（※タイ風豚角煮・煮卵）が好きじゃないです。卵がシーユーダム（黒醤油）でしっかり黒くなってないから。味を染み込ませないでそのまま食べちゃうんですよ。
translations.en: Is there any dish your family makes that you don't like, even though it tastes good? / I don't like Palo because the eggs aren't dark enough from the dark soy sauce. They don't let the sauce soak in, they just eat it.
translations.ko: 가족들이 만들어주는 음식 중에 맛은 있는데 싫어하는 요리가 있나요? / 저는 팔로(พะโล้)를 안 좋아해요. 간장이 진하지 않아서 계란 색이 안 진하거든요. 소스가 배어들게 놔두지도 않고 그냥 먹어버려요.
translations.zh-TW: 有沒有哪道家常菜是你覺得味道很好，但你卻不喜歡的？／我不喜歡泰式滷肉（Palo），因為老抽沒把蛋滷得夠深。他們沒讓醬汁入味，直接就吃了。
translations.id: Apakah ada masakan buatan keluargamu yang tidak kamu sukai, meskipun rasanya enak? / Aku tidak suka Palo karena telurnya tidak cukup gelap dari kecap manis. Mereka tidak membiarkan sausnya meresap, mereka langsung memakannya.
translations.pt: Tem algum prato que sua família faz que você não gosta, mesmo sendo gostoso? / Eu não gosto de Palo porque os ovos não ficam escuros o suficiente com o molho de soja escuro. Eles não deixam o molho penetrar, só comem assim.

transcript.text: So you're really upset? You sound really sad that your family's Palo isn't soaked into the egg. / Do you understand that they have to let the sauce soak into it?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ドゥー・コーン・マーク・ルーイ・ドゥー・サッド・マーク・ティー・パロー・ティー・バーン・マイ・カオ・ヌア・カイ・カオチャイ・マイ・ワー・マン・トン・トム・ハイ・カオ・ヌア
transcript.pronunciation_roman: So you 're really upset ? You sound really sad that your family 's Palo isn 't soaked into the egg . / Do you understand that they have to let the sauce soak into it ?

translations.ja: めっちゃ怒ってるじゃん！実家のパローの卵に味が染みてないのがそんなに悲しいの？555／中まで味を染み込ませなきゃいけないの、分かりますよね？！
translations.en: So you're really upset? You sound really sad that your family's Palo isn't soaked into the egg. / Do you understand that they have to let the sauce soak into it?
translations.ko: 진짜 화가 나셨네요? 가족들이 만들어준 팔로의 계란에 소스가 안 배어들어서 엄청 서운하셨나 봐요. / 소스가 안쪽까지 잘 배어들게 해야 한다는 걸 이해하시나요?
translations.zh-TW: 所以你真的很生氣？聽起來你對家裡的 Palo 沒有滷透這件事感到非常難過。／你懂不懂他們必須讓醬汁徹底滲進去啊？
translations.id: Jadi kamu benar-benar kesal? Kamu terdengar sangat sedih karena Palo keluargamu tidak meresap ke dalam telur. / Apakah kamu mengerti bahwa mereka harus membiarkan sausnya meresap ke dalamnya?
translations.pt: Então você está muito chateado? Parece bem triste que o Palo da sua família não tenha penetrado no ovo. / Você entende que eles precisam deixar o molho penetrar?

transcript.text: But you haven't hit your mom yet, right? / No, no.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: テー・ヤン・マイ・ダイ・ティー・メー・チャイ・マイ・マイ・マイ・クラップ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: But you haven 't hit your mom yet , right ? / No , no .

translations.ja: でも、まだお母さんを叩いたりしてないよね？555／してないです、してないです！555
translations.en: But you haven't hit your mom yet, right? / No, no.
translations.ko: 하지만 아직 엄마를 때린 적은 없죠? / 아니요, 아니요.
translations.zh-TW: 但你還沒打過你媽吧？／沒有，沒有。
translations.id: Tapi kamu belum memukul ibumu kan? / Tidak, tidak.
translations.pt: Mas você ainda não bateu na sua mãe, né? / Não, não.

transcript.text: Tell me tonight. / It sounds like a motorcycle passing by you. / He really does sound like that!
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ボーク・クーン・ニー・ムアン・モートーサイ・ウィン・パーン・ルーイ・シアン・ムアン・ジン・ジン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Tell me tonight . / It sounds like a motorcycle passing by you . / He really does sound like that !

translations.ja: 今夜教えてよ。／横をバイクが走り去っていったみたいな音ですね。／本当にそんな音だった555！
translations.en: Tell me tonight. / It sounds like a motorcycle passing by you. / He really does sound like that!
translations.ko: 오늘 밤에 말해줘요. / 오토바이가 옆을 지나가는 소리 같아요. / 정말 그렇게 들리네요!
translations.zh-TW: 今晚告訴我。／聽起來就像一台機車從你旁邊騎過去。／他聽起來真的很像！
translations.id: Ceritakan padaku malam ini. / Terdengar seperti sepeda motor yang lewat di sebelahmu. / Dia benar-benar terdengar seperti itu!
translations.pt: Me conta hoje à noite. / Parece uma moto passando do seu lado. / Ele realmente parece com isso!

transcript.text: Hello guys! Welcome back to the Har Tum Show!
transcript.pronunciation_kana: サワッディー・クラップ・トゥック・コン・インディー・トーンラップ・クラブ・カオ・スー・ラーイガーン・ハートゥム・ショー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Hello guys ! Welcome back to the Har Tum Show !

translations.ja: サワッディー・クラップ（みなさんこんにちは）！「ハートゥム・ショー」へようこそ！
translations.en: Hello guys! Welcome back to the Har Tum Show!
translations.ko: 여러분 안녕하세요! 하툼 쇼에 다시 오신 것을 환영합니다!
translations.zh-TW: 大家好！歡迎回到 Har Tum 秀！
translations.id: Halo semuanya! Selamat datang kembali di Har Tum Show!
translations.pt: Olá, pessoal! Sejam bem-vindos de volta ao Har Tum Show!

transcript.text: We're full of energy today! Today, we're here with PERSES!
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ワン・ニー・パラン・テム・ピアン・マーク・ワン・ニー・ラオ・ユー・カップ・パーセス
transcript.pronunciation_roman: We 're full of energy today ! Today , we 're here with PERSES !

translations.ja: 今日はエネルギー満点でお届けします！本日はPERSESのみんなと一緒です！
translations.en: We're full of energy today! Today, we're here with PERSES!
translations.ko: 오늘 에너지가 넘치네요! 오늘은 퍼세스와 함께합니다!
translations.zh-TW: 我們今天活力滿滿！今天我們邀請到了 PERSES！
translations.id: Kita penuh energi hari ini! Hari ini, kita bersama PERSES!
translations.pt: Estamos cheios de energia hoje! Hoje, estamos aqui com o PERSES!

transcript.text: I love that team voice! Can we do it again? / Of course! Today, we're with / PERSES!
transcript.pronunciation_kana: チョープ・シアン・プローム・カン・ジャン・コー・イーク・ティー・ダイ・マイ・ダイ・ルーイ・ワン・ニー・ラオ・ユー・カップ・パーセス
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I love that team voice ! Can we do it again ? / Of course ! Today , we 're with / PERSES !

translations.ja: みんなで揃えた声、最高！もう一回やっていい？／もちろん！今日一緒にいるのは……／PERSES！
translations.en: I love that team voice! Can we do it again? / Of course! Today, we're with / PERSES!
translations.ko: 팀 구호 정말 좋네요! 한 번 더 할 수 있을까요? / 물론이죠! 오늘은 퍼세스와 함께합니다!
translations.zh-TW: 我好喜歡那個團隊口號！可以再來一次嗎？／當然！今天我們跟／PERSES 在一起！
translations.id: Aku suka suara tim itu! Bisakah kita melakukannya lagi? / Tentu saja! Hari ini, kita bersama / PERSES!
translations.pt: Adoro essa voz de equipe! Podemos fazer de novo? / Claro! Hoje, estamos com o / PERSES!

transcript.text: That's a huge team! Please introduce yourselves one by one! Of course! I'm Pluggy from PERSES! Hello! I'm Palm from PERSES!
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ティーム・ヤイ・マーク・ネナム・トゥア・ティー・ラ・コン・ルーイ・ダイ・ルーイ・クラップ・ポム・プラッギー・チャーク・パーセス・クラップ・サワッディー・クラップ・ポム・パーム・チャーク・パーセス・クラップ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: That 's a huge team ! Please introduce yourselves one by one ! Of course ! I 'm Pluggy from PERSES ! Hello ! I 'm Palm from PERSES !

translations.ja: すごい大所帯！一人ずつ自己紹介をお願いします！／もちろんです！PERSESのプラッギーです！／サワッディー・クラップ、PERSESのパームです！
translations.en: That's a huge team! Please introduce yourselves one by one! Of course! I'm Pluggy from PERSES! Hello! I'm Palm from PERSES!
translations.ko: 정말 대단한 팀이네요! 한 명씩 자기소개 부탁드려요! 물론이죠! 저는 퍼세스의 플러기입니다! 안녕하세요! 저는 퍼세스의 팜입니다!
translations.zh-TW: 真是個龐大的團體！請大家依序自我介紹！當然！我是 PERSES 的 Pluggy！大家好！我是 PERSES 的 Palm！
translations.id: Itu tim yang sangat besar! Silakan perkenalkan diri kalian satu per satu! Tentu saja! Aku Pluggy dari PERSES! Halo! Aku Palm dari PERSES!
translations.pt: Que equipe enorme! Por favor, se apresentem um por um! Claro! Eu sou o Pluggy do PERSES! Olá! Eu sou o Palm do PERSES!

transcript.text: Hey guys! I'm Krittin from PERSES! Hello, I'm Jung from PERSES! Hey guys! I'm Nay from PERSES!
transcript.pronunciation_kana: サワッディー・クラップ・トゥック・コン・ポム・クリッティン・チャーク・パーセス・クラップ・サワッディー・クラップ・ポム・ジャン・チャーク・パーセス・クラップ・サワッディー・クラップ・トゥック・コン・ポム・ネー・チャーク・パーセス・クラップ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Hey guys ! I 'm Krittin from PERSES ! Hello , I 'm Jung from PERSES ! Hey guys ! I 'm Nay from PERSES !

translations.ja: みなさんサワッディー・クラップ！PERSESのクリッティンです！／サワッディー・クラップ、PERSESのジャンです！／みなさんサワッディー・クラップ！PERSESのネーです！
translations.en: Hey guys! I'm Krittin from PERSES! Hello, I'm Jung from PERSES! Hey guys! I'm Nay from PERSES!
translations.ko: 여러분 안녕하세요! 저는 퍼세스의 크리틴입니다! 안녕하세요, 저는 퍼세스의 정입니다! 여러분 안녕하세요! 저는 퍼세스의 네이입니다!
translations.zh-TW: 大家好！我是 PERSES 的 Krittin！大家好，我是 PERSES 的 Jung！大家好！我是 PERSES 的 Nay！
translations.id: Halo semuanya! Aku Krittin dari PERSES! Halo, aku Jung dari PERSES! Halo semuanya! Aku Nay dari PERSES!
translations.pt: E aí, gente! Eu sou o Krittin do PERSES! Olá, eu sou o Jung do PERSES! E aí, gente! Eu sou o Nay do PERSES!

transcript.text: Hey guys! I'm Eclair. I Hiwwhee back and forth.

translations.zh-TW: 大家好！我是 Eclair。我 Hiwwhee 來回晃動。
translations.id: Halo semuanya! Aku Eclair. Aku Hiwwhee mondar-mandir.
translations.pt: E aí, gente! Eu sou o Eclair. Eu Hiwwhee para frente e para trás.

transcript.text: What are we making today? / Lemongrass and lime salad with fried sea bass. / Wow. Even the name sounds complicated.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ワン・ニー・ラオ・チャ・タム・アライ・カン・ヤム・プラー・カポン・トート・タクライ・マナーオ・ワーオ・ケー・チュー・コー・ドゥー・ヤーク・レオ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: What are we making today ? / Lemongrass and lime salad with fried sea bass . / Wow . Even the name sounds complicated .

translations.ja: 今日は何を作るんですか？／揚げスズキのレモングラスとライムのヤム（※タイ風和え物サラダ）です。／わぁ、名前からしてすでに難しそう！
translations.en: What are we making today? / Lemongrass and lime salad with fried sea bass. / Wow. Even the name sounds complicated.
translations.ko: 오늘 뭘 만드나요? / 레몬그라스와 라임을 곁들인 농어 튀김 샐러드요. / 와. 이름만 들어도 복잡해 보이네요.
translations.zh-TW: 我們今天要做什麼？／香茅萊姆沙拉佐炸海鱸魚。／哇。光聽名字就很複雜。
translations.id: Apa yang kita buat hari ini? / Salad serai dan jeruk nipis dengan ikan kakap putih goreng. / Wow. Namanya saja sudah terdengar rumit.
translations.pt: O que vamos fazer hoje? / Salada de capim-limão e limão com robalo frito. / Nossa. Até o nome parece complicado.

transcript.text: Amazing! / This sounds like something you'd get at a Chinese banquet. There must be fish maw soup coming next.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: アメイジング・ムアン・メヌー・ト・ジーン・ルーイ・ディアオ・トン・ミー・クラポ・プラー・ターム・マー・ネー・ネー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Amazing ! / This sounds like something you 'd get at a Chinese banquet . There must be fish maw soup coming next .

translations.ja: アメイジング！／中華の宴会料理に出てきそうなメニューですね。この後きっと魚の浮袋スープ（クラポ・プラー）も出てきますよ。
translations.en: Amazing! / This sounds like something you'd get at a Chinese banquet. There must be fish maw soup coming next.
translations.ko: 대박이네요! / 중식당 코스 요리에서 나올 것 같아요. 다음엔 어복탕 같은 수프가 나올 것 같네요.
translations.zh-TW: 太棒了！／這聽起來像是在中式宴席上才能吃到的菜。接下來一定會上魚翅羹吧。
translations.id: Luar biasa! / Ini terdengar seperti makanan yang akan kamu dapatkan di jamuan makan Tiongkok. Pasti akan ada sup perut ikan setelah ini.
translations.pt: Incrível! / Isso parece algo que você comeria em um banquete chinês. Deve vir uma sopa de bexiga de peixe a seguir.

transcript.text: What ingredients do we have? / First, we've got sea bass. / Can we use other types of fish? / Well, the dish is called fried sea bass.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ラオ・ミー・ワットゥディップ・アライ・バーン・ヤーン・レーク・ラオ・ミー・プラー・カポン・チャイ・プラー・ウーン・ダイ・マイ・コー・チュー・メヌー・マン・クー・プラー・カポン・トート・ニー・ナー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: What ingredients do we have ? / First , we 've got sea bass . / Can we use other types of fish ? / Well , the dish is called fried sea bass .

translations.ja: どんな食材がありますか？／まずスズキがあります。／他の魚を使ってもいいですか？／いや、料理名自体が「揚げスズキ」ですから555！
translations.en: What ingredients do we have? / First, we've got sea bass. / Can we use other types of fish? / Well, the dish is called fried sea bass.
translations.ko: 어떤 재료가 있나요? / 먼저 농어가 있습니다. / 다른 종류의 생선을 써도 되나요? / 음, 요리 이름이 농어 튀김이니까요.
translations.zh-TW: 我們有哪些食材？／首先，我們有海鱸魚。／可以用其他種類的魚嗎？／嗯，這道菜就叫做炸海鱸魚嘛。
translations.id: Bahan apa saja yang kita miliki? / Pertama, kita punya ikan kakap putih. / Bisakah kita menggunakan jenis ikan lain? / Yah, hidangannya disebut ikan kakap putih goreng.
translations.pt: Quais ingredientes nós temos? / Primeiro, temos robalo. / Podemos usar outros tipos de peixe? / Bem, o prato se chama robalo frito.

transcript.text: Maybe fried tilapia or red tilapia? / Sure, you can. Feel free to change it. So that means we have to prepare the fish today, and Jung knows how to do it. / Not at all.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: プラ・ニン・トート・ルー・プラ・タップティム・トート・ダイ・シ・プリアン・ダイ・ルーイ・ペー・ワー・ワン・ニー・ラオ・トン・タム・プラー・レオ・ジャン・タム・ペン・マイ・マイ・ペン・ルーイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Maybe fried tilapia or red tilapia ? / Sure , you can . Feel free to change it . So that means we have to prepare the fish today , and Jung knows how to do it . / Not at all .

translations.ja: 「ティラピア揚げとかプラータップティム（※ティラピアの改良種）揚げでもいい？」「もちろん、自由に変えていいよ。ってことは今日僕たち魚を捌かなきゃいけないけど、ジャンはやり方わかるよね？」「全然わからないです」
translations.en: Maybe fried tilapia or red tilapia? / Sure, you can. Feel free to change it. So that means we have to prepare the fish today, and Jung knows how to do it. / Not at all.
translations.ko: 틸라피아나 홍틸라피아 튀김은요? / 물론이죠. 편하신 걸로 바꾸세요. 그럼 오늘 생선을 손질해야 한다는 뜻인데, 정이가 그 방법을 알고 있군요. / 전혀 모릅니다.
translations.zh-TW: 也許可以用炸羅非魚或紅羅非魚？／當然可以，隨便你換。所以這代表我們今天必須自己處理魚，而 Jung 會處理。／完全不會。
translations.id: Mungkin ikan nila goreng atau nila merah? / Tentu, bisa. Silakan diganti. Jadi artinya kita harus menyiapkan ikan hari ini, dan Jung tahu caranya. / Sama sekali tidak.
translations.pt: Talvez tilápia frita ou tilápia vermelha? / Claro, pode sim. Fique à vontade para mudar. Então isso significa que temos que preparar o peixe hoje, और o Jung sabe como fazer. / Nem um pouco.

transcript.text: I'm already stressed out. Honestly, none of us know how to cook. / That's right. / I can't cook either.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: クリアット・ルーイ・チン・チン・プワク・ラオ・マイ・ミー・クライ・タム・アハーン・ペン・ルーイ・チャイ・ラオ・ゴー・タム・マイ・ペン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I 'm already stressed out . Honestly , none of us know how to cook . / That 's right . / I can 't cook either .

translations.ja: 「もうすでにストレスだよ。正直、僕たち誰も料理できないんだよね」「チャイ（そう）」「僕も作れないし」
translations.en: I'm already stressed out. Honestly, none of us know how to cook. / That's right. / I can't cook either.
translations.ko: 벌써 스트레스받네요. 솔직히 우리 중 아무도 요리할 줄 몰라요. / 맞아요. / 저도 요리 못 해요.
translations.zh-TW: 我已經壓力很大了。說真的，我們沒有人會煮飯。／沒錯。／我也會不會煮。
translations.id: Aku sudah stres. Sejujurnya, tidak ada di antara kita yang tahu cara memasak. / Betul sekali. / Aku juga tidak bisa memasak.
translations.pt: Já estou estressado. Sinceramente, nenhum de nós sabe cozinhar. / É verdade. / Eu também não sei cozinhar.

transcript.text: But we have to make it. / We can do it! / Besides the sea bass, what other ingredients do we have?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: テー・ラオ・トン・タム・ナ・タム・ダイ・ユー・レオ・ノーク・チャーク・プラー・グラポン・ミー・ワッティディップ・アライ・イーク・バーン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: But we have to make it . / We can do it ! / Besides the sea bass , what other ingredients do we have ?

translations.ja: 「でも作らなきゃ」「できるよ！」「プラーグラポン（※スズキ）の他に、どんな食材があるの？」
translations.en: But we have to make it. / We can do it! / Besides the sea bass, what other ingredients do we have?
translations.ko: 하지만 만들어야 하죠. / 우리도 할 수 있어요! / 농어 말고 다른 재료는 뭐가 있나요?
translations.zh-TW: 但我們還是得做。／我們辦得到的！／除了海鱸魚，我們還有哪些食材？
translations.id: Tapi kita harus membuatnya. / Kita bisa melakukannya! / Selain ikan kakap putih, bahan apa lagi yang kita miliki?
translations.pt: Mas temos que fazer. / Nós conseguimos! / Além do robalo, quais outros ingredientes nós temos?

transcript.text: We've got lime, lemongrass, red chili, kaffir lime leaves. / Chili. / What's this? / Oil, galangal, kaffir lime leaves.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ミー・マナーオ・タクライ・プリック・デン・バイ・マクルート・プリック・アン・ニー・アライ・ナムマン・カー・バイ・マクルート
transcript.pronunciation_roman: We 've got lime , lemongrass , red chili , kaffir lime leaves . / Chili . / What 's this ? / Oil , galangal , kaffir lime leaves .

translations.ja: 「ライム、レモングラス、赤唐辛子、バイマクルー（※こぶみかんの葉）があるよ」「唐辛子」「これは何？」「油、カー（※タイのショウガ）、バイマクルー」
translations.en: We've got lime, lemongrass, red chili, kaffir lime leaves. / Chili. / What's this? / Oil, galangal, kaffir lime leaves.
translations.ko: 라임, 레몬그라스, 홍고추, 카피르 라임 잎이 있어요. / 고추요. / 이건 뭔가요? / 식용유, 갈랑갈, 카피르 라임 잎이요.
translations.zh-TW: 我們有萊姆、香茅、紅辣椒、箭葉橙葉。／辣椒。／這是什麼？／油、南薑、箭葉橙葉。
translations.id: Kita punya jeruk nipis, serai, cabai merah, daun jeruk purut. / Cabai. / Apa ini? / Minyak, lengkuas, daun jeruk purut.
translations.pt: Temos limão, capim-limão, pimenta vermelha, folhas de lima kaffir. / Pimenta. / O que é isso? / Óleo, galanga, folhas de lima kaffir.

transcript.text: Mint and flour. I think the flour is for coating the fish before frying. / Yes. / Where do we start? Are we starting now? / Shall we get started? / What do we start with?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: バイ・サラネー・レオ・ゴー・ペーン・キット・ワー・ペーン・アオ・ワイ・チュップ・プラー・トート・チャイ・ルーム・チャーク・トロン・ナイ・ルーム・ルーイ・マイ・ルーム・ルーイ・マイ・クラップ・ルーム・チャーク・アライ・ディー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Mint and flour . I think the flour is for coating the fish before frying . / Yes . / Where do we start ? Are we starting now ? / Shall we get started ? / What do we start with ?

translations.ja: 「ミントと小麦粉。小麦粉は魚を揚げる前にまぶす用だよね」「チャイ」「どこから始める？今すぐ始める？」「始めましょうか？」「何から始める？」
translations.en: Mint and flour. I think the flour is for coating the fish before frying. / Yes. / Where do we start? Are we starting now? / Shall we get started? / What do we start with?
translations.ko: 민트와 밀가루요. 밀가루는 튀기기 전에 생선에 묻히는 용도인 것 같아요. / 네. / 어디서부터 시작하죠? 지금 시작하나요? / 시작해 볼까요? / 뭘 먼저 시작하죠?
translations.zh-TW: 薄荷和麵粉。我覺得麵粉是用來在炸之前裹魚肉的。／對。／我們從哪裡開始？現在就要開始了嗎？／我們要開始了嗎？／從什麼開始？
translations.id: Daun mint dan tepung. Sepertinya tepung itu untuk melapisi ikan sebelum digoreng. / Ya. / Dari mana kita mulai? Apakah kita mulai sekarang? / Haruskah kita mulai? / Dengan apa kita mulai?
translations.pt: Hortelã e farinha. Acho que a farinha é para empanar o peixe antes de fritar. / Sim. / Por onde começamos? Vamos começar agora? / Vamos começar? / Com o que começamos?

transcript.text: Here's the thing, we're stuck between "Let's start" and "Come back next episode." Can we go home now? / We're all here, so we should do it. / While we're talking, I'm looking at the fish and hoping I don't have to prepare it.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: クー・ラワーン・ルーム・カン・ルーイ・ガップ・ポップ・カン・マイ・イーピー・ナー・グラップ・バーン・ダイ・マイ・マー・カン・レオ・ゴー・トン・タム・シ・ラワーン・ティー・クイ・カン・モーン・プラー・レオ・ワン・ワー・チャン・マイ・トン・タム
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Here 's the thing , we 're stuck between "Let's start " and "Come back next episode ." Can we go home now ? / We 're all here , so we should do it . / While we 're talking , I 'm looking at the fish and hoping I don 't have to prepare it .

translations.ja: 「要するにさ、『始めよう』と『また次回の動画で会いましょう』の間で迷ってるんだよね。もう帰っていい？」「せっかく来たんだからやらなきゃ」「話しながら魚を見てるんだけど、自分が捌かなくて済むように祈ってるよ555」
translations.en: Here's the thing, we're stuck between "Let's start" and "Come back next episode." Can we go home now? / We're all here, so we should do it. / While we're talking, I'm looking at the fish and hoping I don't have to prepare it.
translations.ko: "시작하자"와 "다음 에피소드에 계속" 사이에서 진퇴양난이에요. 지금 집에 가도 될까요? / 다들 와 있으니까 해야죠. / 얘기하는 동안 생선을 보면서 손질 안 해도 되기를 바라고 있어요.
translations.zh-TW: 問題是，我們現在卡在「開始吧」和「下一集再來」之間。我們現在可以回家了嗎？／大家都到齊了，所以還是得做。／一邊說著，我一邊看著那條魚，希望我不用動手處理它。
translations.id: Masalahnya, kita terjebak di antara "Ayo mulai" dan "Kembali lagi episode depan." Bisakah kita pulang sekarang? / Kita semua ada di sini, jadi kita harus melakukannya. / Sambil mengobrol, aku melihat ikannya dan berharap aku tidak harus menyiapkannya.
translations.pt: O problema é que estamos presos entre "Vamos começar" e "Voltem no próximo episódio". Podemos ir para casa agora? / Estamos todos aqui, então devemos fazer. / Enquanto conversamos, estou olhando para o peixe e torcendo para não ter que prepará-lo.

transcript.text: P'Eclair! / You can do it. / You don't know how to fillet a fish, right? / I don't. Oh my gosh. / I'll show you how to do it. / I'll start by giving you the cutting board. / I can do it. / I'm worried about my fingers.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ピー・エクレア・タム・ダイ・ユー・レオ・レー・プラー・マイ・ペン・チャイ・マイ・マイ・ペン・オイ・ターイ・レオ・ソーン・ハイ・ドゥー・ルーム・チャーク・ハイ・キアン・ゴーン・タム・ダイ・ペン・フアン・ニウ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: P 'Eclair! / You can do it . / You don 't know how to fillet a fish , right ? / I don 't. Oh my gosh . / I 'll show you how to do it . / I 'll start by giving you the cutting board . / I can do it . / I 'm worried about my fingers .

translations.ja: 「ピー・エクレア！」「できるって」「魚おろせないんでしょ？」「おろせないよ、どうしよう」「やり方見せてあげる」「まずはまな板を渡すところからね」「僕できるよ」「指を切らないか心配だな」
translations.en: P'Eclair! / You can do it. / You don't know how to fillet a fish, right? / I don't. Oh my gosh. / I'll show you how to do it. / I'll start by giving you the cutting board. / I can do it. / I'm worried about my fingers.
translations.ko: 에클레어 형! / 너도 할 수 있어. / 너 생선 포 뜨는 법 모르잖아, 그지? / 몰라요. 아이고. / 내가 어떻게 하는지 보여줄게. / 일단 도마를 줄게요. / 저 할 수 있어요. / 손가락이 걱정돼요.
translations.zh-TW: P'Eclair！／你行的。／你不會片魚肉對吧？／我不會。我的天啊。／我教你怎麼用。／我先把砧板拿給你。／我可以的。／我很擔心我的手指。
translations.id: P'Eclair! / Kamu bisa melakukannya. / Kamu tidak tahu cara memfillet ikan, kan? / Tidak. Ya ampun. / Aku akan tunjukkan caranya. / Aku akan mulai dengan memberimu talenan. / Aku bisa melakukannya. / Aku khawatir dengan jariku.
translations.pt: P'Eclair! / Você consegue. / Você não sabe filetar um peixe, sabe? / Não sei. Ai meu Deus. / Vou te mostrar como fazer. / Vou começar te dando a tábua de cortar. / Eu consigo. / Estou preocupado com meus dedos.

transcript.text: I can use my hands, right? / Of course. What else are you going to use? / I'll wash my hands first. Make yourself useful and cut up the vegetables. / I'll do it.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: チャイ・ムー・ダイ・チャイ・マイ・ダイ・シ・チャ・チャイ・アライ・ラ・ラーン・ムー・ゴーン・チュアイ・カン・ハン・パック・ノイ・タム・ハイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I can use my hands , right ? / Of course . What else are you going to use ? / I 'll wash my hands first . Make yourself useful and cut up the vegetables . / I 'll do it .

translations.ja: 「手を使っていいんだよね？」「もちろん。じゃなきゃ何を使うのさ」「まず手を洗ってくる。みんなも野菜を切って役に立ってよ」「僕が切るよ」
translations.en: I can use my hands, right? / Of course. What else are you going to use? / I'll wash my hands first. Make yourself useful and cut up the vegetables. / I'll do it.
translations.ko: 손을 써도 되죠? / 당연하지. 그럼 뭘로 할래? / 손부터 씻을게요. 넌 그동안 야채를 썰어서 1인분 제 몫을 해. / 제가 할게요.
translations.zh-TW: 我可以徒手拿對吧？／當然。不然你還想用什麼？／我先去洗手。發揮點作用，把蔬菜切了吧。／我來切。
translations.id: Aku bisa menggunakan tanganku, kan? / Tentu saja. Apa lagi yang akan kamu gunakan? / Aku cuci tangan dulu. Buat dirimu berguna dan potong sayurannya. / Aku akan melakukannya.
translations.pt: Posso usar minhas mãos, né? / Claro. O que mais você vai usar? / Vou lavar minhas mãos primeiro. Seja útil e corte os vegetais. / Eu faço isso.

transcript.text: We've already cleaned the fish for you. / While you're talking, he's asking how to cut the vegetables.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ラーン・プラー・ハイ・レオ・ナ・ラワーン・ティー・クイ・カオ・ターム・ワー・ハン・パック・ヤンガイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: We 've already cleaned the fish for you . / While you 're talking , he 's asking how to cut the vegetables .

translations.ja: 「魚はもう洗っておいたよ」「話してる間に、彼が野菜はどう切ればいいか聞いてるよ」
translations.en: We've already cleaned the fish for you. / While you're talking, he's asking how to cut the vegetables.
translations.ko: 생선은 저희가 이미 손질해 두었습니다. / 얘기하는 사이에 야채를 어떻게 썰어야 하냐고 묻고 있네요.
translations.zh-TW: 我們已經幫你把魚清理乾淨了。／你們在講話的同時，他正在問怎麼切蔬菜。
translations.id: Kami sudah membersihkan ikannya untukmu. / Sambil kamu berbicara, dia bertanya cara memotong sayurannya.
translations.pt: Já limpamos o peixe para vocês. / Enquanto vocês conversam, ele está perguntando como cortar os vegetais.

transcript.text: How do you cut it? / Wait a second, how do you cut it? Oh, you just cut it normally. You know how, right?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ハン・ヤンガイ・ディアオ・ナ・ハン・ヤンガイ・ゴー・ハン・タマダー・タム・ペン・チャイ・マイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: How do you cut it ? / Wait a second , how do you cut it ? Oh , you just cut it normally . You know how , right ?

translations.ja: 「どうやって切るの？」「ちょっと待って、どう切るの？普通に切ればいいんだよ。やり方わかるでしょ？」
translations.en: How do you cut it? / Wait a second, how do you cut it? Oh, you just cut it normally. You know how, right?
translations.ko: 어떻게 썰어요? / 잠깐만요, 어떻게 썰어야 해요? 아, 그냥 평소대로 썰면 돼요. 어떻게 하는지 알죠?
translations.zh-TW: 怎麼切？／等一下，怎麼切？噢，就正常切。你懂的對吧？
translations.id: Bagaimana cara memotongnya? / Tunggu sebentar, bagaimana cara memotongnya? Oh, dipotong biasa saja. Kamu tahu caranya, kan?
translations.pt: Como corta isso? / Espera um segundo, como corta? Ah, corta normal. Você sabe como é, né?

transcript.text: So you have to cut away from the core like this, so you can squeeze it.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ゴー・トーン・ファン・ロッ・ゲーン・ベープ・ニー・ハイ・ビープ・ダイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: So you have to cut away from the core like this , so you can squeeze it .

translations.ja: こうやって芯を避けて切るんだよ、そうすれば絞れるからね。
translations.en: So you have to cut away from the core like this, so you can squeeze it.
translations.ko: 심지에서 먼 쪽을 이렇게 잘라내야 즙을 짜낼 수 있어요.
translations.zh-TW: 所以你必須像這樣從果心切開，這樣才能擠出汁。
translations.id: Jadi kamu harus memotongnya menjauhi bagian tengah seperti ini, agar kamu bisa memerahnya.
translations.pt: Então você tem que cortar para longe do miolo assim, para poder espremer.

transcript.text: Jung has started prepping the fish! Everyone, if it turns out good or bad, it's all because of Jung. / It looks okay!
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ピ・ジャン・ルアム・レー・プラー・レオ・ナ・トゥック・コン・オオーク・マー・ディー・マイ・ディー・ゴー・ユー・ティー・ピ・ジャン・ナ・クラップ / ドゥー・ディー・ユー・ナ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Jung has started prepping the fish ! Everyone , if it turns out good or bad , it 's all because of Jung . / It looks okay !

translations.ja: ピジャンが魚をさばき始めました！みなさん、美味しくなっても失敗しても全部ピジャン次第ですよ／いい感じに見えるよ！
translations.en: Jung has started prepping the fish! Everyone, if it turns out good or bad, it's all because of Jung. / It looks okay!
translations.ko: 정이 생선 손질을 시작했습니다! 여러분, 요리가 잘 되든 못 되든 전부 정의 탓입니다! / 괜찮아 보이는데요!
translations.zh-TW: Jung 開始處理魚了！各位，不管做出來好吃還是難吃，全都是 Jung 的功勞（或責任）！／看起來還不錯！
translations.id: Jung sudah mulai menyiapkan ikannya! Semuanya, jika hasilnya bagus atau buruk, itu semua karena Jung. / Tampaknya lumayan!
translations.pt: O Jung começou a preparar o peixe! Pessoal, se ficar bom ou ruim, a culpa é toda do Jung. / Parece bom!

transcript.text: I think we'd better let them fillet it. / Oh wow! That's so smooth! But it didn't even pierce the skin. Damn it! I bought new knives just for this episode!
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ハイ・ラーン・レー・ハイ・ディー・クワー・マイ / オー・ホー・ニアン・マーク・テー・ナン・ヤン・マイ・カート・ルーイ・パット・トー・ウッサー・スー・ミート・マイ・サムラップ・イー・ピー・ニー・ルーイ・ナ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I think we 'd better let them fillet it . / Oh wow ! That 's so smooth ! But it didn 't even pierce the skin . Damn it ! I bought new knives just for this episode !

translations.ja: お店の人にさばいてもらった方がよかったんじゃない？／うわあ！滑らかすぎる！でも皮すら切れてないじゃん。もう！この回のために新しい包丁買ったのに！
translations.en: I think we'd better let them fillet it. / Oh wow! That's so smooth! But it didn't even pierce the skin. Damn it! I bought new knives just for this episode!
translations.ko: 그냥 저 친구들이 포를 뜨게 두는 게 나을 것 같아요. / 오 와우! 정말 부드럽네요! 하지만 피부도 뚫지 못했어요. 젠장! 이번 에피소드를 위해 새 칼을 샀단 말이에요!
translations.zh-TW: 我看我們還是讓他們來片魚好了。／噢哇！這刀切得真順！但它甚至沒割破皮。可惡！我為了這一集專門買了新刀子！
translations.id: Kurang lebih sebaiknya kita biarkan mereka yang memfilletnya. / Oh wow! Sangat mulus! Tapi itu bahkan tidak menembus kulit. Sialan! Aku membeli pisau baru khusus untuk episode ini!
translations.pt: Acho melhor deixarmos eles filetarem. / Ah, nossa! Que suave! Mas nem chegou a perfurar a pele. Droga! Comprei facas novas só para este episódio!

transcript.text: Is the knife not sharp enough? / You don't need to cut it all the same size, some pieces can be bigger and some smaller. / Okay, got it! / Yay, it finally went through!
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ミート・マイ・コム・ルー・プラーオ / マイ・トーン・タオ・ガン・モット・ゴー・ダイ・ミー・ヤイ・バーン・レック・バーン / オーケー・カオチャイ・レオ / イェー・カオ・サック・ティー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Is the knife not sharp enough ? / You don 't need to cut it all the same size , some pieces can be bigger and some smaller . / Okay , got it ! / Yay , it finally went through !

translations.ja: 包丁切れないの？／全部同じ大きさに切らなくてもいいよ、大きかったり小さかったりで／オッケー、わかった！／イェーイ、やっと刃が入った！
translations.en: Is the knife not sharp enough? / You don't need to cut it all the same size, some pieces can be bigger and some smaller. / Okay, got it! / Yay, it finally went through!
translations.ko: 칼이 잘 안 드나요? / 다 똑같은 크기로 썰 필요는 없어요, 좀 더 크게 썰어도 되고 작게 썰어도 돼요. / 네, 알겠습니다! / 야, 드디어 잘렸어!
translations.zh-TW: 是刀子不夠利嗎？／你不需要把每塊都切得一樣大，有些可以切大塊一點，有些切小塊。／好，知道了！／耶，終於切過去了！
translations.id: Apakah pisaunya kurang tajam? / Kamu tidak perlu memotongnya dengan ukuran yang sama persis, beberapa bagian bisa lebih besar dan beberapa lebih kecil. / Oke, mengerti! / Hore, akhirnya tembus juga!
translations.pt: A faca não está afiada o suficiente? / Não precisa cortar tudo do mesmo tamanho, alguns pedaços podem ser maiores e outros menores. / Ok, entendi! / Oba, finalmente passou!

transcript.text: Your fingers almost got chopped off too. / No, keep your fingers up. / Yeah, cut it like that. / Slice it. That's right!
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ギアップ・ドーン・ニウ・レオ・マイ・ラ / マイ・チャイ・ハイ・タン・ニウ・ワイ / チャイ・ファン・ベープ・ナン・ルーイ / スライ・パイ・チャイ・ルーイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Your fingers almost got chopped off too . / No , keep your fingers up . / Yeah , cut it like that . / Slice it . That 's right !

translations.ja: 指まで切り落としそうになってるじゃん／違うよ、指を立てて丸めて／そう、そんな風に切って／スライスして。そうそう！
translations.en: Your fingers almost got chopped off too. / No, keep your fingers up. / Yeah, cut it like that. / Slice it. That's right!
translations.ko: 손가락도 잘릴 뻔했네요. / 아니요, 손가락을 위로 치켜들어요. / 그래, 그렇게 썰어. / 썰어봐요. 맞아요!
translations.zh-TW: 你的手指也差點被砍斷了。／不，把手指抬高。／對，就那樣切。／切片。沒錯！
translations.id: Jarimu hampir terpotong juga. / Tidak, angkat jarimu. / Ya, potong seperti itu. / Iris. Benar sekali!
translations.pt: Seus dedos quase foram cortados fora também. / Não, mantenha os dedos para cima. / É, corta assim. / Fatie. Isso mesmo!

transcript.text: That's good! We don't need it like that. Oh, we have to dice it? / Yes. / So we have to cut the lime in two different sizes? The first one is cut up to mix into the dish, and the second one is diced lime for decorating the plate.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ディー・レオ・マイ・トーン・タム・ベープ・ナン・オ・トーン・ファン・ルー・タオ・ルー・クラップ / チャイ / スルップ・クー・トーン・ファン・マナーオ・ソーン・ベープ・チャイ・マイ・アン・レーク・ア・クラック・コン・カオ・パイ・ナイ・アハーン・アン・ティー・ソーン・ペン・ルー・タオ・ワイ・トック・テーン・チャーン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: That 's good ! We don 't need it like that . Oh , we have to dice it ? / Yes . / So we have to cut the lime in two different sizes ? The first one is cut up to mix into the dish , and the second one is diced lime for decorating the plate .

translations.ja: いいね！それはそんな風にしなくていいよ。あ、角切り（ダイスカット）にするの？／そう／つまりライムを2通りの切り方にするってこと？1つ目は料理に混ぜる用で、もう1つはお皿に飾る用の角切りね。
translations.en: That's good! We don't need it like that. Oh, we have to dice it? / Yes. / So we have to cut the lime in two different sizes? The first one is cut up to mix into the dish, and the second one is diced lime for decorating the plate.
translations.ko: 좋아요! 저렇게까지 할 필요는 없어요. 아, 주사위 모양으로 썰어야 하나요? / 네. / 그럼 라임을 두 가지 크기로 썰어야 하네요? 첫 번째는 요리에 섞을 용도로 썰고, 두 번째는 플레이팅 장식용으로 잘게 썰어야 해요.
translations.zh-TW: 這樣很好！我們不需要那樣。噢，我們得切成丁？／對。／所以我們要用兩種不同大小切萊姆？第一種切好用來拌進沙拉裡，第二種切成萊姆丁用來裝飾盤子。
translations.id: Bagus! Kita tidak butuh bentuk seperti itu. Oh, harus dipotong dadu? / Ya. / Jadi kita harus memotong jeruk nipis dalam dua ukuran berbeda? Yang pertama dipotong untuk dicampur ke dalam hidangan, dan yang kedua adalah jeruk nipis potong dadu untuk menghias piring.
translations.pt: Isso é bom! Não precisamos assim. Ah, temos que cortar em cubos? / Sim. / Então temos que cortar o limão em dois tamanhos diferentes? O primeiro é cortado para misturar no prato, e o segundo é limão em cubos para decorar o prato.

transcript.text: Wow, you're filleting it so nicely! You look like a fishmonger filleting a fish! Do you think you were related to fish in your past life?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: オー・ホー・レー・スワイ・マーク・ルーイ・ムアン・ポー・カー・カーイ・プラー・マー・レー・エーン・ルーイ・チャート・ティー・レオ・キッ・ワー・キアオ・コーン・カップ・プラー・マイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Wow , you 're filleting it so nicely ! You look like a fishmonger filleting a fish ! Do you think you were related to fish in your past life ?

translations.ja: わあ、めちゃくちゃ綺麗にさばいてる！魚屋のお兄さんが自分でさばいてるみたい！前世は魚と何か縁があったんじゃない？
translations.en: Wow, you're filleting it so nicely! You look like a fishmonger filleting a fish! Do you think you were related to fish in your past life?
translations.ko: 와, 포를 엄청 예쁘게 뜨네요! 생선 가게 아저씨가 생선 손질하는 것 같아요! 전생에 생선이랑 아는 사이였나요?
translations.zh-TW: 哇，你片得真漂亮！你看起來就像個在市場賣魚的魚販！你覺得你上輩子跟魚有什麼關係嗎？
translations.id: Wow, kamu memfilletnya dengan sangat rapi! Kamu terlihat seperti penjual ikan yang sedang memfillet ikan! Apakah menurutmu kamu punya hubungan dengan ikan di kehidupan masa lalumu?
translations.pt: Nossa, você está filetando tão bem! Você parece um peixeiro filetando um peixe! Acha que era parente de peixe em sua vida passada?

transcript.text: I'm not sure, but I could swim right away when I was born. / Meenanuch is Jung! Do you remember why you could swim right away?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: マイ・ネー・チャイ・テー・クート・マー・ゴー・ワーイ・ナーム・ダイ・ルーイ / ミーナヌット・クー・ピ・ジャン・ニー・エーン・チャム・ダイ・マイ・ワー・タムマイ・トゥン・ワーイ・ダイ・タンティー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I 'm not sure , but I could swim right away when I was born . / Meenanuch is Jung ! Do you remember why you could swim right away ?

translations.ja: よく分からないけど、生まれた瞬間から泳げたよ／ミーナヌット（※タイの人魚ドラマに登場するキャラクター）はピジャンだったんだ！なんで生まれた途端に泳げたか覚えてる？
translations.en: I'm not sure, but I could swim right away when I was born. / Meenanuch is Jung! Do you remember why you could swim right away?
translations.ko: 잘 모르겠지만, 태어났을 때 바로 수영할 수 있었어요. / 미나누치(Meenanuch)는 바로 정이네요! 태어나자마자 수영할 수 있었던 이유가 기억나요?
translations.zh-TW: 我不確定，但我一出生就會游泳了。／Meenanuch 就是 Jung！你還記得你為什麼一出生就會游泳嗎？
translations.id: Aku tidak yakin, tapi aku langsung bisa berenang saat lahir. / Meenanuch adalah Jung! Apakah kamu ingat kenapa kamu bisa langsung berenang?
translations.pt: Não tenho certeza, mas eu sabia nadar assim que nasci. / Meenanuch é o Jung! Você lembra por que sabia nadar logo de cara?

transcript.text: Something was stuck in my belly button, so I kept pushing it. / And suddenly you could swim? / Yeah, and I could swim like a fish.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ミー・アライ・ティット・ユー・ティー・サドゥ・ゴー・ルーイ・ゴット・パイ・ルアイ・ルアイ / レオ・ユー・ユー・ゴー・ワーイ・ダイ・ルーイ・ルー / チャイ・レオ・ゴー・ワーイ・ダイ・ムアン・プラー・ルーイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Something was stuck in my belly button , so I kept pushing it . / And suddenly you could swim ? / Yeah , and I could swim like a fish .

translations.ja: おへそに何かが詰まってて、それをずっと押してたんだ／そしたら急に泳げるようになったの？／そう、それで魚みたいにスイスイ泳げるようになったんだよ。
translations.en: Something was stuck in my belly button, so I kept pushing it. / And suddenly you could swim? / Yeah, and I could swim like a fish.
translations.ko: 배꼽에 뭔가 껴 있어서 그걸 계속 눌렀거든요. / 그랬더니 갑자기 수영이 됐다고요? / 네, 물고기처럼 수영할 수 있었어요.
translations.zh-TW: 有東西卡在我肚臍裡，所以我一直按它。／然後你突然就會游泳了？／對，而且我游得跟魚一樣好。
translations.id: Ada sesuatu yang tersangkut di pusarku, jadi aku terus menekannya. / Dan tiba-tiba kamu bisa berenang? / Ya, dan aku bisa berenang seperti ikan.
translations.pt: Tinha alguma coisa presa no meu inbigo, então eu ficava empurrando. / E de repente você soube nadar? / É, e eu conseguia nadar como um peixe.

transcript.text: There was this one time, my dear viewers, when he dreamed about a fish. Tell them all about it. / I don't know where to focus! / But there was this one time he dreamed about a fish. Tell them all about it.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ミー・クラン・ヌン・ナ・クラップ・ターン・プー・チョム・カオ・クーイ・ファン・ヘン・プラー・ラオ・ハイ・トゥック・コン・ファン・ノーイ / マイ・ルー・チャ・フォーカス・トロン・ナイ・ディー・レオ / テー・ミー・クラン・ヌン・ティー・ファン・トゥン・プラー・ラオ・ハイ・ファン・ノーイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: There was this one time , my dear viewers , when he dreamed about a fish . Tell them all about it . / I don 't know where to focus ! / But there was this one time he dreamed about a fish . Tell them all about it .

translations.ja: 視聴者のみなさん、彼が魚の夢を見たことがあるんですよ。みんなに話してあげて／どこに集中すればいいのか分からないよ！／でも魚の夢を見たことがあるんだよね。みんなに話してあげて。
translations.en: There was this one time, my dear viewers, when he dreamed about a fish. Tell them all about it. / I don't know where to focus! / But there was this one time he dreamed about a fish. Tell them all about it.
translations.ko: 사랑하는 시청자 여러분, 그가 물고기 꿈을 꾼 적이 한 번 있었어요. 그 얘기를 전부 들려주세요. / 어디에 집중해야 할지 모르겠어요! / 하지만 그가 물고기 꿈을 꾼 적이 한 번 있었죠. 그 얘기를 다 해줘요.
translations.zh-TW: 有一次，各位親愛的觀眾，他夢見了一條魚。把這件事告訴大家吧！／我都不知道該把焦點放在哪裡！／但有一次他夢見了一條魚。把這件事告訴大家吧。
translations.id: Ada suatu ketika, para penonton sekalian, ketika dia bermimpi tentang seekor ikan. Ceritakan semuanya kepada mereka! / Aku tidak tahu harus fokus ke mana! / Tapi ada suatu ketika dia bermimpi tentang ikan. Ceritakan semuanya kepada mereka.
translations.pt: Teve aquela vez, meus queridos espectadores, que ele sonhou com um peixe. Contem tudo para eles. / Não sei onde focar! / Mas teve aquela vez que ele sonhou com um peixe. Contem tudo para eles.

transcript.text: The fish came into my dream and told me I was actually pretty good looking. / Damn!
transcript.pronunciation_kana: プラー・マー・カオ・ファン・レオ・ボーク・ワー・チン・チン・レオ・ポム・コー・ロー・ムアン・カン・ナ・チア
transcript.pronunciation_roman: The fish came into my dream and told me I was actually pretty good looking . / Damn !

translations.ja: 魚が夢に出てきて、「君って実は結構イケメンだね」って言ってきたんだよね。 / うわっ！
translations.en: The fish came into my dream and told me I was actually pretty good looking. / Damn!
translations.ko: 물고기가 꿈에 나와서 제가 사실 꽤 잘생겼다고 말해줬어요. / 젠장!
translations.zh-TW: 那條魚進入我的夢裡，告訴我其實我長得滿帥的。／靠！
translations.id: Ikan itu datang ke dalam mimpiku dan mengatakan bahwa aku sebenarnya cukup tampan. / Sialan!
translations.pt: O peixe entrou no meu sonho e me disse que eu era bem bonito, na verdade. / Droga!

transcript.text: That fish is such a fan of yours. So the fish told you that you were good looking. Did you believe it in your dream? / You ask so many questions!
transcript.pronunciation_kana: プラー・トゥア・ナン・ペン・エーフ・シー・ナ・ニアン・サルップ・プラー・ボーク・ワー・ロー・レオ・ナイ・ファン・チュア・マイ・ターム・ユア・ジャン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: That fish is such a fan of yours . So the fish told you that you were good looking . Did you believe it in your dream ? / You ask so many questions !

translations.ja: その魚、完全にファンの子じゃん555 で、魚にイケメンって言われて、夢の中で信じたの？ / めっちゃ質問してくるじゃん！
translations.en: That fish is such a fan of yours. So the fish told you that you were good looking. Did you believe it in your dream? / You ask so many questions!
translations.ko: 그 물고기 정말 열성팬이네요. 물고기가 잘생겼다고 하니까 꿈에서 그걸 믿었나요? / 질문이 정말 많으시네요!
translations.zh-TW: 那條魚真的是你的超級粉絲耶。所以那條魚告訴你你長得很帥。你在夢裡相信了嗎？／你問題真的很多！
translations.id: Ikan itu benar-benar penggemarmu. Jadi ikan itu bilang kamu tampan. Apakah kamu mempercayainya dalam mimpimu? / Kamu banyak sekali bertanya!
translations.pt: Esse peixe é muito seu fã. Então o peixe te disse que você era bonito. Você acreditou nisso no seu sonho? / Você faz muitas perguntas!

transcript.text: This is how I do it, right? / Amazing. / Yes, perfect. Now do the same on the other side. / Wow, you're really good at this! You're doing a great job!

translations.en: Okay, let's keep going. What's next? / I was a very active kid. / You've loved joining activities since you were a kid.
translations.ko: 좋아요, 계속해 볼까요. 다음은요? / 저는 아주 활동적인 아이였어요. / 어릴 때부터 활동하는 걸 좋아했군요.
translations.zh-TW: 好，我們繼續。接下來呢？／我是一個非常活躍的小孩。／你從小就喜歡參加各種活動。
translations.id: Baiklah, mari kita lanjutkan. Apa selanjutnya? / Aku anak yang sangat aktif. / Kamu sudah suka ikut berbagai kegiatan sejak kecil.
translations.pt: Ok, vamos continuar. O que vem a seguir? / Eu era uma criança muito ativa. / Você adora participar de atividades desde criança.

transcript.text: Yes, I loved dancing to Korean music with my seniors. / So you've been dancing for a long time? / Yes. / So was dancing your main talent as a kid? Like cover dances?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: チャイ・クラップ・ジョープ・テン・プレーン・カオリー・カップ・ルンピー・ガン・コー・テン・マー・ナーン・レオ・シ・チャイ・クラップ・レオ・トーン・デック・デック・テン・ペン・クワーム・サーマート・ラック・ルーイ・ルー・ベーップ・プアック・コーフウォー・デーンス
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Yes , I loved dancing to Korean music with my seniors . / So you 've been dancing for a long time ? / Yes . / So was dancing your main talent as a kid ? Like cover dances ?

translations.ja: チャイ・クラップ（そうです）、先輩たちとK-POPを踊るのが大好きで。 / じゃあダンス歴長いんだね？ / チャイ・クラップ（はい）。 / 子供の頃の特技はダンスがメインだったの？カバーダンスとか？
translations.en: Yes, I loved dancing to Korean music with my seniors. / So you've been dancing for a long time? / Yes. / So was dancing your main talent as a kid? Like cover dances?
translations.ko: 네, 선배들과 한국 음악에 맞춰 춤추는 걸 좋아했어요. / 그럼 춤을 꽤 오래 췄네요? / 네. / 그럼 어릴 때 주특기가 춤이었어요? 커버 댄스 같은 거요?
translations.zh-TW: 對，我很喜歡和學長姐一起跳韓國流行音樂的舞。／所以你跳舞很久了？／對。／那跳舞是你小時候的主要才藝嗎？像是翻跳舞蹈？
translations.id: Ya, aku suka menari mengikuti musik Korea bersama para senior. / Jadi, kamu sudah lama menari? / Ya. / Jadi, apakah menari adalah bakat utamamu waktu kecil? Seperti tarian cover?
translations.pt: Sim, eu adoro dançar música coreana com os veteranos. / Então você dança há muito tempo? / Sim. / Então a dança era seu principal talento quando criança? Tipo covers de dança?

transcript.text: I danced and sang too. I also competed on a show. I went viral as a kid. / What was it? / The Voice Kids.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: テン・ドゥアイ・ローン・ドゥアイ・クラップ・クーイ・パイ・プラクワット・ラーイカーン・ドゥアイ・トーン・デック・デック・クーイ・ワイラン・ユー・ラーイカーン・アライ・ナ・デ・ウォーイス・キット・クラップ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I danced and sang too . I also competed on a show . I went viral as a kid . / What was it ? / The Voice Kids .

translations.ja: ダンスも歌も両方やってました。オーディション番組にも出たことあって、子供の頃バズったことあるんです。 / 何の番組？ / 『The Voice Kids』ですクラップ。
translations.en: I danced and sang too. I also competed on a show. I went viral as a kid. / What was it? / The Voice Kids.
translations.ko: 춤도 추고 노래도 했어요. 대회에도 나간 적이 있어요. 어릴 때 꽤 화제가 됐었죠. / 그게 뭔데요? / 더 보이스 키즈요.
translations.zh-TW: 我會跳舞也會唱歌。我還參加過選秀節目。我小時候在網路上爆紅過。／是什麼節目？／《聲林之王兒童版》（The Voice Kids）。
translations.id: Aku menari dan juga bernyanyi. Aku juga pernah ikut kompetisi di acara TV. Aku sempat viral waktu kecil. / Acara apa? / The Voice Kids.
translations.pt: Eu dançava e cantava também. Também competi em um programa. Fiquei famoso na internet quando criança. / O que era? / The Voice Kids.

transcript.text: The legendary The Voice Kids. / Yes, have you watched it before? / Of course! You were really famous. And when you joined T Pop, you became famous because you were that viral kid from The Voice Kids.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: デ・ウォーイス・キット・ナイ・タムナーン・チャイ・クラップ・クーイ・ドゥー・マイ・クラップ・ネーノーン・ダン・マーク・ルーイ・ナ・レオ・ポー・カオ・マー・ウォンガーン・ティー・ポップ・コー・ダン・プロ・ペン・デック・ワイラン・チャーク・デ・ウォーイス・キット・コン・ナン・レ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: The legendary The Voice Kids . / Yes , have you watched it before ? / Of course ! You were really famous . And when you joined T Pop , you became famous because you were that viral kid from The Voice Kids .

translations.ja: 伝説の『The Voice Kids』！ / チャイ・クラップ（はい）、見たことありますか？ / もちろん！めちゃくちゃ有名だったじゃん。で、T-POP界に入ってきた時も、「The Voice Kidsでバズったあの子だ！」って話題になったもんね。
translations.en: The legendary The Voice Kids. / Yes, have you watched it before? / Of course! You were really famous. And when you joined T Pop, you became famous because you were that viral kid from The Voice Kids.
translations.ko: 전설의 더 보이스 키즈요. / 네, 보신 적 있어요? / 당연하죠! 정말 유명했잖아요. 그리고 T-POP에 들어왔을 때, 더 보이스 키즈의 그 화제의 아이돌로 유명해졌죠.
translations.zh-TW: 傳說中的《聲林之王兒童版》。／對，你看過嗎？／當然！你超有名的。而且你加入 T Pop 時，大家就知道你是那個從《聲林之王》爆紅的小孩。
translations.id: The Voice Kids yang legendaris. / Ya, apa kamu pernah menontonnya? / Tentu saja! Kamu benar-benar terkenal. Dan saat kamu bergabung dengan T Pop, kamu jadi terkenal karena kamu anak viral dari The Voice Kids itu.
translations.pt: O lendário The Voice Kids. / Sim, você já assistiu? / Claro! Você era muito famoso. E quando entrou no T-Pop, ficou famoso por ser aquele garoto viral do The Voice Kids.

transcript.text: Yes! / I remember. / I danced a lot after my voice broke and I couldn't sing like I used to.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: チャイ・クラップ・チャム・ダイ・ポム・マー・テン・ユア・クン・トーン・シアン・テーク・ヌム・レオ・ローン・プレーン・ムアン・ドゥーム・マイ・ダイ・レオ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Yes ! / I remember . / I danced a lot after my voice broke and I couldn 't sing like I used to .

translations.ja: チャイ・クラップ（そうです）！ / 覚えてるよ。 / 声変わりして前みたいに歌えなくなっちゃってから、ダンスをすごくやるようになったんです。
translations.en: Yes! / I remember. / I danced a lot after my voice broke and I couldn't sing like I used to.
translations.ko: 맞아요! / 기억나요. / 변성기가 온 뒤로는 예전처럼 노래를 못 해서 춤을 많이 췄어요.
translations.zh-TW: 對！／我記得。／我變聲之後就跳了很多舞，沒辦法像以前那樣唱歌了。
translations.id: Ya! / Aku ingat. / Aku banyak menari setelah suara ku pecah dan aku tidak bisa bernyanyi seperti dulu.
translations.pt: Sim! / Eu me lembro. / Eu dancei muito depois que minha voz mudou e eu não conseguia mais cantar como antes.

transcript.text: I really want to know, for boys who sing well as kids and then their voices break, can they still sing well?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ヤーク・ルー・チン・チン・ルーイ・ワー・デック・プー・チャーイ・ティー・ローン・プレーン・プロ・トーン・デック・ポー・シアン・テーク・レオ・ヤン・ローン・プロ・ユー・マイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I really want to know , for boys who sing well as kids and then their voices break , can they still sing well ?

translations.ja: すごく気になってたんですけど、子どもの頃に歌が上手かった男の子って、声変わりした後も変わらず上手に歌えるんですか？
translations.en: I really want to know, for boys who sing well as kids and then their voices break, can they still sing well?
translations.ko: 정말 궁금한 게 있는데요, 어릴 때 노래를 잘하던 소년들이 변성기가 오면 여전히 노래를 잘할 수 있나요?
translations.zh-TW: 我真的很想知道，小時候很會唱歌的男生變聲之後，還能唱得好嗎？
translations.id: Aku sangat ingin tahu, bagi anak laki-laki yang bernyanyi dengan baik saat kecil lalu suara mereka pecah, apakah mereka masih bisa bernyanyi dengan baik?
translations.pt: Eu realmente quero saber, para garotos que cantam bem quando crianças e depois a voz muda, eles ainda conseguem cantar bem?

transcript.text: I think it takes time to adjust, but I felt really down at the time. I felt like I should stop singing and focus on dancing instead. So I started taking dance competitions seriously.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ポム・ワー・トン・チャイ・ウェー・ラー・プラップ・トゥア・テー・トーン・ナン・ルー・スック・ノイド・マーク・ルー・スック・ワー・ユット・ローン・レオ・パイ・フォー・カッス・ダーン・テン・ディー・クワー・ゴー・ルーイ・ルーム・ケン・テン・チン・チャン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I think it takes time to adjust , but I felt really down at the time . I felt like I should stop singing and focus on dancing instead . So I started taking dance competitions seriously .

translations.ja: 調整するのに時間がかかると思います。でも当時はすごく落ち込んじゃって、歌はやめてダンスに集中しようって思ったんです。それで本格的にダンスの大会に出るようになりました。
translations.en: I think it takes time to adjust, but I felt really down at the time. I felt like I should stop singing and focus on dancing instead. So I started taking dance competitions seriously.
translations.ko: 적응하는 데 시간이 좀 걸리는 것 같아요. 하지만 당시에는 정말 우울했어요. 노래를 그만두고 춤에만 집중해야겠다고 느꼈죠. 그래서 춤 대회에 진지하게 임하기 시작했어요.
translations.zh-TW: 我覺得需要時間適應，但我當時真的很沮喪。我覺得我應該停止唱歌，專心跳舞。所以我開始認真參加舞蹈比賽。
translations.id: Menurutku butuh waktu untuk beradaptasi, tapi aku merasa sangat down saat itu. Aku merasa harus berhenti bernyanyi dan fokus menari saja. Jadi, aku mulai serius mengikuti kompetisi menari.
translations.pt: Acho que leva tempo para se adaptar, mas eu me senti muito mal na época. Senti que deveria parar de cantar e focar na dança. Então comecei a levar as competições de dança a sério.

transcript.text: So you decided to take dancing seriously. / Yes. How did it go? Was it successful? / Yes, because they saw one of my dance clips and called me in for an audition for PERSES.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ゴー・ルーイ・ハン・マー・アオ・ディー・ダーン・テン・/・チャイ・クラップ・レオ・ペン・ガイ・プラ・ソップ・クワーム・サム・レット・マイ・/・チャイ・クラップ・プロ・カオ・ヘン・クリップ・テン・コーン・ポム・ゴー・ルーイ・リーヤック・マー・オー・ディ・シャン・パーセス
transcript.pronunciation_roman: So you decided to take dancing seriously . / Yes . How did it go ? Was it successful ? / Yes , because they saw one of my dance clips and called me in for an audition for PERSES .

translations.ja: それでダンスに本腰を入れたんだね。／チャイ・クラップ（そうです）。どうだった？うまくいった？／チャイ・クラップ（はい）、僕のダンス動画を見てくれたスタッフが、PERSESのオーディションに呼んでくれたんです。
translations.en: So you decided to take dancing seriously. / Yes. How did it go? Was it successful? / Yes, because they saw one of my dance clips and called me in for an audition for PERSES.
translations.ko: 그래서 춤을 진지하게 해보기로 결심했군요. / 네. 어땠어요? 성공적이었나요? / 네, 제 춤 클립을 보고 PERSES 오디션에 연락을 주셨거든요.
translations.zh-TW: 所以你決定認真走跳舞這條路。／對。結果怎麼樣？成功嗎？／對，因為他們看到我的一支舞蹈影片，就叫我去參加 PERSES 的試鏡。
translations.id: Jadi, kamu memutuskan untuk serius menari. / Ya. Bagaimana hasilnya? Apakah berhasil? / Ya, karena mereka melihat salah satu klip tancoku dan memanggilku untuk audisi PERSES.
translations.pt: Então você decidiu levar a dança a sério. / Sim. Como foi? Foi bem-sucedido? / Sim, porque eles viram um dos meus clipes de dança e me chamaram para uma audição para o PERSES.

transcript.text: What are you doing, chef? I saw you moving the cutting board. / My back hurts. / Oh, the chef's back hurts. And his bones haven't fully connected yet.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: シェープ・タム・ア・ライ・ユー・ヘン・カ・ヤップ・キアン・/・プアット・ラン・クラップ・/・オー・シェープ・プアット・ラン・レオ・クラ・ドゥーク・ヤン・トー・ガン・マイ・サ・ニット・ルーイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: What are you doing , chef ? I saw you moving the cutting board . / My back hurts . / Oh , the chef 's back hurts . And his bones haven 't fully connected yet .

translations.ja: シェフ、何してるの？まな板動かしてたけど。／腰が痛くて。／あ〜、シェフ腰が痛いんだ。まだ骨も完全にくっついてないのに555
translations.en: What are you doing, chef? I saw you moving the cutting board. / My back hurts. / Oh, the chef's back hurts. And his bones haven't fully connected yet.
translations.ko: 셰프님, 뭐 하시는 거예요? 도마 옮기는 거 봤어요. / 허리 아파요. / 아, 셰프 허리가 아프시구나. 아직 뼈가 다 안 붙었나 봐요.
translations.zh-TW: 主廚你在幹嘛？我看到你在移動砧板。／我的腰好酸。／喔，主廚的腰好酸，而且他的骨頭好像還沒完全長好。
translations.id: Apa yang kamu lakukan, chef? Aku lihat kamu memindahkan talenan. / Punggungku sakit. / Oh, punggung chef sakit. Dan tulangnya belum sepenuhnya menyatu.
translations.pt: O que você está fazendo, chef? Eu vi você movendo a tábua de cortar. / Minha coluna dói. / Ah, a coluna do chef dói. E os ossos dele ainda não se consolidaram totalmente.

transcript.text: What about you? What was your childhood like? / My childhood was all about love.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: レオ・ピー・ラ・トーン・デック・ペン・ヤン・ガイ・/・ワイ・デック・コーン・ピー・ミー・テー・ルアン・クワーム・ラック
transcript.pronunciation_roman: What about you ? What was your childhood like ? / My childhood was all about love .

translations.ja: じゃあそっちは？子どもの頃どんな感じだったの？／僕の幼少期は恋バナばっかりだよ。
translations.en: What about you? What was your childhood like? / My childhood was all about love.
translations.ko: 당신은요? 어린 시절이 어땠나요? / 제 어린 시절은 온통 사랑이었어요.
translations.zh-TW: 那你呢？你的童年是什麼樣的？／我的童年全都是關於愛。
translations.id: Bagaimana denganmu? Seperti apa masa kecilmu? / Masa kecilku penuh dengan cinta.
translations.pt: E você? Como foi sua infância? / Minha infância foi pura paixão.

transcript.text: Yeah, I started experiencing love when I was in kindergarten. I had a crush on one of my friends from the next class when we were lining up together.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: チャイ・ピー・ルーム・ミー・クワーム・ラック・タン・テー・ア・ヌ・バーン・エープ・チョープ・プアン・ホーン・カーン・カーン・トーン・カオ・テーオ・ドゥアイ・ガン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Yeah , I started experiencing love when I was in kindergarten . I had a crush on one of my friends from the next class when we were lining up together .

translations.ja: チャイ（そうだよ）、幼稚園の頃からもう恋をしててさ。朝の整列の時に、隣のクラスの子を好きになっちゃったんだよね。
translations.en: Yeah, I started experiencing love when I was in kindergarten. I had a crush on one of my friends from the next class when we were lining up together.
translations.ko: 네, 유치원 때부터 사랑을 겪기 시작했어요. 줄을 서 있을 때 옆 반 친구를 짝사랑했거든요.
translations.zh-TW: 對啊，我幼稚園的時候就開始體驗到愛了。排隊時我暗戀隔壁班的一個朋友。
translations.id: Ya, aku mulai mengenal cinta saat aku di taman kanak-kanak. Aku naksir salah satu teman dari kelas sebelah saat kami berbaris bersama.
translations.pt: Sim, comecei a vivenciar o amor quando estava no jardim de infância. Eu tinha uma paixão por uma das minhas amigas da turma ao lado quando fazíamos fila juntos.

transcript.text: And when we lined up, we had to stand next to each other. / The lines were next to each other. Class 1 and Class 2 were next to each other. / Yeah.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: レオ・トーン・カオ・テーオ・トン・ユーン・カーン・ガン・/・テーオ・マン・ユー・カーン・ガン・ホーン・ヌン・ガップ・ホーン・ソーン・ユー・ティット・ガン・/・チャイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: And when we lined up , we had to stand next to each other . / The lines were next to each other . Class 1 and Class 2 were next to each other . / Yeah .

translations.ja: 並ぶ時、ちょうど隣同士になっちゃうんだよね。／列が隣り合わせだったんだ。1組と2組が隣で。／チャイ（そう）。
translations.en: And when we lined up, we had to stand next to each other. / The lines were next to each other. Class 1 and Class 2 were next to each other. / Yeah.
translations.ko: 줄을 설 때면 꼭 옆에 서야 했어요. / 줄이 바로 옆이었죠. 1반과 2반이 나란히 있었으니까요. / 맞아요.
translations.zh-TW: 排隊的時候，我們必須站在一起。／隊伍剛好排在隔壁。一班和二班排在一起。／對啊。
translations.id: Dan saat berbaris, kami harus berdiri berdampingan. / Barisannya berdampingan. Kelas 1 dan Kelas 2 berdampingan. / Ya.
translations.pt: E quando fazíamos fila, tínhamos que ficar um ao lado do outro. / As filas ficavam lado a lado. A turma 1 e a turma 2 ficavam lado a lado. / Sim.

transcript.text: We had to sing the national anthem, and while we were singing, we made eye contact. / Wow, singing the national anthem and making sweet eye contact.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: トン・ローン・プレーン・チャート・レオ・トーン・ローン・プレーン・ゴー・ソップ・ター・ガン・/・ワーオ・ローン・プレーン・チャート・パイ・ソン・サーイ・ター・ワーン・スン・パイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: We had to sing the national anthem , and while we were singing , we made eye contact . / Wow , singing the national anthem and making sweet eye contact .

translations.ja: 国歌を歌わなきゃいけないんだけど、歌いながら目が合っちゃったりして。／わぁ、国歌を歌いながら甘いアイコンタクトしてたんだ。
translations.en: We had to sing the national anthem, and while we were singing, we made eye contact. / Wow, singing the national anthem and making sweet eye contact.
translations.ko: 국가 징을 불어야 했는데, 부르면서 눈이 마주쳤죠. / 와, 국가를 부르면서 달콤한 눈빛을 교환했군요.
translations.zh-TW: 我們得唱國歌，唱著唱著我們就對到眼了。／哇，唱國歌還能含情脈脈地對視。
translations.id: Kami harus menyanyikan lagu kebangsaan, dan saat bernyanyi, kami saling melakukan kontak mata. / Wah, menyanyikan lagu kebangsaan sambil saling tatap dengan manis.
translations.pt: Tínhamos que cantar o hino nacional e, enquanto cantávamos, fazíamos contato visual. / Uau, cantar o hino nacional e fazer um contato visual romântico.

transcript.text: Okay, try being him, and I'll be the girl in Class 1.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: アオ・ラ・ローン・ペン・カオ・ドゥー・ディアオ・ピー・ペン・デック・プー・イン・ホーン・ヌン・エーン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Okay , try being him , and I 'll be the girl in Class 1 .

translations.ja: じゃあ、その男の子役やってみて。僕が1組の女の子をやるから。
translations.en: Okay, try being him, and I'll be the girl in Class 1.
translations.ko: 자, 그 사람 역할을 해봐요. 난 1반 여자아이를 할게요.
translations.zh-TW: 好，你來當他，我來當一班的女生。
translations.id: Baiklah, coba kamu jadi dia, dan aku jadi anak perempuan di Kelas 1.
translations.pt: Ok, tente ser ele, e eu serei a garota da turma 1.

transcript.text: Like that? Isn't the atmosphere strange? / It's not that bad though.
