translations.en: Oh my God. / How is it? P'Eclair's eyes are wide open! / Maybe you didn't get any sauce. / I did, it's delicious. Dig in, guys. It's delicious.
translations.ko: 세상에. / 어때요? P'에클레르 눈이 동그래졌어요! / 소스를 안 찍었나 봐요. / 찍었어요, 맛있어. 다들 드셔보세요. 맛있어요.
translations.zh-TW: 我的天啊。／怎麼樣？Eclair 姊姊眼睛瞪超大！／可能是你沒沾到醬汁。／我有沾啊，很好吃。大家快吃。很好吃。
translations.id: Ya ampun. / Bagaimana rasanya? Mata P'Eclair terbuka lebar! / Mungkin kamu tidak pakai saus. / Aku pakai, ini enak. Makanlah, teman-teman. Ini enak.
translations.pt: Ai meu Deus. / Como está? Os olhos do P'Eclair estão arregalados! / Talvez você não tenha pego molho. / Peguei, está delicioso. Comam, gente. Está delicioso.

transcript.text: It's such a simple dish, but it's so delicious. It's really aromatic. / That's scary. / The chili smells really strong, but the lemongrass smells nice.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: タム・ンガーイ・ンガーイ・テー・アローイ・マーク・ホーム・マーク・ナー・クルア・マーク・クリン・プリック・レン・マーク・テー・クリン・タクライ・ホーム
transcript.pronunciation_roman: It 's such a simple dish , but it 's so delicious . It 's really aromatic . / That 's scary . / The chili smells really strong , but the lemongrass smells nice .

translations.ja: 簡単な料理なのにすごく美味しい。すごくいい香り。／ちょっと怖いよ／唐辛子の匂いは強いけどレモングラスの香りがすごくいいね。
translations.en: It's such a simple dish, but it's so delicious. It's really aromatic. / That's scary. / The chili smells really strong, but the lemongrass smells nice.
translations.ko: 정말 간단한 요리인데 너무 맛있어요. 향이 정말 좋네요. / 무섭다. / 고추 냄새가 정말 강한데 레몬그라스 향이 좋아요.
translations.zh-TW: 這道菜雖然簡單，但卻很好吃。真的很香。／這有點可怕。／辣椒的味道很濃，但香茅的味道很香。
translations.id: Ini hidangan yang sangat sederhana, tapi sangat enak. Aromanya benar-benar harum. / Itu menyeramkan. / Aroma cabainya sangat kuat, tapi serainya harum.
translations.pt: É um prato tão simples, mas é tão delicioso. É muito aromático. / Isso é assustador. / O cheiro da pimenta é muito forte, mas o capim-limão cheira bem.

transcript.text: Isn't it good? The dressing is delicious. Is it good? / Yeah. / It's somehow really good. / But I wish there was more dressing.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: アローイ・マイ・ナム・ヤム・アローイ・アローイ・マイ・チャイ・アローイ・チューイ・ルーイ・テー・ヤーク・ダイ・ナム・ヤム・イーク
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Isn 't it good ? The dressing is delicious . Is it good ? / Yeah . / It 's somehow really good . / But I wish there was more dressing .

translations.ja: 美味しいでしょ？タレが美味しいよね。美味しい？／うん／なんか普通にめっちゃ美味しい。／でもタレがもっとあってもいいかも。
translations.en: Isn't it good? The dressing is delicious. Is it good? / Yeah. / It's somehow really good. / But I wish there was more dressing.
translations.ko: 맛있지 않아요? 소스가 정말 맛있어요. 맛있죠? / 네. / 왠지 정말 맛있네요. / 하지만 소스가 좀 더 많았으면 좋겠어요.
translations.zh-TW: 不好吃嗎？醬汁很讚。好吃嗎？／對啊。／不知為何真的很讚。／但我希望醬汁能再多一點。
translations.id: Bukankah ini enak? Bumbu siramannya enak. Apakah enak? / Ya. / Rasanya sungguh enak entah bagaimana. / Tapi kuharap bumbu siramannya lebih banyak.
translations.pt: Não está bom? O tempero está delicioso. Está bom? / É. / É muito bom de alguma forma. / Mas eu queria que houvesse mais tempero.

transcript.text: Let me get some of that dressing. / It's so good! It's delicious. Fresh sea bass is naturally sweet, and because we deep fried it, it's crispy, so that's a great base.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: コー・ナム・ヤム・ノイ・アローイ・マーク・アローイ・プラー・カポン・ソット・ワーン・レオ・ラオ・トート・クロープ・ドゥアイ・ペン・ベート・ティー・ディー・マーク
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Let me get some of that dressing . / It 's so good ! It 's delicious . Fresh sea bass is naturally sweet , and because we deep fried it , it 's crispy , so that 's a great base .

translations.ja: 僕にもタレかけて。／めちゃくちゃ美味しい！美味しいよ。新鮮なスズキの身が甘いし、カリカリに揚げてあるからベースとして最高だね。
translations.en: Let me get some of that dressing. / It's so good! It's delicious. Fresh sea bass is naturally sweet, and because we deep fried it, it's crispy, so that's a great base.
translations.ko: 소스 좀 더 가져올게요. / 정말 맛있어요! 맛있어. 신선한 농어는 본연의 단맛이 나고, 튀겼기 때문에 바삭해서 훌륭한 베이스가 되죠.
translations.zh-TW: 讓我沾點那個醬汁。／真的太讚了！很好吃。新鮮海鱸魚本身就很甜，而且因為我們是炸的，所以外酥內嫩，這是個很棒的基底。
translations.id: Biar aku ambil sedikit bumbu siramannya. / Enak sekali! Lezat. Ikan siakap segar secara alami manis, dan karena kita menggorengnya hingga garing, itu jadi dasar yang sangat bagus.
translations.pt: Deixa eu pegar um pouco desse tempero. / É muito bom! Está delicioso. O robalo fresco é naturalmente doce e, como o fritamos por imersão, fica crocante, então essa é uma ótima base.

transcript.text: The dressing really deserves the credit today. / It's delicious. / We all helped each other make it. / It's so good. I feel like the herbs and spices are so fragrant when you eat them with the fish.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ワン・ニー・ナム・ヤム・トン・ダイ・クレディット・チン・チン・アローイ・ラオ・チュアイ・カン・タム・トゥック・コン・アローイ・マーク・ルー・スック・ワー・サモン・プライ・ホーム・マーク・ウェーラー・キン・カップ・プラー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: The dressing really deserves the credit today . / It 's delicious . / We all helped each other make it . / It 's so good . I feel like the herbs and spices are so fragrant when you eat them with the fish .

translations.ja: 今日の主役は間違いなくこのタレだね。／美味しい。／みんなで協力して作ったからね。／すごく美味しい。魚と一緒に食べるとハーブの香りがすごく引き立つよ。
translations.en: The dressing really deserves the credit today. / It's delicious. / We all helped each other make it. / It's so good. I feel like the herbs and spices are so fragrant when you eat them with the fish.
translations.ko: 오늘 소스가 정말 한몫했네요. / 맛있어요. / 우리 다 같이 만들었잖아요. / 정말 맛있어요. 생선이랑 같이 먹으니까 허브랑 향신료 향이 너무 향긋하게 퍼지는 것 같아요.
translations.zh-TW: 這道醬汁今天真的居功至偉。／很好吃。／這是大家一起合力做的。／真的超棒。我覺得跟魚一起吃的時候，香草和香料的味道非常香。
translations.id: Bumbu siramannya benar-benar layak diacungi jempol hari ini. / Enak. / Kita semua saling membantu membuatnya. / Enak sekali. Rasanya rempah-rempah dan bumbunya sangat harum saat dimakan bersama ikan.
translations.pt: O tempero realmente merece o mérito hoje. / Está delicioso. / Todos nós ajudamos a fazer. / É muito bom. Sinto que as ervas e especiarias são muito perfumadas quando você as come com o peixe.

transcript.text: When? When is it fragrant? / Just now! It's so good. Isn't it good, Jung? / Yes! / Of course, my dear.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: トーン・ナイ・ホーム・トーン・ナイ・ムア・キー・アローイ・マーク・アローイ・マイ・ジャン・チャイ・ネー・ノーン・ユー・レオ・クラップ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: When ? When is it fragrant ? / Just now ! It 's so good . Isn 't it good , Jung ? / Yes ! / Of course , my dear .

translations.ja: いつ？いつ香ったの？／さっき！すごく美味しい。美味しいよねジャン？／うん！／もちろんですよ。
translations.en: When? When is it fragrant? / Just now! It's so good. Isn't it good, Jung? / Yes! / Of course, my dear.
translations.ko: 언제요? 언제 향긋했는데요? / 방금요! 정말 맛있어요. 맛있지, 정? / 네! / 당연하지, 내 사랑.
translations.zh-TW: 什麼時候？什麼時候很香？／就剛剛！真的很棒。不覺得很好吃嗎，Jung？／對啊！／當然啦，親愛的。
translations.id: Kapan? Kapan harumnya? / Baru saja! Enak sekali. Bukankah enak, Jung? / Ya! / Tentu saja, sayangku.
translations.pt: Quando? Quando está perfumado? / Agora mesmo! É muito bom. Não está bom, Jung? / Sim! / Com certeza, meu querido.

transcript.text: The dressing is so good. Amazing! / Basically, you can toss the fried fish in the spicy dressing in a big bowl before serving. It's so good.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ナム・ヤム・アローイ・マーク・アメイジング・チン・チン・クー・アオ・プラー・トート・パイ・クルック・カップ・ナム・ヤム・ナイ・チャーム・ヤイ・コーン・サープ・ダイ・ルーイ・アローイ・マーク
transcript.pronunciation_roman: The dressing is so good . Amazing ! / Basically , you can toss the fried fish in the spicy dressing in a big bowl before serving . It 's so good .

translations.ja: タレが本当に美味しい。アメイジング！／これ、盛り付ける前に大きなボウルで揚げた魚とタレを絡めてもいいね。すごく美味しい。
translations.en: The dressing is so good. Amazing! / Basically, you can toss the fried fish in the spicy dressing in a big bowl before serving. It's so good.
translations.ko: 소스가 정말 맛있어요. 최고야! / 기본적으로, 튀긴 생선을 큰 볼에 넣고 매콤한 소스와 함께 버무려서 내놓아도 아주 맛있어요.
translations.zh-TW: 醬汁真的太棒了。讚啦！／基本上，上菜前你可以把炸魚和香辣醬汁在大碗裡拌勻。超好吃的。
translations.id: Bumbu siramannya sangat enak. Luar biasa! / Pada dasarnya, kamu bisa mengaduk ikan goreng ke dalam bumbu pedas di mangkuk besar sebelum disajikan. Enak sekali.
translations.pt: O tempero está tão bom. Incrível! / Basicamente, você pode misturar o peixe frito no molho picante em uma tigela grande antes de servir. É muito bom.

transcript.text: I'm just repeating myself, that's all. I just want everyone to know that it's actually good. If it's not good, you can argue with me. Is it good? / It is.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ケー・プート・サム・チューイ・チューイ・ヤーク・ハイ・トゥック・コン・ルー・ワー・マン・アローイ・チン・チン・ター・マイ・アローイ・ティアン・ダイ・ルーイ・アローイ・マイ・アローイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I 'm just repeating myself , that 's all . I just want everyone to know that it 's actually good . If it 's not good , you can argue with me . Is it good ? / It is .

translations.ja: 何回も言ってるだけだよ。本当に美味しいってことをみんなに知ってほしいんだ。美味しくなかったら文句言っていいから。美味しい？／美味しいよ。
translations.en: I'm just repeating myself, that's all. I just want everyone to know that it's actually good. If it's not good, you can argue with me. Is it good? / It is.
translations.ko: 그냥 똑같은 말을 반복하는 거예요. 진짜 맛있다는 걸 다들 알아줬으면 해서요. 맛없으면 저랑 싸워도 돼요. 맛있죠? / 맛있어요.
translations.zh-TW: 我只是在重複一樣的話而已。我只是想讓大家知道它真的很好吃。如果不好吃，你可以跟我辯論。好吃嗎？／很好吃。
translations.id: Aku hanya mengulang-ngulang perkataanku, itu saja. Aku hanya ingin semua orang tahu bahwa ini benar-benar enak. Jika tidak enak, kamu boleh berdebat denganku. Apakah ini enak? / Enak.
translations.pt: Estou apenas me repetindo, só isso. Só quero que todos saibam que é realmente bom. Se não for bom, você pode discutir comigo. Está bom? / Está.

transcript.text: Does each of you have a dish you really miss? / I do. It's my grandma's Chinese vegetable stew. / Really? / Yeah, my grandma passed away, and I really miss her.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: テ・ラ・コン・ミー・メーヌー・ティー・キット・トゥン・マイ・ミー・チャップ・チャイ・コーン・アー・マー・チン・ルー・チャイ・アー・マー・シア・パイ・レオ・キット・トゥン・マーク
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Does each of you have a dish you really miss ? / I do . It 's my grandma 's Chinese vegetable stew . / Really ? / Yeah , my grandma passed away , and I really miss her .

translations.ja: みんなそれぞれ恋しい料理ってある？／僕あるよ。おばあちゃん（※中国系タイ人のおばあちゃん）のチャップチャイ（※中国風野菜煮込み）。／本当に？／うん、おばあちゃん亡くなっちゃったから、すごく恋しいんだ。
translations.en: Does each of you have a dish you really miss? / I do. It's my grandma's Chinese vegetable stew. / Really? / Yeah, my grandma passed away, and I really miss her.
translations.ko: 다들 각자 정말 그리운 음식이 있나요? / 있어요. 할머니가 끓여주시던 중국식 야채 스튜요. / 진짜요? / 네, 할머니가 돌아가셔서 정말 그리워요.
translations.zh-TW: 你們每個人都有最懷念的一道菜嗎？／我有。是我奶奶做的中式蔬菜湯。／真的嗎？／對啊，我奶奶過世了，我真的很想念她。
translations.id: Apakah masing-masing dari kalian punya hidangan yang sangat dirindukan? / Aku punya. Yaitu sup sayur ala Tionghoa buatan nenekku. / Benarkah? / Ya, nenekku sudah meninggal, dan aku sangat merindukannya.
translations.pt: Cada um de vocês tem um prato de que sente muita falta? / Eu tenho. É o ensopado de legumes chinês da minha avó. / Sério? / É, minha avó faleceu e sinto muita falta dela.

transcript.text: I really miss it. I'm addicted to eating cabbage stew twice a week because I miss the way she used to make it. / So none of the ones you've had since then taste as good as hers?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: キット・トゥン・マーク・ティット・キン・トム・カランプリー・アーティット・ラ・ソーン・クラン・プロ・キット・トゥン・ロット・ムー・カオ・サデーン・ワー・ティー・キン・マー・マイ・ミー・ティー・ナイ・アローイ・タオ・ルーイ・ルー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I really miss it . I 'm addicted to eating cabbage stew twice a week because I miss the way she used to make it . / So none of the ones you 've had since then taste as good as hers ?

translations.ja: 本当に恋しくて。おばあちゃんの味を思い出すから、週に2回はキャベツの煮込みを食べるのにハマってるんだ。／じゃあ今まで食べたやつでおばあちゃんのより美味しいのはないの？
translations.en: I really miss it. I'm addicted to eating cabbage stew twice a week because I miss the way she used to make it. / So none of the ones you've had since then taste as good as hers?
translations.ko: 정말 그리워요. 할머니가 만들어 주시던 맛이 그리워서 일주일에 두 번씩 양배추 스튜를 먹는 중독에 빠졌어요. / 그럼 그 이후에 먹어본 것들은 다 할머니 맛이 안 나나요?
translations.zh-TW: 我真的很想念。我迷上了每週吃兩次高麗菜湯，因為我很懷念她以前做的那種味道。／所以你們後來吃過的都沒有她做的好吃囉？
translations.id: Aku sangat merindukannya. Aku ketagihan makan sup kol dua kali seminggu karena aku rindu cara dia dulu membuatnya. / Jadi tidak ada satupun yang pernah kamu makan sejak saat itu yang enak buatan nenekmu?
translations.pt: Sinto muita falta. Sou viciado em comer ensopado de repolho duas vezes por semana porque sinto falta do jeito que ela costumava fazer. / Então nenhum dos que você comeu desde então tem um gosto tão bom quanto o dela?

transcript.text: Yeah, my grandma's cooking had a unique flavor that nobody else could recreate. / Is it true that one time you went to a restaurant and ordered cabbage stew, and you cried after taking one bite?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: チャイ・ロット・ムー・アー・マー・ミー・エーク・カ・ラック・マイ・ミー・クライ・ムアン・チン・マイ・ティー・クーイ・パイ・ラーン・アーハーン・レオ・サン・トム・カランプリー・ポー・キン・パイ・カム・レーク・ローン・ハイ・ルーイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Yeah , my grandma 's cooking had a unique flavor that nobody else could recreate . / Is it true that one time you went to a restaurant and ordered cabbage stew , and you cried after taking one bite ?

translations.ja: チャイ（そうなんだよ）。おばあちゃんの味付けは唯一無二で、誰も再現できないんだ。／ある店に行ってキャベツの煮込みを頼んだら、一口食べて泣いちゃったって本当？
translations.en: Yeah, my grandma's cooking had a unique flavor that nobody else could recreate. / Is it true that one time you went to a restaurant and ordered cabbage stew, and you cried after taking one bite?
translations.ko: 네, 할머니 요리에는 다른 사람은 흉내 낼 수 없는 독특한 풍미가 있었어요. / 전에 식당에 가서 양배추 스튜를 주문하고 한 입 먹은 다음에 울었다는 게 사실인가요?
translations.zh-TW: 對啊，我奶奶的菜有一種獨特的風味，別人模仿不來。／聽說你曾經去餐廳點了高麗菜湯，吃了一口之後就哭了，真的假的？
translations.id: Ya, masakan nenekku punya cita rasa unik yang tidak bisa ditiru orang lain. / Betulkah suatu ketika kamu pergi ke restoran dan memesan sup kol, lalu kamu menangis setelah satu suap?
translations.pt: É, a culinária da minha avó tinha um sabor único que mais ninguém conseguia recriar. / É verdade que uma vez você foi a um restaurante e pediu ensopado de repolho, e chorou depois de dar uma mordida?

transcript.text: How am I supposed to answer that? / Just say you did. 3, 2, 1.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: チャ・トープ・ヤン・ガイ・ニアン・トープ・ワー・チン・ルーイ・サーム・ソーン・ヌン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: How am I supposed to answer that ? / Just say you did . 3 , 2 , 1 .

translations.ja: どう答えればいいのさ555／本当って言いなよ。3、2、1！
translations.en: How am I supposed to answer that? / Just say you did. 3, 2, 1.
translations.ko: 제가 뭐라고 대답해야 하죠? / 그냥 울었다고 해. 3, 2, 1.
translations.zh-TW: 我要怎麼回答這個問題？／就說你有。3、2、1。
translations.id: Bagaimana aku harus menjawabnya? / Bilang saja iya. 3, 2, 1.
translations.pt: Como devo responder a isso? / Apenas diga que sim. 3, 2, 1.

transcript.text: I cried because I miss my grandma so much. I actually can't talk about her much without getting really emotional.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ローン・ハイ・プロ・キット・トゥン・アー・マー・マーク・チン・チン・プート・トゥン・アー・マー・マイ・ダイ・ルーイ・マン・チャ・センシティブ・マーク
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I cried because I miss my grandma so much . I actually can 't talk about her much without getting really emotional .

translations.ja: おばあちゃんをすごく思い出して泣いたんだ。実はおばあちゃんの話をすると、すごく感情的になっちゃうからあまり話せないんだよね。
translations.en: I cried because I miss my grandma so much. I actually can't talk about her much without getting really emotional.
translations.ko: 할머니가 너무 그리워서 울었어요. 사실 할머니 얘기만 해도 감정이 격해져서 잘 말을 못 해요.
translations.zh-TW: 我哭了是因為我太想念我奶奶了。其實我不太能聊到她，不然我會情緒很激動。
translations.id: Aku menangis karena sangat merindukan nenekku. Sebenarnya aku tidak bisa banyak membicarakannya tanpa menjadi sangat emosional.
translations.pt: Eu chorei porque sinto muita falta da minha avó. Na verdade, não consigo falar muito sobre ela sem ficar muito emocionado.

transcript.text: Let's give a round of applause to welcome his grandma! / That might be a little scary. / Grandma, go back for now.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: プロップ・ムー・トーン・ラップ・アー・マー・ノイ・ローン・ナ・ニアン・アー・マー・クラップ・パイ・コーン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Let 's give a round of applause to welcome his grandma ! / That might be a little scary . / Grandma , go back for now .

translations.ja: じゃあおばあちゃんをお迎えして拍手しよう！／それはちょっと怖いって555／おばあちゃん、一旦戻っててね。
translations.en: Let's give a round of applause to welcome his grandma! / That might be a little scary. / Grandma, go back for now.
translations.ko: 할머니를 모시는 박수를 쳐볼까요! / 그건 좀 무서운데요. / 할머니, 일단 들어가세요.
translations.zh-TW: 讓我們掌聲歡迎他奶奶！／那可能有點恐怖。／奶奶，妳先回去吧。
translations.id: Mari beri tepuk tangan untuk menyambut neneknya! / Itu mungkin sedikit menyeramkan. / Nenek, kembali dulu ya.
translations.pt: Vamos dar uma salva de palavas para receber a avó dele! / Isso pode ser um pouco assustador. / Vovó, volte por enquanto.

transcript.text: What about you? Any dishes you miss? Or is it gochujang fried pork? / My mom calls it rice noodle rolls, but it's actually steamed rice noodles with assorted toppings.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: レオ・ナーイ・ラ・ミー・メーヌー・ティー・キット・トゥン・マイ・ルー・ペン・ムー・パット・コチュジャン・メー・ポム・リーアク・ワー・クワイティアオ・ロード・テー・チン・チン・マン・クー・クワイティアオ・ロード・ソン・クルアン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: What about you ? Any dishes you miss ? Or is it gochujang fried pork ? / My mom calls it rice noodle rolls , but it 's actually steamed rice noodles with assorted toppings .

translations.ja: 君はどう？恋しい料理はある？それともコチュジャン豚肉炒め？／僕のお母さんはクイッティアオ・ロード（※タイ風蒸し春巻き・米粉麺包み）って呼んでるけど、実際は具だくさんの蒸し米麺なんだ。
translations.en: What about you? Any dishes you miss? Or is it gochujang fried pork? / My mom calls it rice noodle rolls, but it's actually steamed rice noodles with assorted toppings.
translations.ko: 너는 어때? 그리운 음식 있어? 아니면 고추장 제육볶음인가? / 우리 엄마는 쌀국수 롤이라고 부르는데, 사실은 여러 가지 토핑을 얹은 찜 쌀국수예요.
translations.zh-TW: 你呢？有什麼想念的菜嗎？還是韓式辣醬炒豬肉？／我媽把它叫做腸粉，但其實是蒸米粉配上各種配料。
translations.id: Bagaimana denganmu? Ada hidangan yang dirindukan? Atau daging babi goreng gochujang? / Ibuku menyebutnya gulungan mi beras, tapi sebenarnya itu mi beras kukus dengan berbagai topping.
translations.pt: E você? Algum prato de que sente falta? Ou é carne de porco frita com gochujang? / Minha mãe chama de rolinhos de macarrão de arroz, mas na verdade são macarrões de arroz cozidos no vapor com vários acompanhamentos.

transcript.text: What's that? Isn't rice noodle rolls enough? And it's called steamed rice noodles with assorted toppings? / It's steamed thick noodles with lots of toppings, like tofu. Do you guys know it?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: アライ・ナ・クワイティアオ・ロード・マイ・ポー・トン・ソン・クルアン・ドゥアイ・ルー・ペン・セン・ヤイ・ミー・クルアン・ヨ・ヨ・ミー・タオフー・ルー・チャック・カン・マイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: What 's that ? Isn 't rice noodle rolls enough ? And it 's called steamed rice noodles with assorted toppings ? / It 's steamed thick noodles with lots of toppings , like tofu . Do you guys know it ?

translations.ja: なにそれ？クイッティアオ・ロードだけじゃなくて、トッピング乗せって言うの？／太麺に豆腐とか色んな具がたっぷり乗ってるやつだよ。みんな知ってる？
translations.en: What's that? Isn't rice noodle rolls enough? And it's called steamed rice noodles with assorted toppings? / It's steamed thick noodles with lots of toppings, like tofu. Do you guys know it?
translations.ko: 그게 뭔데? 쌀국수 롤로 부족해서 여러 가지 토핑을 얹은 찜 쌀국수라고 부르는 거야? / 두부 같은 토핑이 잔뜩 올라간 찜 두께 있는 면이에요. 다들 아시나요?
translations.zh-TW: 那是什麼？腸粉還不夠嗎？而且叫蒸米粉配各種配料？／那是蒸的粗米粉，配上很多料，像是豆腐。你們知道嗎？
translations.id: Apa itu? Bukankah gulungan mi beras saja sudah cukup? Dan itu disebut mi beras kukus dengan berbagai topping? / Itu mi tebal kukus dengan banyak topping, seperti tahu. Apakah kalian tahu?
translations.pt: O que é isso? O macarrão de arroz não é suficiente? E se chama macarrão de arroz cozido no vapor com acompanhamentos variados? / São macarrões grossos cozidos no vapor com muitos acompanhamentos, como tofu. Vocês conhecem?

transcript.text: Minced pork and lots of other toppings. / Yeah, I've never had one anywhere as delicious as my mom's. / I wish I were your mom.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ムー・サップ・レオ・コー・クルアン・ヨ・ヨ・チャイ・マイ・クーイ・キン・ティー・ナイ・アローイ・タオ・コーン・メー・ルーイ・ヤーク・ペン・メー・ナーイ・ジャン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Minced pork and lots of other toppings . / Yeah , I 've never had one anywhere as delicious as my mom 's. / I wish I were your mom .

translations.ja: 豚ひき肉とか色んな具が乗ってるやつね。／そう、お母さんのより美味しいやつはどこでも食べたことがない。／僕が君のお母さんになりたいな。
translations.en: Minced pork and lots of other toppings. / Yeah, I've never had one anywhere as delicious as my mom's. / I wish I were your mom.
translations.ko: 다진 고기와 다른 토핑들이 듬뿍. / 네, 엄마가 만들어준 것만큼 맛있는 곳을 본 적이 없어요. / 내가 너희 엄마였으면 좋겠다.
translations.zh-TW: 豬絞肉還有很多其他配料。／對啊，我在其他地方都沒吃過跟我媽做的一樣好吃的。／我希望我是你媽。
translations.id: Daging babi cincang dan banyak topping lainnya. / Ya, aku belum pernah makan yang seenak buatan ibuku di mana pun. / Aku berharap aku adalah ibumu.
translations.pt: Carne de porco moída e muitos outros acompanhamentos. / É, nunca comi um em lugar nenhum tão delicioso quanto o da minha mãe. / Quem dera eu fosse sua mãe.

transcript.text: You can be! / Why do you want to be his mom? / His mom seems like a really good cook.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ペン・ダイ・ナ・タムマイ・ヤーク・ペン・メー・カオ・ラ・クン・メー・カオ・ドゥー・タム・アーハーン・ケン・マーク
transcript.pronunciation_roman: You can be ! / Why do you want to be his mom ? / His mom seems like a really good cook .

translations.ja: なってもいいよ！／なんでお母さんになりたいの？／お母さん、すごく料理上手そうだからさ。
translations.en: You can be! / Why do you want to be his mom? / His mom seems like a really good cook.
translations.ko: 그럴 수 있어요! / 왜 그의 엄마가 되고 싶어 하는 거야? / 그의 엄마는 요리를 정말 잘하시는 것 같아요.
translations.zh-TW: 你可以當啊！／你幹嘛想當他媽？／他媽好像很會煮飯。
translations.id: Kamu bisa jadi! / Kenapa kamu ingin jadi ibunya? / Ibunya tampaknya jago memasak.
translations.pt: Você pode ser! / Por que você quer ser a mãe dele? / A mãe dele parece cozinhar muito bem.

transcript.text: What about you? Where is he going? / Me? I really like fried pork patties and rice porridge. / Fried pork patties? / Yeah, rice porridge is easy to eat. It's nice for a late breakfast.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: レオ・ナーイ・ラ・チャ・パイ・ナイ・ニアン・ポム・ルー・チョープ・ムー・トート・ゴーン・カップ・カオ・トム・マーク・ムー・トート・ゴーン・ルー・チャイ・カオ・トム・キン・ンガーイ・ディー・モ・カップ・ムー・サーイ・サーイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: What about you ? Where is he going ? / Me ? I really like fried pork patties and rice porridge . / Fried pork patties ? / Yeah , rice porridge is easy to eat . It 's nice for a late breakfast .

translations.ja: 君は？どこ行くの？／僕？僕は豚肉のつくね揚げとお粥がすごく好きなんだ。／豚肉のつくね揚げ？／うん、お粥って食べやすいし、遅めの朝ごはんにぴったりなんだよね。
translations.en: What about you? Where is he going? / Me? I really like fried pork patties and rice porridge. / Fried pork patties? / Yeah, rice porridge is easy to eat. It's nice for a late breakfast.
translations.ko: 너는 어때? 어디 가는 거야? / 나? 나는 돼지고기 완자 튀김이랑 죽을 정말 좋아해. / 돼지고기 완자 튀김? / 응, 죽은 먹기 편해서 좋아. 늦은 아침 식사로 아주 좋지.
translations.zh-TW: 你呢？他去哪了？／我？我很喜歡炸肉餅配白粥。／炸肉餅？／對啊，白粥很好入口。當作晚一點的早餐很不錯。
translations.id: Bagaimana denganmu? Mau ke mana dia? / Aku? Aku sangat suka perkedel babi goreng dan bubur nasi. / Perkedel babi goreng? / Ya, bubur nasi mudah dimakan. Enak untuk sarapan siang.
translations.pt: E você? Onde ele vai? / Eu? Gosto muito de hambúrguer de porco frito e mingau de arroz. / Hambúrguer de porco frito? / É, mingau de arroz é fácil de comer. É bom para um café da manhã tardio.

transcript.text: What about you? / It's pretty basic. I like fried chicken, but it has to have crispy skin. / That's not basic at all. It isn't? Why do you eat such a fancy meal? Crispy skinned fried chicken.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: レオ・ナーイ・ラ・タマダー・マーク・チョープ・カイ・トート・テー・トン・ナン・クロープ・ナ・マイ・タマダー・ルーイ・ナ・マイ・ルー・タムマイ・キン・ルー・ジャン・カイ・トート・ナン・クロープ・ニアン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: What about you ? / It 's pretty basic . I like fried chicken , but it has to have crispy skin . / That 's not basic at all . It isn 't? Why do you eat such a fancy meal ? Crispy skinned fried chicken .

translations.ja: 君はどう？／僕は普通だよ。フライドチキンが好きなんだけど、皮がパリパリじゃないとダメなんだ。／全然普通じゃないよ。そう？なんでそんなこだわりの料理食べるの？皮パリフライドチキンなんて。
translations.en: What about you? / It's pretty basic. I like fried chicken, but it has to have crispy skin. / That's not basic at all. It isn't? Why do you eat such a fancy meal? Crispy skinned fried chicken.
translations.ko: 너는? / 난 꽤 평범해. 치킨을 좋아하는데, 껍질이 바삭해야 해. / 전혀 평범하지 않은데. 아니라고? 왜 그렇게 화려한 걸 먹어? 바삭한 껍질의 치킨이라니.
translations.zh-TW: 你呢？／這蠻基本的。我喜歡炸雞，但皮一定要酥脆。／這根本一點都不基本。會嗎？為什麼你要吃這麼高級的餐點？酥皮炸雞。
translations.id: Bagaimana denganmu? / Cukup biasa. Aku suka ayam goreng, tapi kulitnya harus krispi. / Itu sama sekali tidak biasa. Bukan begitu? Kenapa kamu makan makanan yang begitu mewah? Ayam goreng kulit krispi.
translations.pt: E você? / É bem básico. Gosto de frango frito, mas tem que ter a pele crocante. / Isso não é básico de jeito nenhum. Não é? Por que você come uma comida tão chique? Frango frito com pele crocante.

transcript.text: There's this recipe where the chicken wing skin is really crispy, but the meat inside is still juicy. / That's a Hong Kong recipe. Your mom is from Hong Kong!
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ミー・スート・ティー・ナン・ピーク・カイ・クロープ・マーク・テー・ヌア・カーン・ナイ・ヤン・チャム・ユー・ナン・マン・スート・ホンコン・ニー・メー・ナーイ・マー・チャーク・ホンコン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: There 's this recipe where the chicken wing skin is really crispy , but the meat inside is still juicy . / That 's a Hong Kong recipe . Your mom is from Hong Kong !

translations.ja: 手羽先の皮がすごくパリパリで、中のお肉はジューシーなレシピがあるんだ。／それ香港のレシピじゃん。君のお母さん香港出身だしね！
translations.en: There's this recipe where the chicken wing skin is really crispy, but the meat inside is still juicy. / That's a Hong Kong recipe. Your mom is from Hong Kong!
translations.ko: 닭날개 껍질은 엄청 바삭한데 안의 고기는 여전히 촉촉한 그런 레시피가 있거든. / 홍콩 레시피네. 너희 엄마 홍콩 분이시구나!
translations.zh-TW: 有一個食譜做出來的雞翅皮超脆，但裡面的肉還是很多汁。／那是香港食譜。你媽是香港人！
translations.id: Ada resep ini di mana kulit sayap ayamnya sangat krispi, tapi daging di dalamnya tetap berair. / Itu resep Hong Kong. Ibumu berasal dari Hong Kong!
translations.pt: Tem essa receita em que a pele da asa de frango fica bem crocante, mas a carne por dentro ainda continua suculenta. / Essa é uma receita de Hong Kong. Sua mãe é de Hong Kong!

transcript.text: She's actually from Samut Prakan. What about you? Are there any dishes you miss? We finished it! Why are you the first one to finish your rice? I still have so much left.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ジン・ジン・ケー・ユー・サムット・プラーカーン・コー・レー・コン・ウーン・ラー・ミー・アーハーン・ティー・キットトゥン・マイ・モット・レーウ・タンマイ・ギン・モット・コン・ラーイ・チャン・ヤン・ルー・イエ・ルーイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: She 's actually from Samut Prakan . What about you ? Are there any dishes you miss ? We finished it ! Why are you the first one to finish your rice ? I still have so much left .

translations.ja: 本当はサムットプラーカーン（※バンコク隣接の県）出身なんだよ。君はどう？思い出す恋しい料理はある？あっ、食べ終わっちゃった！なんで一番最初に食べ終わってるの？僕はまだこんなに残ってるのに。
translations.en: She's actually from Samut Prakan. What about you? Are there any dishes you miss? We finished it! Why are you the first one to finish your rice? I still have so much left.
translations.ko: 사실 사뭇프라칸 분이셔. 너는? 그리운 음식 있어? 우리 다 먹었는데! 너는 왜 벌써 밥을 다 먹었어? 나는 아직 많이 남았는데.
translations.zh-TW: 她其實是北欖府人。你呢？有什麼想念的菜嗎？我們吃完了！為什麼你第一個吃完飯？我還剩一大堆。
translations.id: Dia sebenarnya berasal dari Samut Prakan. Bagaimana denganmu? Ada hidangan yang dirindukan? Kita sudah menghabiskannya! Kenapa kamu orang pertama yang menghabiskan nasi? Milikku masih banyak.
translations.pt: Ela é de Samut Prakan na verdade. E você? Há algum prato de que sinta falta? Terminamos! Por que você é o primeiro a terminar seu arroz? Ainda tenho muito sobrando.

transcript.text: My mom doesn't cook. / Really? / Oh, when I was a kid, my mom used to make baked chicken with tomatoes. It's made with a tomato sauce base.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: メー・チャン・マイ・タム・アーハーン・ジン・ルー・コー・トーン・デック・メー・コー・タム・ガイ・オップ・ソース・マクアテーッ・タム・ジャーク・ソース・マクアテーッ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: My mom doesn 't cook . / Really ? / Oh , when I was a kid , my mom used to make baked chicken with tomatoes . It 's made with a tomato sauce base .

translations.ja: 僕のお母さんは料理しないんだ。 / 本当に？ / あ、子供のころ、お母さんがトマトソース煮込みのチキン（※ガイオップソースマクアテーッ）を作ってくれたな。トマトソースベースのやつ。
translations.en: My mom doesn't cook. / Really? / Oh, when I was a kid, my mom used to make baked chicken with tomatoes. It's made with a tomato sauce base.
translations.ko: 우리 엄마는 요리를 안 해. / 진짜? / 아, 어렸을 때 엄마가 토마토를 넣고 닭고기를 구워주셨어. 토마토 소스를 베이스로 만든 거야.
translations.zh-TW: 我媽不會煮飯。／真的嗎？／哦，我小時候，我媽常做番茄烤雞。那是用番茄醬當基底做的。
translations.id: Ibuku tidak bisa memasak. / Benarkah? / Oh, waktu aku kecil, ibuku biasa membuat ayam panggang tomat. Itu dibuat dengan dasar saus tomat.
translations.pt: Minha mãe não cozinha. / Sério? / Ah, quando eu era criança, minha mãe costumava fazer frango assado com tomates. É feito com uma base de molho de tomate.

transcript.text: I remember going to your house and your family made... / Ah, it was salmon. My aunt made it. She loves cooking, especially when guests come over. She buys river prawns and salmon to serve the guests.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: チャン・ジャン・ダーイ・ワー・ケー・パイ・バーン・ナ・ア・サーモン・パー・タム・パー・チョープ・タム・アーハーン・マーク・ウェラー・ミー・ケーク・マー・クー・スー・クン・メーナム・ガップ・サーモン・マー・レアン・ケーク
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I remember going to your house and your family made ... / Ah , it was salmon . My aunt made it . She loves cooking , especially when guests come over . She buys river prawns and salmon to serve the guests .

translations.ja: 君の家に行ったとき、ご家族が作ってくれたのを覚えてるよ… / ああ、サーモンだね。伯母さんが作ったんだ。伯母さんは料理が大好きで、特にお客さんが来るときは川エビやサーモンを買っておもてなしするんだ。
translations.en: I remember going to your house and your family made... / Ah, it was salmon. My aunt made it. She loves cooking, especially when guests come over. She buys river prawns and salmon to serve the guests.
translations.ko: 너희 집에 갔을 때 너희 가족이 만들어준 게 기억나는데... / 아, 연어였어. 고모가 만드셨지. 손님들 오실 때 요리하는 걸 정말 좋아하시거든. 손님들 대접하려고 강새우랑 연어를 사 오시더라고.
translations.zh-TW: 我記得我去你家時，你們家做了……／啊，那是鮭魚。我阿姨做的。她很喜歡煮飯，特別是有客人來的時候。她會買河蝦和鮭魚來招待客人。
translations.id: Aku ingat pergi ke rumahmu dan keluargamu membuat... / Ah, itu salmon. Bibiku yang membuatnya. Dia suka memasak, terutama saat ada tamu datang. Dia membeli udang sungai dan salmon untuk disajikan kepada tamu.
translations.pt: Lembro de ir à sua casa e sua família fez... / Ah, era salmão. Minha tia fez. Ela adora cozinhar, especialmente quando os convidados vêm. Ela compra camarões de água doce e salmão para servir aos convidados.

transcript.text: It was really good. / What dish was that again? The baked chicken with tomato sauce! / What made it so good? How is it better than the ones from other places? It's basically baked chicken in red sauce.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: アロイ・マーク・ルーイ・アーハーン・アラライ・ナ・ガイ・オップ・ソース・マクアテーッ・タンマイ・アロイ・タンマイ・ディー・クワー・ティー・ウーン・コー・クー・ガイ・オップ・ソース・デーン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: It was really good . / What dish was that again ? The baked chicken with tomato sauce ! / What made it so good ? How is it better than the ones from other places ? It 's basically baked chicken in red sauce .

translations.ja: すごく美味しかったよ。 / それ何だっけ？トマトソースのチキン煮込み！ / 何がそんなに美味しかったの？他のお店のと何が違うの？要はレッドソースのチキン煮込みでしょ。
translations.en: It was really good. / What dish was that again? The baked chicken with tomato sauce! / What made it so good? How is it better than the ones from other places? It's basically baked chicken in red sauce.
translations.ko: 정말 맛있었어. / 그 요리가 뭐였더라? 토마토소스 치킨 구이! / 뭐가 그렇게 맛있었어? 다른 데서 파는 거랑 뭐가 달라서? 그냥 빨간 소스에 구운 닭고기잖아.
translations.zh-TW: 真的很好吃。／那是什麼菜來著？番茄醬烤雞！／到底為什麼那麼好吃？怎麼會比其他地方賣的還好吃？基本上就是紅醬烤雞啊。
translations.id: Itu sangat enak. / Hidangan apa itu tadi? Ayam panggang dengan saus tomat! / Apa yang membuatnya begitu enak? Bagaimana itu lebih baik daripada dari tempat lain? Itu pada dasarnya ayam panggang bersaus merah.
translations.pt: Estava muito bom. / Que prato era esse mesmo? O frango assado com molho de tomate! / O que o tornava tão bom? Como ele é melhor do que os de outros lugares? É basicamente frango assado em molho vermelho.

transcript.text: I've never had it this delicious anywhere else. It's sweet, creamy, smooth, and the meat is so tender it falls off the bone.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: マイ・ケーイ・ギン・ティー・ナイ・アロイ・ケー・ニー・ルーイ・ワーン・マン・ラーモン・レー・ヌア・プア・ルット・ジャーク・グラドゥーク
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I 've never had it this delicious anywhere else . It 's sweet , creamy , smooth , and the meat is so tender it falls off the bone .

translations.ja: 他ではこんなに美味しいの食べたことないよ。甘みとコクがあって滑らかで、お肉が骨からほろっと外れるくらい柔らかいんだ。
translations.en: I've never had it this delicious anywhere else. It's sweet, creamy, smooth, and the meat is so tender it falls off the bone.
translations.ko: 다른 데선 절대 이렇게 맛있는 걸 먹어본 적이 없어. 달콤하고, 크리미하고, 부드럽고, 고기가 뼈에서 스르륵 발라질 정도로 엄청 연해.
translations.zh-TW: 我在其他地方從沒吃過這麼好吃的。它很甜、很濃郁、很滑順，而且肉嫩到骨頭都要脫落了。
translations.id: Aku belum pernah makan yang seenak ini di tempat lain. Rasanya manis, kental, lembut, dan dagingnya sangat empuk hingga lepas dari tulangnya.
translations.pt: Nunca comi tão delicioso em nenhum outro lugar. É doce, cremoso, macio e a carne é tão macia que se solta do osso.

transcript.text: What meat? / My meat.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ヌア・アライ・ヌア・チャン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: What meat ? / My meat .

translations.ja: 何のお肉？ / 僕のお肉。
translations.en: What meat? / My meat.
translations.ko: 어떤 고기? / 내 살코기.
translations.zh-TW: 什麼肉？／我的肉。
translations.id: Daging apa? / Dagingku.
translations.pt: Que carne? / Minha carne.

transcript.text: Is there any dish your family makes that you don't like, even though they make it often? / I don't like Palo because the eggs aren't dark enough from the dark soy sauce. They don't let the sauce soak in, they just eat it.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ミー・アーハーン・ティー・バーン・タム・ボイ・テー・マイ・チョープ・マイ・マイ・チョープ・カイ・パロー・プロ・カイ・マイ・ダム・シーユー・ダム・マイ・スアム・ソース・ギン・ルーイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Is there any dish your family makes that you don 't like , even though they make it often ? / I don 't like Palo because the eggs aren 't dark enough from the dark soy sauce . They don 't let the sauce soak in , they just eat it .

translations.ja: 実家でよく作るけど、あんまり好きじゃない料理ってある？ / 僕カイ・パロー（※タイ風煮込み卵料理）が苦手なんだ。醤油の味が卵に染み込んで黒くなってなくて、煮込まずすぐ食べちゃうから。
translations.en: Is there any dish your family makes that you don't like, even though they make it often? / I don't like Palo because the eggs aren't dark enough from the dark soy sauce. They don't let the sauce soak in, they just eat it.
translations.ko: 가족들이 자주 만들어주는데도 별로 안 좋아하는 음식이 있나요? / 난 팔로(태국식 오향장육 족발/달걀 조림)를 별로 안 좋아해요. 간장 색이 달걀에 까맣게 배어들지 않아서요. 소스가 스며들게 두지도 않고 그냥 바로 먹어버리거든요.
translations.zh-TW: 你們家有沒有哪道菜是你明明常常吃卻很不喜歡的？／我不喜歡滷肉，因為用老抽上色的蛋顏色不夠深。他們沒有讓醬汁入味，直接就拿來吃了。
translations.id: Apakah ada hidangan buatan keluargamu yang tidak kamu sukai, meskipun mereka sering membuatnya? / Aku tidak suka telur kecap (Palo) karena telurnya tidak cukup gelap dari kecap manis. Mereka tidak membiarkan sausnya meresap, mereka langsung memakannya.
translations.pt: Há algum prato que sua família faz de que você não gosta, mesmo que eles façam com frequência? / Não gosto de Palo porque os ovos não estão escuros o suficiente com o molho de soja escuro. Eles não deixam o molho penetrar, apenas comem.

transcript.text: So you're really sad? You sound really sad that your family's Palo isn't soaked into the egg. / I am sad. Do you understand that they have to let the sauce soak into it?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: スー・セーウ・マーク・ルーイ・ドゥー・セーウ・ティー・カイ・パロー・マイ・スアム・ソース・セーウ・シ・カーオジャイ・マイ・ワー・トン・ハイ・ソース・スアム・コー・パイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: So you 're really sad ? You sound really sad that your family 's Palo isn 't soaked into the egg . / I am sad . Do you understand that they have to let the sauce soak into it ?

translations.ja: すごく悲しいんだね？実家のカイ・パローの味が卵に染み込んでないのが本当にショックそうな声してるよ。 / ショックなんだよ。味がしっかり染み込むまで煮込まないといけないの分かってくれる？
translations.en: So you're really sad? You sound really sad that your family's Palo isn't soaked into the egg. / I am sad. Do you understand that they have to let the sauce soak into it?
translations.ko: 그럼 엄청 속상하겠네? 가족들이 만든 팔로가 달걀에 안 배어들어서 엄청 서운한 목소리야. / 서운해요. 소스가 푹 배어들게 해야 하는 거 이해하시죠?
translations.zh-TW: 所以你覺得很難過？聽起來你對你們家滷蛋沒滷進去這件事感到很難過。／我很難過。你們懂不懂他們應該要把醬汁滷進去啊？
translations.id: Jadi kamu sangat sedih? Suaramu terdengar sangat sedih karena telur kecap keluargamu tidak meresap ke dalam telur. / Aku sedih. Apakah kalian mengerti bahwa mereka harus membiarkan sausnya meresap ke dalamnya?
translations.pt: Então você está muito triste? Você parece muito triste porque o Palo da sua família não penetrou no ovo. / Estou triste. Você entende que eles têm que deixar o molho penetrar nele?

transcript.text: But when my family makes it, we have to eat it right away. The egg whites are still white and haven't turned dark yet, so I don't like it.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: テー・ウェラー・バーン・チャン・タム・トン・ギン・タンティー・カイ・カーオ・ヤン・カーオ・ユー・マイ・ペロン・シー・ダム・ルーイ・マイ・チョープ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: But when my family makes it , we have to eat it right away . The egg whites are still white and haven 't turned dark yet , so I don 't like it .

translations.ja: でも僕の家で作るときは、すぐ食べなきゃいけないんだ。白身がまだ真っ白で黒くなってないから好きじゃないんだよ。
translations.en: But when my family makes it, we have to eat it right away. The egg whites are still white and haven't turned dark yet, so I don't like it.
translations.ko: 근데 우리 가족이 만들면 바로 먹어야 해요. 흰자가 아직도 하얗고 까맣게 안 변해 있어서 난 별로더라고요.
translations.zh-TW: 但我們家做的時候，都得馬上吃。蛋白還是白色的，還沒變黑，所以我不喜歡。
translations.id: Tapi saat keluargamu membuatnya, kita harus langsung memakannya. Putih telurnya masih putih dan belum menjadi gelap, jadi aku tidak suka.
translations.pt: Mas quando minha família faz, temos que comer imediatamente. As claras dos ovos ainda estão brancas e ainda não escureceram, então eu não gosto.

transcript.text: But you haven't hit your mom yet, right? / No, no. But we did have a little argument.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: テー・マイ・ダーイ・ティ・メー・チャイ・マイ・マイ・マイ・テー・コー・ミー・タロー・ガン・ニッノイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: But you haven 't hit your mom yet , right ? / No , no . But we did have a little argument .

translations.ja: でもお母さんに手を出したりはしてないでしょ？ / 出してない、出してない！でもちょっと口喧嘩にはなったけどね。
translations.en: But you haven't hit your mom yet, right? / No, no. But we did have a little argument.
translations.ko: 그래도 엄마를 때리진 않았지? / 아니요, 아니요. 근데 말다툼은 좀 했어요.
translations.zh-TW: 不過你還沒揍你媽吧？／沒有沒有。但我們確實小吵了一架。
translations.id: Tapi kamu belum memukul ibumu, kan? / Tidak, tidak. Tapi kami sempat sedikit berdebat.
translations.pt: Mas você ainda não bateu na sua mãe, né? / Não, não. Mas tivemos uma pequena discussão.

transcript.text: And you? What's a dish your family makes that you don't really like? / I'm not sure what you call it, but it's salty fried chicken. / The Chinese New Year dish. I love it, why don't you like it? How can you not like it?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: レー・ケー・ラー・アーハーン・ティー・バーン・タム・テー・マイ・コーイ・チョープ・クー・アラライ・マイ・ルー・リーアク・アラライ・テー・クー・ガイ・トート・ケム・アーハーン・トルットジーン・チョープ・マーク・タンマイ・マイ・チョープ・マイ・チョープ・ダーイ・ヤンライ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: And you ? What 's a dish your family makes that you don 't really like ? / I 'm not sure what you call it , but it 's salty fried chicken . / The Chinese New Year dish . I love it , why don 't you like it ? How can you not like it ?

translations.ja: 君は？実家で作るけどあまり好きじゃない料理はある？ / 何て呼ぶのか分からないけど、鶏肉の塩揚げ（※春節によく食べる料理）なんだ。 / 春節の料理ね！僕大好きなのに、なんで嫌いなの？嫌いになれる要素ある？
translations.en: And you? What's a dish your family makes that you don't really like? / I'm not sure what you call it, but it's salty fried chicken. / The Chinese New Year dish. I love it, why don't you like it? How can you not like it?
translations.ko: 너는? 가족들이 만들지만 별로 안 좋아하는 음식은 뭐야? / 뭐라고 부르는지 잘 모르겠는데, 짭조름한 닭튀김이요. / 춘절에 먹는 요리잖아. 난 그거 엄청 좋아하는데, 넌 왜 안 좋아해? 어떻게 이걸 안 좋아할 수가 있어?
translations.zh-TW: 那你呢？你們家做的菜裡有哪一道是你不太喜歡的？／我不知道那叫什麼，但那是鹹炸雞。／農曆新年的那道菜。我很喜歡啊，你怎麼會不喜歡？怎麼會有人不喜歡？
translations.id: Dan kamu? Apa hidangan buatan keluargamu yang tidak begitu kamu sukai? / Aku tidak tahu apa namanya, tapi itu ayam goreng asin. / Hidangan Tahun Baru Imlek. Aku menyukainya, kenapa kamu tidak suka? Bagaimana mungkin kamu tidak suka?
translations.pt: E você? Qual é um prato que sua família faz de que você não gosta muito? / Não tenho certeza de como você chama, mas é frango frito salgado. / O prato de Ano Novo Chinês. Eu adoro, por que você não gosta? Como você pode não gostar?

transcript.text: The meat is still on the bones, and we have to gnaw on the bones to get the meat off, so it's a little difficult to eat. / You don't want to gnaw on the bones? It's not exactly an easy to eat dish. / Yes.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ヌア・ヤン・ティット・グラドゥーク・トン・キャー・グラドゥーク・ギン・ヤーク・ニッノイ・マイ・ヤーック・キャー・グラドゥーク・マイ・チャイ・アーハーン・ギン・ガーイ・チャイ・クラップ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: The meat is still on the bones , and we have to gnaw on the bones to get the meat off , so it 's a little difficult to eat . / You don 't want to gnaw on the bones ? It 's not exactly an easy to eat dish . / Yes .

translations.ja: 骨にお肉がついてて、骨をかじりながら食べなきゃいけないから、ちょっと食べるのが面倒なんだ。 / 骨をかじるのが嫌なの？まあ手軽に食べられる料理ではないよね。 / はい、クラップ（その通りです）。
translations.en: The meat is still on the bones, and we have to gnaw on the bones to get the meat off, so it's a little difficult to eat. / You don't want to gnaw on the bones? It's not exactly an easy to eat dish. / Yes.
translations.ko: 고기가 뼈에 붙어 있어서 살을 발라먹으려면 뼈를 갉아먹어야 해서 먹기가 좀 힘들어요. / 뼈를 갉아먹기 싫다고? 먹기 편한 요리는 아니지. / 맞아요.
translations.zh-TW: 肉還黏在骨頭上，我們得啃骨頭才能把肉吃下來，所以有點難吃。／你不想啃骨頭？這確實不是一道好入口的菜。／對啊。
translations.id: Dagingnya masih menempel di tulang, dan kita harus menggigiti tulangnya untuk melepaskan dagingnya, jadi agak sulit dimakan. / Kamu tidak mau menggigiti tulangnya? Itu bukan hidangan yang mudah dimakan. / Ya.
translations.pt: A carne ainda está nos ossos, e temos que roer os ossos para tirar a carne, então é um pouco difícil de comer. / Você não quer roer os ossos? Não é exatamente um prato fácil de comer. / É.

transcript.text: Guys, we've eaten everything and we're not even halfway through the episode yet. / We're not even halfway? / We've still got a long way to go. How many hours is one episode? / Right now, we're looking for something else to add to the dish. We've finished all the fish, and we don't want to waste the dressing.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: トゥック・コン・ギン・モット・レーウ・ヤン・マイ・トゥン・クルン・イーピー・ルーイ・ヤン・マイ・トゥン・クルン・ヤン・イーック・カイ・ケー・ネー・イーピー・ヌン・ギー・チャーモン・トーン・ニー・ハー・アラライ・マ・サーイ・ペーム・ギン・プラ・モット・レーウ・マイ・ヤーック・シヤー・ドラーッシング
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Guys , we 've eaten everything and we 're not even halfway through the episode yet . / We 're not even halfway ? / We 've still got a long way to go . How many hours is one episode ? / Right now , we 're looking for something else to add to the dish . We 've finished all the fish , and we don 't want to waste the dressing .

translations.ja: みんな、全部食べちゃったのに、まだ番組（EP）の半分もいってないよ。 / まだ半分もいってないの？ / 先はまだまだ長いよ。1エピソード何時間あるの？ / 今、お皿に足す他のものを探してるところ。魚は全部食べちゃったけど、ドレッシングを残すのはもったいないからね。
translations.en: Guys, we've eaten everything and we're not even halfway through the episode yet. / We're not even halfway? / We've still got a long way to go. How many hours is one episode? / Right now, we're looking for something else to add to the dish. We've finished all the fish, and we don't want to waste the dressing.
translations.ko: 여러분, 우리 다 먹었는데 아직 에피소드 절반도 안 지났어요. / 아직 절반도 안 됐다고? / 아직 갈 길이 멀어요. 한 에피소드가 몇 시간짜리야? / 지금은 요리에 곁들일 다른 걸 찾고 있어요. 생선은 다 먹었는데 소스를 버리긴 아까우니까요.
translations.zh-TW: 各位，我們全吃完了，而且這一集還沒過一半。／還沒過一半？／我們還有很長的路要走。一集到底幾個小時啊？／現在我們正在找別的東西加進這道菜裡。魚都吃完了，我們不想浪費醬汁。
translations.id: Teman-teman, kita sudah makan semuanya dan episodenya bahkan belum setengah jalan. / Belum setengah jalan? / Perjalanan kita masih panjang. Berapa jam durasi satu episode? / Sekarang, kita sedang mencari sesuatu yang lain untuk ditambahkan ke hidangan ini. Kita sudah menghabiskan semua ikannya, dan kita tidak ingin menyia-nyiakan bumbu siramannya.
translations.pt: Gessoal, nós comemos tudo e nem estamos na metade do episódio. / Nem na metade? / Ainda temos um longo caminho a percorrer. Quantas horas dura um episódio? / Agora, estamos procurando outra coisa para adicionar ao prato. Terminamos todo o peixe e não queremos desperdiçar o tempero.

transcript.text: I want to know, when you guys were trainees... What? / Nothing! / When you guys were trainees, did you ever have a moment where you thought, "What am I doing here?"
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ヤーック・ルー・ウェラー・ペントン・ペーン・デック・フルック・アラライ・マイ・ミー・アラライ・ウェラー・ペントン・ペーン・デック・フルック・ミー・モーメント・ティー・キット・ワー・チーウィット・タム・アラライ・ユー・ティー・ニー・マイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I want to know , when you guys were trainees ... What ? / Nothing ! / When you guys were trainees , did you ever have a moment where you thought , "What am I doing here ?"

translations.ja: 知りたいんだけど、みんなが練習生だった頃…何？ / 何でもない！ / みんなが練習生だった頃、『僕ここで一体何やってるんだろう？』って思った瞬間はある？
translations.en: I want to know, when you guys were trainees... What? / Nothing! / When you guys were trainees, did you ever have a moment where you thought, "What am I doing here?"
translations.ko: 궁금한 게 있는데, 너희 연습생 때... 뭐? / 아무것도 아니야! / 너희 연습생 때 "내가 여기서 뭐 하고 있는 거지?"라고 생각했던 적 있어?
translations.zh-TW: 我想知道，當你們還是練習生時…… 什麼？／沒事！／當你們還是練習生時，有沒有哪一刻心想：「我到底在這裡幹嘛？」
translations.id: Aku ingin tahu, saat kalian menjadi peserta pelatihan... Apa? / Tidak ada! / Saat kalian menjadi peserta pelatihan, apakah kalian pernah mengalami momen di mana kalian berpikir, "Apa yang kulakukan di sini?"
translations.pt: Eu quero saber, quando vocês eram trainees... O quê? / Nada! / Quando vocês eram trainees, tiveram algum momento em que pensaram: "O que estou fazendo aqui?"

translations.en: Did any of you have moments like that? / I think some of us did. / You don't need to look at the other guys. You keep making eye contact and sending signals.
translations.ko: 그런 순간이 있었던 사람? / 우리 중에 몇 명은 있었던 것 같아. / 다른 멤버들 쳐다볼 필요 없어. 자꾸 눈빛 교환하면서 신호 보낸다.
translations.zh-TW: 你們有人有過這種時刻嗎？／我想我們有些人有過。／你們不需要看其他團員。你們一直眼神接觸還打暗號。
translations.id: Apakah ada di antara kalian yang mengalami momen seperti itu? / Kurasa beberapa dari kita mengalaminya. / Kalian tidak perlu melihat yang lain. Kalian terus saling bertukar pandang dan memberi sinyal.
translations.pt: Algum de vocês teve momentos assim? / Acho que alguns de nós tivemos. / Vocês não precisam olhar para os outros caras. Vocês ficam fazendo contato visual e enviando sinais.

transcript.text: Who? So who felt like that? / Me. I'm very attached to my friends, and once I became a trainee, I had to train at the GMM building every day, traveling from Rangsit to Asoke every day.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: クライ・ラーイ・クライ・キット・ベーップ・ナン・チャン・チャン・ティット・プアン・マーク・レー・ポー・ペーン・デック・フルック・トン・マー・ソーム・ティー・トゥック・ワン・ダーンターン・ジャーク・ランシット・マー・アソーク・トゥック・ワン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Who ? So who felt like that ? / Me . I 'm very attached to my friends , and once I became a trainee , I had to train at the GMM building every day , traveling from Rangsit to Asoke every day .

translations.ja: 誰？で、誰がそう思ったの？ / 僕。僕はすごく友達思いでさ、練習生になってからは毎日GMMビルで練習しなきゃいけなくて、毎日ランシット（※バンコク北部の郊外）からアソーク（※GMMグラミー本社がある中心街）まで通ってたんだ。
translations.en: Who? So who felt like that? / Me. I'm very attached to my friends, and once I became a trainee, I had to train at the GMM building every day, traveling from Rangsit to Asoke every day.
translations.ko: 누구? 그럼 누가 그랬는데? / 저요. 제가 친구들을 엄청 좋아하는데, 연습생이 된 이후로는 랑싯에서 아속까지 매일 GMM 사옥으로 출퇴근하면서 연습해야 했거든요.
translations.zh-TW: 誰？所以到底是誰有這種感覺？／我。我很黏朋友，一旦成了練習生，我必須每天去 GMM 大樓訓練，每天從蘭實通勤到阿索克。
translations.id: Siapa? Jadi siapa yang merasa seperti itu? / Aku. Aku sangat terikat dengan teman-temanku, dan begitu aku menjadi peserta pelatihan, aku harus berlatih di gedung GMM setiap hari, bepergian dari Rangsit ke Asoke setiap hari.
translations.pt: Quem? Então quem se sentiu assim? / Eu. Sou muito apegado aos meus amigos, e assim que me tornei trainee, tive que treinar no prédio da GMM todos os dias, viajando de Rangsit para Asoke todos os dias.

transcript.text: I was really tired, and I wanted to spend more time with my friends. I wanted to quit every day. I would cry at the back of the classroom every day, saying, "I'm going to quit."
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ネーイ・マーク・レー・ヤーック・ユー・ガップ・プアン・イエ・イエ・ヤーック・ラーオーク・トゥック・ワン・ロー・ハイ・ユー・ラーン・ホン・トゥック・ワン・ボーク・ワー・ジャ・ラーオーク
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I was really tired , and I wanted to spend more time with my friends . I wanted to quit every day . I would cry at the back of the classroom every day , saying , "I'm going to quit ."

translations.ja: すごく疲れてたし、友達ともっと一緒に過ごしたかった。毎日辞めたくて、毎日教室の後ろで『辞めてやる』って泣いてたんだ。
translations.en: I was really tired, and I wanted to spend more time with my friends. I wanted to quit every day. I would cry at the back of the classroom every day, saying, "I'm going to quit."
translations.ko: 정말 지쳤고 친구들이랑 더 많은 시간을 보내고 싶었어요. 매일 그만두고 싶었죠. 연습실 구석에서 매일 울면서 "나 그만둘 거야"라고 말했어요.
translations.zh-TW: 我真的很累，而且我想花更多時間陪朋友。我每天都想退團。我每天都會在教室後面哭著說：「我要退團。」
translations.id: Aku sangat lelah, dan aku ingin menghabiskan lebih banyak waktu dengan teman-temanku. Aku ingin berhenti setiap hari. Aku akan menangis di bagian belakang kelas setiap hari, sambil berkata, "Aku akan berhenti."
translations.pt: Eu estava muito cansado e queria passar mais tempo com meus amigos. Eu queria desistir todos os dias. Eu chorava no fundo da sala de aula todos os dias, dizendo: "Vou desistir."

transcript.text: Every time after rehearsal, I'd be like, "I don't want to do this anymore." / But I have to say, everyone in my group was so confused about you.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: トゥック・クラング・ラン・サオム・ジャ・ベーップ・マイ・アオ・レーウ・テー・トン・ボーク・ワー・トゥック・コン・ナイ・グルーム・スンスン・ガップ・ケー・マーク
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Every time after rehearsal , I 'd be like , "I don 't want to do this anymore ." / But I have to say , everyone in my group was so confused about you .

translations.ja: 練習が終わるたびに『もう嫌だ、やりたくない』ってなってた。 / でも正直、グループのメンバー全員君のことに困惑してたよ。
translations.en: Every time after rehearsal, I'd be like, "I don't want to do this anymore." / But I have to say, everyone in my group was so confused about you.
translations.ko: 연습이 끝날 때마다 "나 이제 이거 하기 싫어" 이랬다니까요. / 근데 제 무리 사람들은 너 때문에 정말 당황스러웠어요.
translations.zh-TW: 每次排練完，我都覺得：「我不想再做了。」／但我得說，我這組的每個人對你都超頭痛的。
translations.id: Setiap kali selesai latihan, aku seperti, "Aku tidak mau melakukan ini lagi." / Tapi harus kukatakan, semua orang di kelompokku sangat bingung denganmu.
translations.pt: Toda vez depois do ensaio, eu ficava tipo: "Não quero mais fazer isso.". / Mas tenho que dizer, todo mundo no meu grupo estava muito confuso sobre você.

transcript.text: I mean, the people in my group. We were like, "We have to send him to more classes," and once he got it, we were all so happy.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: クー・コン・ナイ・グルーム・チャン・ウー・トン・ソン・ケー・パイ・リアン・ペーム・レー・ポー・ケー・ダーイ・トゥック・コン・コー・ディー・ジャイ・マーク
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I mean , the people in my group . We were like , "We have to send him to more classes ," and once he got it , we were all so happy .

translations.ja: つまり僕のグループのみんなね。『彼をもっとレッスンに行かせなきゃ』ってなってて、彼ができるようになった時は、みんな本当に喜んでたんだよ。
translations.en: I mean, the people in my group. We were like, "We have to send him to more classes," and once he got it, we were all so happy.
translations.ko: 그러니까 제 무리 사람들이요. "쟤 수업을 더 많이 보내야겠어" 이랬는데, 막상 걔가 해내니까 우리 다 너무 기뻐했죠.
translations.zh-TW: 我是說我這組的人。我們都覺得：「我們得送他去上更多課才行」，等他學會了，大家都超開心的。
translations.id: Maksudku, orang-orang di kelompokku. Kami seperti, "Kita harus mengirimnya ke lebih banyak kelas," dan begitu dia menguasainya, kami semua sangat senang.
translations.pt: Quer dizer, as pessoas do meu grupo. Nós ficávamos tipo: "Temos que mandá-lo para mais aulas", e assim que ele entendeu, ficamos todos muito felizes.

transcript.text: Gisabelle, my friend, would always keep me updated, saying, "He got it!" and telling me to get ready to praise him! Once we saw him going to practice, we were thinking, "You can do it," and you did!
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ジサベル・プアン・コン・チャン・コー・コイ・アップデート・タロート・ワー・カオ・タム・ダイ・レオ・ナ・ハイ・トリアム・チョム・カオ・ルーイ・ポー・ラーオ・ヘン・カオ・パイ・ソーム・コー・キット・ワー・ナーイ・タム・ダイ・ナ・レオ・ナーイ・コー・タム・ダイ・ジリン・ジリン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Gisabelle , my friend , would always keep me updated , saying , "He got it !" and telling me to get ready to praise him ! Once we saw him going to practice , we were thinking , "You can do it ," and you did !

translations.ja: 友達のジサベルが「彼、できるようになったよ！褒める準備しておいて！」ってずっと報告してくれてさ。彼が練習に行くのを見て「君ならできるよ」って思ってたら、本当にやり遂げたんだよね！
translations.en: Gisabelle, my friend, would always keep me updated, saying, "He got it!" and telling me to get ready to praise him! Once we saw him going to practice, we were thinking, "You can do it," and you did!
translations.ko: 내 친구 지사벨은 늘 "해냈어!"라며 소식을 전해 주곤 했고, 그를 칭찬할 준비를 하라고 말했죠! 연습하러 가는 걸 봤을 때 우리도 "할 수 있어"라고 생각했고, 정말 해냈어요!
translations.zh-TW: 我的朋友 Gisabelle 總是隨時更新我的近況，對我說：「他做到了！」還叫我準備好稱讚他！當我們看到他去練習時，我們心想：「你辦得到的」，而你也真的辦到了！
translations.id: Gisabelle, temanku, selalu memberi kabar kepadaku, "Dia berhasil!" dan menyuruhku bersiap untuk memujinya! Begitu kami melihatnya pergi latihan, kami berpikir, "Kamu pasti bisa," dan kamu benar-benar melakukannya!
translations.pt: Gisabelle, minha amiga, sempre me mantinha atualizado, dizendo: "Ele conseguiu!" e me dizendo para me preparar para elogiá-lo! Assim que o vimos indo para o treino, pensamos: "Você consegue", e você conseguiu!

transcript.text: It's really difficult, and it takes a lot of effort. / What about you? Did you ever have a moment when you felt like this wasn't the path for you anymore?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: マン・ヤーック・マーック・ジリン・ジリン・レオ・コー・トン・サイ・コー・カーン・パヤーヤーム・マーック・レオ・ナーイ・ラー・コー・ケーイ・ミー・シュアン・ヴェーラー・ティー・ルースック・ワー・ニー・マイ・チャイ・ターン・コン・ラーオ・イーク・タイ・マイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: It 's really difficult , and it takes a lot of effort . / What about you ? Did you ever have a moment when you felt like this wasn 't the path for you anymore ?

translations.ja: 本当に難しくてすごく努力が必要だったんだ。それで、君は？これが自分の進む道じゃないかもしれないって感じた瞬間ってあった？
translations.en: It's really difficult, and it takes a lot of effort. / What about you? Did you ever have a moment when you felt like this wasn't the path for you anymore?
translations.ko: 정말 어렵고 엄청난 노력이 필요하죠. / 당신은요? 이 길이 더 이상 내 길이 아니라고 느낀 순간이 있었나요?
translations.zh-TW: 這真的很困難，需要付出很大的努力。／那你呢？你曾有過覺得這條路不再適合你的時刻嗎？
translations.id: Itu sangat sulit, dan butuh banyak usaha. / Bagaimana denganmu? Apakah kamu pernah merasa seperti ini bukan lagi jalur yang tepat untukmu?
translations.pt: É realmente difícil e exige muito esforço. / E você? Você já teve algum momento em que sentiu que este não era mais o seu caminho?

transcript.text: I did, when we started the final member round. Palm was already here. / Did they tell you there were going to be five members in the debut group?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ケーイ・シ・トーン・ティー・ラーオ・レーム・ラーン・ファイナル・メンバー・パーム・コー・ユー・ティー・ニー・レオ・カオ・ダイ・ボーク・マイ・ワー・キャー・ミー・ハァー・コン・ナイ・ウォン・デビュー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I did , when we started the final member round . Palm was already here . / Did they tell you there were going to be five members in the debut group ?

translations.ja: あったよ、ファイナルメンバーの選考が始まった時ね。パームはもうここにいたんだ。デビューグループは5人だって言われてた？
translations.en: I did, when we started the final member round. Palm was already here. / Did they tell you there were going to be five members in the debut group?
translations.ko: 있었어요, 최종 멤버 선발전을 시작했을 때요. 팜은 이미 여기에 와 있었죠. / 데뷔 조가 5명이라고 들었었나요?
translations.zh-TW: 我有過，在我們開始最後成員篩選的時候。Palm 已經在這裡了。／他們有告訴過你出道組會有五位成員嗎？
translations.id: Pernah, saat kami memulai babak anggota terakhir. Palm sudah ada di sini. / Apakah mereka memberi tahu kalian bahwa akan ada lima anggota di grup debut?
translations.pt: Sim, quando começamos a rodada final de membros. O Palm já estava aqui. / Eles disseram a vocês que haveria cinco membros no grupo de debut?

transcript.text: Yes, but suddenly, after practicing as a five member group, they asked us to become five plus one, and switched me out for another member. / You must have been shocked.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: チャイ・クラップ・テー・ユー・ユー・ポー・ソーム・カン・ハァー・コン・カオ・コー・ハイ・ラーオ・グライ・ペン・ハァー・ボーグ・ヌン・レオ・コー・スラップ・チャン・オーク・カブ・メンバー・コン・ウーン・トックジャイ・ルーイ・シ・ナ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Yes , but suddenly , after practicing as a five member group , they asked us to become five plus one , and switched me out for another member . / You must have been shocked .

translations.ja: はい、でも5人で練習した後に突然「5プラス1」にしようって言われて、僕を別のメンバーと入れ替えたんです。ショックだったでしょう。
translations.en: Yes, but suddenly, after practicing as a five member group, they asked us to become five plus one, and switched me out for another member. / You must have been shocked.
translations.ko: 네, 그런데 갑자기 5인 조로 연습을 하다가 5플러스 1로 바꾸겠다고 하더니 저를 다른 멤버로 교체했어요. / 충격이었겠어요.
translations.zh-TW: 有，但突然間，在以五人團體練習之後，他們要求我們變成五加一人體制，然後把我換成了另一位成員。／你當時一定很震驚。
translations.id: Ya, tapi tiba-tiba, setelah berlatih sebagai grup beranggotakan lima orang, mereka meminta kami menjadi lima ditambah satu, dan menukar posisiku dengan anggota lain. / Kamu pasti kaget.
translations.pt: Sim, mas de repente, depois de treinar como um grupo de cinco membros, eles nos pediram para virar cinco mais um e me trocaram por outro membro. / Você deve ter ficado chocado.

transcript.text: Yeah, it was unsettling every time I got switched out. When we saw the other member dancing, I was really upset, but I knew I'd done my best.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: チャイ・クラップ・マン・ルースック・マイ・モーン・コン・トゥック・クラング・ティー・ドゥーン・スラップ・オーク・ポー・ラーオ・ヘン・メンバー・コン・ウーン・テン・チャン・コー・ルースック・セーイ・ジャイ・テー・コー・ルー・ワー・チャン・タム・ディー・ティースット・レオ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Yeah , it was unsettling every time I got switched out . When we saw the other member dancing , I was really upset , but I knew I 'd done my best .

translations.ja: うん、入れ替えられるたびにすごく不安でした。他のメンバーが踊っているのを見た時、すごくショックだったけど、自分は全力を尽くしたって分かってました。
translations.en: Yeah, it was unsettling every time I got switched out. When we saw the other member dancing, I was really upset, but I knew I'd done my best.
translations.ko: 네, 교체될 때마다 불안했어요. 다른 멤버가 춤추는 걸 봤을 때 정말 속상했지만, 최선을 다했다는 건 알고 있었어요.
translations.zh-TW: 對啊，每次我被換掉時都感到心神不寧。當我們看到另一位成員在跳舞時，我真的很難過，但我知道我已經盡力了。
translations.id: Ya, rasanya tidak nyaman setiap kali aku digantikan. Saat kami melihat anggota lain menari, aku sangat kesal, tapi aku tahu aku sudah melakukan yang terbaik.
translations.pt: Sim, era perturbador toda vez que eu era trocado. Quando vimos o outro membro dançando, fiquei muito chateado, mas sabia que tinha feito o meu melhor.

transcript.text: Looking at my other four members and the younger member, I felt like the group was better without me. / Oh! / That's how I felt.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ポー・モーン・ドゥー・メンバー・イーク・シー・コン・カブ・ノン・イーク・コン・チャン・ルースック・ワー・ウォン・ニー・ミー・カオ・コー・ディー・クワー・ミー・チャン・オー・ルースック・バッブ・ナン・ルーイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Looking at my other four members and the younger member , I felt like the group was better without me . / Oh ! / That 's how I felt .

translations.ja: 他のメンバー4人とノンを見て、僕がいない方がこのグループにとって良いんじゃないかって思っちゃって。あら！そんな風に思ってたんだ。
translations.en: Looking at my other four members and the younger member, I felt like the group was better without me. / Oh! / That's how I felt.
translations.ko: 다른 네 명의 멤버와 어린 멤버를 보니, 내가 없는 편이 그룹에 더 낫겠다는 생각이 들었어요. / 오! / 그렇게 느꼈죠.
translations.zh-TW: 看著其他四位成員還有年紀較小的成員，我覺得沒有我的團體會更好。／噢！／我當時是這麼想的。
translations.id: Melihat keempat anggota lainnya dan anggota yang lebih muda, aku merasa grup ini lebih baik tanpa aku. / Oh! / Begitulah yang aku rasakan.
translations.pt: Olhando para os meus outros quatro membros e para o membro mais jovem, senti que o grupo estava melhor sem mim. / Oh! / Foi isso que eu senti.

transcript.text: I put a lot of pressure on myself, and it made me question whether it was actually good for me to be there. / But it was really heartbreaking seeing Pluggy back then.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: チャン・ゴッダン・タムエーング・マーック・タムハイ・チャン・タンカムターム・ワー・チャン・ユー・ティー・ニー・マン・ディー・ジリン・ジリン・ルー・プラオ・テー・トーン・ナン・ヘン・プラッギー・レオ・サトゥアンジャイ・マーック・ルーイ・ナ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I put a lot of pressure on myself , and it made me question whether it was actually good for me to be there . / But it was really heartbreaking seeing Pluggy back then .

translations.ja: 自分にすごくプレッシャーをかけていて、ここに僕がいることが本当に良いことなのか疑問に思っちゃって。でも当時プラッギーを見ていて、本当に胸が痛んだよ。
translations.en: I put a lot of pressure on myself, and it made me question whether it was actually good for me to be there. / But it was really heartbreaking seeing Pluggy back then.
translations.ko: 스스로에게 압박을 많이 주었고, 내가 그 자리에 있는 게 정말 도움이 되는지 의문이 들었어요. / 하지만 그때 플러기가 다시 들어온 걸 보는 건 정말 가슴 아팠어요.
translations.zh-TW: 我給自己施加了很大的壓力，這讓我質疑自己待在那裡到底是不是件好事。／但當時看到 Pluggy 那樣，真的讓人很心碎。
translations.id: Aku memberi banyak tekanan pada diriku sendiri, dan itu membuatku mempertanyakan apakah berada di sana benar-benar hal yang baik untukku. / Tapi sangat menyedihkan melihat Pluggy saat itu.
translations.pt: Eu coloquei muita pressão sobre mim mesmo e isso me fez questionar se realmente era bom para mim estar lá. / Mas foi muito de cortar o coração ver o Pluggy naquela época.

transcript.text: He was the only one who kept getting switched in and out. / Why was that? Have you ever thought maybe it was because you stood out so much, and they switched you out to see what the group would be like without you?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: カオ・ペン・コン・ディアウ・ティー・ドゥーン・スラップ・カウ・スラップ・オーク・タロート・タムマイ・ラー・ケーイ・キット・マイ・ワー・アージ・ジャ・プロ・ナーイ・ドードデン・マーック・カオ・レーイ・ロン・スラップ・オーク・ドゥー・ワー・タイ・マイ・ミー・ナーイ・ウォン・ジャ・ペン・ヤンガイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: He was the only one who kept getting switched in and out . / Why was that ? Have you ever thought maybe it was because you stood out so much , and they switched you out to see what the group would be like without you ?

translations.ja: 彼だけが何度も入れ替えられていたんだ。どうしてだろうね？君が目立ちすぎていたから、君がいない状態でグループがどうなるか試すために入れ替えられたのかもって考えたことはある？
translations.en: He was the only one who kept getting switched in and out. / Why was that? Have you ever thought maybe it was because you stood out so much, and they switched you out to see what the group would be like without you?
translations.ko: 계속 교체되던 건 그뿐이었거든요. / 왜 그랬을까요? 혹시 당신이 너무 돋보여서, 내가 없으면 그룹이 어떨지 보려고 빼본 건 아닐까 생각해 본 적 있나요?
translations.zh-TW: 他是唯一一個不斷被換上換下的人。／為什麼會這樣？你有沒有想過，也許是因為你太出風頭了，所以他們把你換掉，看看沒有你的團體會是什麼樣子？
translations.id: Dia adalah satu-satunya yang terus-menerus masuk dan keluar daftar anggota. / Mengapa begitu? Pernahkah kamu berpikir mungkin itu karena kamu begitu menonjol, dan mereka mengganti posisimu untuk melihat seperti apa grup ini tanpa kamu?
translations.pt: Ele era o único que continuava entrando e saindo. / Por que isso? Você já pensou que talvez fosse porque você se destacava tanto, e eles te tiravam para ver como seria o grupo sem você?

transcript.text: Wow, that's such a positive way of looking at it. / Back then, I never looked at it that way. / Imagine if you were the producer. You might have done the same thing if you came across a talented kid.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ワオ・ナン・ペン・コールン・モーン・ナイ・エーン・ボーグ・マーック・ルーイ・トーン・ナン・チャン・マイ・ケーイ・モーン・バッブ・ナン・ルーイ・ロン・ジントナーカーン・ワー・ナーイ・ペン・プロデューサー・シ・ナーイ・コー・アージ・ジャ・タム・バッブ・ディアウ・カン・タイ・ボーブ・デック・ティー・ミー・フィーミー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Wow , that 's such a positive way of looking at it . / Back then , I never looked at it that way . / Imagine if you were the producer . You might have done the same thing if you came across a talented kid .

translations.ja: わあ、それすごくポジティブな考え方だね！当時はそんな風に考えたこと一度もなかったよ。自分がプロデューサーだったらって想像してみてよ。才能のある子に出会ったら同じことするかもしれないでしょ。
translations.en: Wow, that's such a positive way of looking at it. / Back then, I never looked at it that way. / Imagine if you were the producer. You might have done the same thing if you came across a talented kid.
translations.ko: 와, 정말 긍정적인 생각이네요. / 그땐 그런 식으로 생각해보지 않았어요. / 프로듀서 입장이라고 상상해 보세요. 재능 있는 아이를 발견했다면 똑같이 했을지도 몰라요.
translations.zh-TW: 哇，這真的是個很正面的想法。／當時我從來沒這樣想過。／試想如果你是製作人，如果你遇到一個很有才華的孩子，你可能也會這麼做。
translations.id: Wah, cara pandang yang sangat positif. / Waktu itu, aku tidak pernah memandangnya seperti itu. / Bayangkan jika kamu adalah produser. Kamu mungkin akan melakukan hal yang sama jika menemukan anak yang berbakat.
translations.pt: Uau, essa é uma maneira muito positiva de ver as coisas. / Naquela época, eu nunca vi dessa forma. / Imagine se você fosse o produtor. Você poderia ter feito a mesma coisa se encontrasse um garoto talentoso.

transcript.text: You might switch that kid in and out to see what the group would be like. / Maybe I was meant to debut as a solo artist. / Yeah! You should look at it that way.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ナーイ・アージ・ジャ・スラップ・デック・コン・ナン・カウ・オーク・ドゥー・ワー・ウォン・ジャ・ペン・ヤンガイ・バーン・バーンティ・チャン・アージ・ジャ・ヒー・デビュー・ペン・シンラピン・ディアウ・コー・ダイ・チャイ・モーン・バッブ・ナン・シ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: You might switch that kid in and out to see what the group would be like . / Maybe I was meant to debut as a solo artist . / Yeah ! You should look at it that way .

translations.ja: その子を出し入れしてグループがどうなるか見極めようとするかもね。もしかしたら僕はソロアーティストとしてデビューする運命だったのかも。そうだよ！そう考えるべきだよ。
translations.en: You might switch that kid in and out to see what the group would be like. / Maybe I was meant to debut as a solo artist. / Yeah! You should look at it that way.
translations.ko: 그룹이 어떻게 될지 보려고 그 아이를 넣었다 뺐다 할 수도 있죠. / 어쩌면 난 솔로 아티스트로 데뷔할 운명이었나 봐요. / 그래요! 그런 식으로 생각해야죠.
translations.zh-TW: 你可能會把那個孩子換上換下，看看團體的表現會如何。／也許我註定要以個人歌手身分出道。／對啊！你應該這樣想。
translations.id: Kamu mungkin memasukkan dan mengeluarkan anak itu untuk melihat seperti apa grupnya nanti. / Mungkin aku ditakdirkan untuk debut sebagai artis solo. / Ya! Kamu harus melihatnya dari sudut pandang itu.
translations.pt: Você pode colocar e tirar esse garoto para ver como o grupo ficaria. / Talvez eu estivesse destinado a estrear como artista solo. / Sim! Você deveria ver por esse lado.

transcript.text: I never looked at it that way. / Deep down, you felt bad. / Yeah, I felt like I wasn't a good fit for the PERSES concept they were trying to create.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: チャン・マイ・ケーイ・モーン・バッブ・ナン・ルーイ・ルック・ルック・ラーオ・ルースック・マイ・ディー・チャイ・マイ・チャイ・クラップ・チャン・ルースック・ワー・チャン・マイ・モッソム・カブ・コンセプト・パーセス・ティー・カオ・カムラン・サーン・クン・マー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I never looked at it that way . / Deep down , you felt bad . / Yeah , I felt like I wasn 't a good fit for the PERSES concept they were trying to create .

translations.ja: 全然そんな風に思えなかったです。心の底では辛かったんだよね。はい、彼らが作ろうとしていたPERSESのコンセプトに自分が合っていない気がしていました。
translations.en: I never looked at it that way. / Deep down, you felt bad. / Yeah, I felt like I wasn't a good fit for the PERSES concept they were trying to create.
translations.ko: 전 그런 식으로 생각한 적이 없어요. / 속으로는 마음이 안 좋았군요. / 네, 만들고자 하는 PERSES의 콘셉트에 제가 잘 어울리지 않는다고 느꼈어요.
translations.zh-TW: 我從來沒這樣想過。／你內心深處其實覺得不好受。／對啊，我覺得自己不太符合他們試圖打造的 PERSES 概念。
translations.id: Aku tidak pernah melihatnya dari sudut pandang itu. / Jraf di lubuk hatimu, kamu merasa sedih. / Ya, aku merasa tidak cocok dengan konsep PERSES yang coba mereka buat.
translations.pt: Eu nunca vi por esse lado. / No fundo, você se sentiu mal. / Sim, eu senti que não me encaixava bem no conceito do PERSES que eles estavam tentando criar.

transcript.text: At the time, I just felt like I did my best and gave it my all. I came all the way from Khonkaen, and if I didn't make it through, at least I gave it my all. So I should go back to Khonkaen.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: トーン・ナン・キャー・ルースック・ワー・タム・ディー・ティースット・レオ・タム・トゥック・ヤーン・ティ・ミー・レオ・チャン・アッサダーン・マー・ジャーク・コンケン・タイ・マイ・パーン・ヤーン・ノーイ・コー・ダイ・タム・ディー・ティースット・レオ・コー・ケール・グラップ・コンケン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: At the time , I just felt like I did my best and gave it my all . I came all the way from Khonkaen , and if I didn 't make it through , at least I gave it my all . So I should go back to Khonkaen .

translations.ja: 当時はただ、ベストを尽くして全力を出し切ったって感じでした。わざわざコンケン（※タイ東北部の都市）から出てきたんだから、ダメだったとしても全力を尽くしたんだし、それならコンケンに帰ろうって。
translations.en: At the time, I just felt like I did my best and gave it my all. I came all the way from Khonkaen, and if I didn't make it through, at least I gave it my all. So I should go back to Khonkaen.
translations.ko: 당시에는 그냥 최선을 다했고 모든 걸 쏟아부었다고 느꼈어요. 콘켄에서 먼 길을 왔는데, 안 되더라도 적어도 최선은 다한 거니까 콘켄으로 돌아가야겠다고 생각했죠.
translations.zh-TW: 當時我只覺得我已經盡力了，也付出了全部。我是從孔敬一路大老遠來的，如果我沒能撐過去，至少我全力以赴了。所以我應該回孔敬去。
translations.id: Saat itu, aku hanya merasa telah melakukan yang terbaik dan mengerahkan seluruh tenagaku. Aku datang jauh-jauh dari Khonkaen, dan jika aku tidak lolos, setidaknya aku sudah berusaha semaksimal mungkin. Jadi aku harus kembali ke Khonkaen.
translations.pt: Na época, eu só achava que tinha feito o meu melhor e dado tudo de mim. Vim de muito longe, de Khonkaen, e se eu não conseguisse, pelo menos dei o meu melhor. Então eu deveria voltar para Khonkaen.

transcript.text: You just wanted to bury your face in your home soil. What did you mean when you said it was so sad to see him like that? / I was standing blocking during practice, and I saw that he was called out and replaced by another trainee.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ケー・ヤーク・グラップ・パイ・ソブ・オック・バーン・ゴード・ラー・テー・ティー・ボーク・ワー・ソンサーン・カオ・トーン・ナン・マイ・クワーイ・ティ・タイ・ラーオ・ユー・ブロックキング・トーン・ソーム・レオ・ヘン・カオ・ドゥーン・リーアク・オーク・パイ・スラップ・カブ・デック・フック・コン・ウーン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: You just wanted to bury your face in your home soil . What did you mean when you said it was so sad to see him like that ? / I was standing blocking during practice , and I saw that he was called out and replaced by another trainee .

translations.ja: 実家に帰りたかっただけなんだね。彼を見るのが辛かったってどういうこと？僕、練習中にフォーメーションについて立ってたら、彼が呼ばれて他の練習生と代わられるのを見たんだ。
translations.en: You just wanted to bury your face in your home soil. What did you mean when you said it was so sad to see him like that? / I was standing blocking during practice, and I saw that he was called out and replaced by another trainee.
translations.ko: 그냥 고향 땅에 얼굴을 파묻고 싶었던 거군요. 그가 그렇게 있는 걸 보는 게 너무 슬펐다는 건 무슨 뜻인가요? / 연습 중에 동선을 막고 서 있었는데, 그가 불려 나가 다른 연습생으로 교체되는 걸 봤거든요.
translations.zh-TW: 你當時只想把臉埋在故鄉的土地裡。你剛才說看到他那個樣子很難過是什麼意思？／我當時在練習室站位，看到他被叫出去，然後被另一個練習生取代。
translations.id: Kamu hanya ingin membenamkan wajahmu di tanah kelahirannya. Apa maksudmu saat bilang sangat sedih melihatnya seperti itu? / Aku sedang berdiri di blocking saat latihan, dan aku melihat dia dipanggil dan digantikan oleh trainee lain.
translations.pt: Você só queria enterrar seu rosto na terra da sua casa. O que você quis dizer quando disse que era tão triste vê-lo assim? / Eu estava bloqueando a visão durante o treino e vi que ele foi chamado e substituído por outro trainee.

transcript.text: When he was called and switched with another trainee, you were like, "YES!" / No! / What did you do? / A little bit inside.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ポー・カオ・ドゥーン・リーアク・スラップ・カブ・デック・フック・コン・ウーン・ナーイ・コー・バッブ・イエス・マイ・チャイ・ルーイ・ナーイ・タム・ヤンガイ・コー・ミー・ナイ・ジャイ・ニッノイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: When he was called and switched with another trainee , you were like , "YES!" / No ! / What did you do ? / A little bit inside .

translations.ja: 彼が呼ばれて別の練習生と交代させられた時、「よっしゃー！」ってなったでしょ！違いますよ！どうしたの？心の中でちょっとだけ（笑）。
translations.en: When he was called and switched with another trainee, you were like, "YES!" / No! / What did you do? / A little bit inside.
translations.ko: 그가 불려서 다른 연습생과 교체되었을 때 "만세!" 하신 건가요? / 아니요! / 어떻게 하셨는데요? / 속으로 조금은요.
translations.zh-TW: 當他被叫過去跟另一個練習生交換時，你的反應是「太棒了！」／才沒有！／那你做了什麼？／心裡有一點點……
translations.id: Saat dia dipanggil dan ditukar dengan trainee lain, reaksi kalian seperti, "YES!" / Tidak! / Apa yang kalian lakukan? / Sedikit di dalam hati.
translations.pt: Quando ele foi chamado e trocado por outro trainee, você pensou: "ISSO!" / Não! / O que você fez? / Um pouquinho por dentro.

transcript.text: I thought so! I thought so! I knew it! / I'm joking. I felt really bad for Pluggy because we always practiced together as a group of five.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: チャン・キット・レオ・チェー・ルーク・キー・ラーオ・ロー・レーン・チャン・ルースック・ソンサーン・プラッギー・マーック・プロ・ラーオ・ソーム・ドゥーアイ・カン・ペン・ウォン・ハァー・コン・タロート
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I thought so ! I thought so ! I knew it ! / I 'm joking . I felt really bad for Pluggy because we always practiced together as a group of five .

translations.ja: やっぱりね！お見通しだよ！冗談だよ。僕たちずっと5人のグループで練習してきたから、プラッギーには本当に申し訳なく思ってたよ。
translations.en: I thought so! I thought so! I knew it! / I'm joking. I felt really bad for Pluggy because we always practiced together as a group of five.
translations.ko: 그럴 줄 알았어요! 그럴 줄 알았다고요! 알았어요! / 농담이에요. 5명이서 항상 같이 연습했기 때문에 플러기가 정말 안쓰러웠어요.
translations.zh-TW: 我就知道！我就知道！我早就知道了！／開玩笑的啦。我其實替 Pluggy 感到很難過，因為我們一直都是五個人一起練習的。
translations.id: Aku tahu! Aku tahu! Aku sudah menduga itu! / Aku hanya bercanda. Aku merasa sangat kasihan pada Pluggy karena kami selalu berlatih bersama sebagai grup beranggotakan lima orang.
translations.pt: Eu achei! Eu achei! Eu sabia! / Estou brincando. Eu me senti muito mal pelo Pluggy porque sempre treinávamos juntos como um grupo de cinco.

transcript.text: Are you considered the leader of the group, or only when you guys were trainees? / Back then, I wasn't confident in myself at all. I spoke from my throat, and I felt like I could never lead anyone.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ナーイ・ドゥー・ペン・リーダー・コン・ウォン・ルー・キャー・トーン・ペン・デック・フック・トーン・ナン・チャン・マイ・ミー・コーアン・マンジャイ・ナイ・タムエーング・ルーイ・チャン・プード・ジャーク・ラムコー・レオ・コー・ルースック・ワー・チャン・マイ・サマート・ナム・クライ・ダイ・ルーイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Are you considered the leader of the group , or only when you guys were trainees ? / Back then , I wasn 't confident in myself at all . I spoke from my throat , and I felt like I could never lead anyone .

translations.ja: グループのリーダーなの？それとも練習生の時だけ？当時は自分に全く自信がなかったんです。声も絞り出すように喋ってて、誰かを引っ張っていくなんて絶対にできないと思ってました。
translations.en: Are you considered the leader of the group, or only when you guys were trainees? / Back then, I wasn't confident in myself at all. I spoke from my throat, and I felt like I could never lead anyone.
translations.ko: 그룹의 리더로 인정받나요, 아니면 연습생 때만 그랬나요? / 그때는 제 자신감에 전혀 자신이 없었어요. 목소리도 쥐어짜듯 나왔고, 누구도 이끌 수 없을 것 같았어요.
translations.zh-TW: 你們會覺得他是團體的隊長嗎？還是只有當練習生的時候才是？／當時我對自己一點自信都沒有。我說話都是從喉嚨發聲，我覺得自己根本領導不了任何人。
translations.id: Apakah kamu dianggap sebagai pemimpin grup, atau hanya saat kalian masih menjadi trainee? / Waktu itu, aku sama sekali tidak percaya diri. Suaraku keluar dari tenggorokan, dan aku merasa tidak akan pernah bisa memimpin siapa pun.
translations.pt: Você é considerado o líder do grupo, ou apenas quando vocês eram trainees? / Naquela época, eu não tinha nenhuma confiança em mim mesmo. Eu falava pela garganta e achava que nunca conseguiria liderar ninguém.

transcript.text: And then, I asked the label to make me anything but the leader. But in the end, I was chosen as the leader.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: レオ・チャン・コー・コー・カウ・カーイ・ワー・マイ・オ・タム・タイ・ペン・リーダー・テー・スッタイ・チャン・コー・ドゥーン・レーウク・ハイ・ペン・リーダー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: And then , I asked the label to make me anything but the leader . But in the end , I was chosen as the leader .

translations.ja: それで事務所にリーダー以外なら何でもやるって頼んだんです。でも結局、僕がリーダーに選ばれました。
translations.en: And then, I asked the label to make me anything but the leader. But in the end, I was chosen as the leader.
translations.ko: 그래서 소속사에 리더만 빼고 다 시켜달라고 부탁했어요. 하지만 결국 제가 리더로 선택되었죠.
translations.zh-TW: 然後呢，我要求經紀公司讓我擔任什麼職位都行，就是別當隊長。但到頭來，我還是被選為隊長。
translations.id: Lalu, aku meminta agensi untuk menjadikan aku apa saja selain pemimpin. Tapi pada akhirnya, aku dipilih sebagai pemimpin.
translations.pt: E então, pedi à gravadora para me fazer qualquer coisa, menos o líder. Mas, no fim, fui escolhido como líder.

transcript.text: He didn't look much like a leader when he first got the role, but because of his age... / He's calling you old. / Not one bit of that was related to me.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: カオ・ドゥー・マイ・コーイ・メーノム・リーダー・トーン・ダイ・タム・ナッティー・タイ・テー・プロ・アユ・コン・カオ・カオ・カムラン・バーク・ワー・ナーイ・キャー・マイ・ミー・スアン・キアウ・コン・カブ・チャン・ルーイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: He didn 't look much like a leader when he first got the role , but because of his age ... / He 's calling you old . / Not one bit of that was related to me .

translations.ja: 最初その役割を担当した時はあまりリーダーらしく見えなかったけど、年齢のせいで…。「お前は老けてる」って言ってるんだよ。僕とは全く関係ない話だけどね。
translations.en: He didn't look much like a leader when he first got the role, but because of his age... / He's calling you old. / Not one bit of that was related to me.
translations.ko: 처음 그 역할을 맡았을 때는 리더 같아 보이지 않았지만, 나이 때문에... / 저 사람이 당신보고 늙었다네요. / 저랑은 전혀 상관없는 얘긴데요.
translations.zh-TW: 他剛接下這個角色時看起來不太像個隊長，但因為他的年紀……／他在說你老呢。／這句話跟我可是一點關係都沒有。
translations.id: Dia tidak terlihat seperti pemimpin saat pertama kali mendapatkan peran itu, tapi karena usianya... / Dia memanggilmu tua. / Tidak ada satu pun dari itu yang berhubungan denganku.
translations.pt: Ele não parecia muito com um líder quando assumiu o papel pela primeira vez, mas por causa da idade dele... / Ele está te chamando de velho. / Nem um pouco disso teve a ver comigo.

transcript.text: I didn't feel flustered at all. So, back to what you were saying. / After working for a while, it might've been something he read in a book, or maybe he talked to his dad or something, I don't know, but he changed.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: チャン・マイ・ルースック・ロンラン・ルーイ・ナ・レオ・コー・グラップ・パイ・ティー・ナーイ・プード・プラマーン・ワー・ポー・タムガーン・パイ・サック・パック・アージ・ジャ・ペン・シン・ティー・カオ・アーティ・ナイ・ナンスー・ルー・アーティ・ジャ・クイ・カブ・ポー・コン・カオ・マイ・ルー・テー・カオ・プリアン・パイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I didn 't feel flustered at all . So , back to what you were saying . / After working for a while , it might 've been something he read in a book , or maybe he talked to his dad or something , I don 't know , but he changed .

translations.ja: 全然焦らなかったよ。で、話の続きだけど。しばらく仕事をした後、本で読んだことなのか、お父さんと話したからなのか分からないけど、彼が変わったんだ。
translations.en: I didn't feel flustered at all. So, back to what you were saying. / After working for a while, it might've been something he read in a book, or maybe he talked to his dad or something, I don't know, but he changed.
translations.ko: 전혀 당황하지 않았어요. 자, 하시던 말씀으로 돌아가서요. / 한동안 활동하고 나니, 책에서 읽은 내용이었는지 아버지와 대화를 나눴는지 뭔지 모르겠지만, 그가 변했어요.
translations.zh-TW: 我一點也不慌亂。好啦，回到剛才的話題。／經過一段時間的努力後，或許是他從書裡讀到了什麼，又或許是他跟爸爸聊過之類的，我不知道，但他變了。
translations.id: Aku sama sekali tidak merasa bingung. Jadi, kembali ke apa yang kamu katakan tadi. / Setelah bekerja beberapa lama, mungkin itu sesuatu yang dia baca di buku, atau mungkin dia berbicara dengan ayahnya atau semacamnya, aku tidak tahu, tapi dia berubah.
translations.pt: Eu não fiquei nem um pouco confuso. Então, voltando ao que você estava dizendo. / Depois de trabalhar um pouco, pode ter sido algo que ele leu em um livro, ou talvez ele tenha conversado com o pai dele ou algo assim, eu não sei, mas ele mudou.

transcript.text: Everything about him changed. He became the new Jung. / What did you do? But while we're arguing, he hasn't said a word.

translations.ja: 彼に関する全てが変わった。新しいジャンになったんだ。一体何をしたの？僕たちが言い争ってる間、彼は一言も喋らないけどね。
translations.en: Everything about him changed. He became the new Jung. / What did you do? But while we're arguing, he hasn't said a word.
translations.ko: 그의 모든 것이 변했어요. 그는 새로운 정(Jung)이 되었죠. / 뭐 하신 거예요? 그런데 우리끼리 떠드느라 이 친구는 한 마디도 안 했네요.
translations.zh-TW: 他整個人都變了。他成了全新的炯。／你們在幹嘛？我們在爭論的時候，他竟然一句話也沒說。
translations.id: Segalanya tentang dirinya berubah. Dia menjadi Jung yang baru. / Apa yang kamu lakukan? Tapi saat kita sedang berdebat, dia tidak mengatakan sepatah kata pun.
translations.pt: Tudo nele mudou. Ele se tornou o novo Jung. / O que você fez? Mas enquanto estamos discutindo, ele não disse uma palavra.

transcript.text: So, P'Nay, did you have any moments when you felt you didn't belong? / It was only in the beginning, when I was put on an additional training schedule.

translations.en: So, P'Nay, did you have any moments when you felt you didn't belong? / It was only in the beginning, when I was put on an additional training schedule.
translations.ko: 자, P'네이, 소속감이 들지 않았던 순간이 있었나요? / 추가 트레이닝 스케줄에 들어갔을 때, 처음에만 그랬어요.
translations.zh-TW: 那麼，Nay 哥，你有沒有過覺得自己格格不入的時刻？／只有在剛開始被安排額外訓練課程的時候。
translations.id: Jadi, P'Nay, apakah kamu punya saat-saat di mana kamu merasa tidak cocok? / Itu hanya terjadi di awal, ketika aku dimasukkan ke dalam jadwal latihan tambahan.
translations.pt: Então, P'Nay, você teve algum momento em que sentiu que não pertencia ao grupo? / Foi apenas no começo, quando fui colocado em um cronograma de treinamento adicional.

transcript.text: What?! / I'm just teasing you! / How did you practice?

transcript.pronunciation_roman: What ?! / I 'm just teasing you ! / How did you practice ?

translations.ja: えっ何？！ / ちょっとからかっただけだよ！555 / どうやって練習したの？
translations.en: What?! / I'm just teasing you! / How did you practice?
translations.ko: 뭐라고요?! / 그냥 놀리는 거예요! / 어떻게 연습하셨는데요?
translations.zh-TW: 什麼？！／我跟你開玩笑的啦！／你是怎麼練習的？
translations.id: Apa?! / Aku hanya menggoda kalian! / Bagaimana cara kalian berlatih?
translations.pt: O quê?! / Estou só te zoando! / Como você treinava?

transcript.text: My dancing skills were weaker than the rest of the group, so the team arranged solo dance sessions for me. / He had to wear two sandbags on each arm, one kilogram each, during dance practice.
