translations.ja: 僕のダンススキルがみんなより劣っていたので、チームが僕のために個別レッスンを組んでくれたんです。 / ピネーは練習中、両腕に1キロの砂袋を2つずつ着けて踊らなきゃいけなかったんですよ。
translations.en: My dancing skills were weaker than the rest of the group, so the team arranged solo dance sessions for me. / He had to wear two sandbags on each arm, one kilogram each, during dance practice.
translations.ko: 제 춤 실력이 다른 멤버들보다 부족해서 팀에서 저를 위해 개인 댄스 세션을 마련해 주었어요. / 댄스 연습할 때 양팔에 각각 1킬로그램짜리 모래주머니 두 개를 차야 했어요.
translations.zh-TW: 我的舞蹈底子比團裡其他人弱，所以團隊為我安排了個人舞蹈課程。／他在舞蹈練習時，每隻手臂都得戴著兩個各一公斤的沙袋。
translations.id: Kemampuan menariku lebih lemah daripada anggota lainnya, jadi tim mengatur sesi latihan tari solo khusus untukku. / Dia harus mengenakan dua kantong pasir di setiap lengannya, masing-masing seberat satu kilogram, selama latihan tari.
translations.pt: Minhas habilidades de dança eram mais fraca que as do resto do grupo, então a equipe organizou sessões de dança solo para mim. / Ele tinha que usar dois sacos de areia em cada braço, de um quilo cada, durante o treino de dança.

transcript.text: Seriously? Why did you have to wear sandbags? So you would get used to the weight? / Yes, so I could feel it when dancing. When I first started dance practice, my fingers weren't locked.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: チン・ルー・タムマイ・トン・サイ・トゥン・サーイ・プア・ハイ・チン・カップ・ナム・ナック・ルー・チャイ・クラップ・プア・ハイ・ルー・スック・ウェーラー・テン・トン・ルーム・ソーム・テン・レーク・レーク・ニウ・ポム・マイ・ロック

translations.ja: 本当に？なんで砂袋を着けなきゃいけなかったの？重さに慣れるため？ / チャイ・クラップ（そうです）、踊るときに感覚をつかむためです。練習を始めた最初の頃、指先がピシッと固定されてなかったんですよ。
translations.en: Seriously? Why did you have to wear sandbags? So you would get used to the weight? / Yes, so I could feel it when dancing. When I first started dance practice, my fingers weren't locked.
translations.ko: 정말요? 왜 모래주머니를 차야 했죠? 무게에 익숙해지려고요? / 네, 춤출 때 그 무게를 느낄 수 있게요. 처음 춤 연습을 시작했을 때 손가락이 굳어 있었거든요.
translations.zh-TW: 真的假的？為什麼非得戴沙袋不可？這樣是為了習慣重量嗎？／對啊，這樣跳舞時才能感受到力量。我剛開始練舞時，手指都還不會放鬆固定。
translations.id: Serius? Kenapa kamu harus memakai kantong pasir? Supaya kamu terbiasa dengan bebannya? / Ya, supaya aku bisa merasakan bebannya saat menari. Saat pertama kali mulai latihan menari, jemariku tidak terkunci.
translations.pt: Sério? Por que você tinha que usar sacos de areia? Para você se acostumar com o peso? / Sim, para eu conseguir sentir isso ao dançar. Quando comecei a treinar dança, meus dedos não ficavam travados.

transcript.text: Dance like a ghost. It's literally Shaolin next to PERSES. The strength Shaolin has is followed by PERSES.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: テン・ムアン・ピー・マン・クー・サオ・リン・カーン・パーセス・チャット・チャット・クワーム・ケン・グレン・コーン・サオ・リン・ソン・トー・マー・ティー・パーセス

translations.en: Dance like a ghost. It's literally Shaolin next to PERSES. The strength Shaolin has is followed by PERSES.
translations.ko: 유령처럼 춤추기요. 말 그대로 PERSES에 닥친 소림사 수준이에요. 소림사가 가진 힘을 PERSES가 이어받고 있죠.
translations.zh-TW: 跳得像個鬼一樣。這簡直是 PERSES 裡的少林寺。少林寺具備的力量，PERSES 隨後就跟上了。
translations.id: Menarilah seperti hantu. Ini benar-benar Shaolin versi PERSES. Kekuatan yang dimiliki Shaolin diikuti oleh PERSES.
translations.pt: Dance como um fantasma. É literalmente Shaolin ao lado do PERSES. A força que o Shaolin tem é seguida pelo PERSES.

transcript.text: Mr. Ate-the-most-fish, what about you? Any experiences like this? Any experiences like that? If you encountered a serpent, you'd eat it. Anything that's in the water, you'd eat it all.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: クン・コン・ティー・ギン・プラー・ユッ・ティー・スット・ラ・ミー・プラソップガーン・ベーップ・ニー・マイ・ミー・プラソップガーン・ベーップ・ナン・マイ・ター・チャ・ナーク・ゴー・コン・ギン・アライ・ティー・ユー・ナイ・ナム・クー・ギン・モット
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Mr . Ate-the-most-fish , what about you ? Any experiences like this ? Any experiences like that ? If you encountered a serpent , you 'd eat it . Anything that 's in the water , you 'd eat it all .

translations.ja: 魚を一番食べた人、君はどう？こういう経験はある？あんな経験は？ナーガ（※タイの蛇神）に出会っても食べちゃうでしょ。水の中にいるものなら何でも食べ尽くしちゃうよね。
translations.en: Mr. Ate-the-most-fish, what about you? Any experiences like this? Any experiences like that? If you encountered a serpent, you'd eat it. Anything that's in the water, you'd eat it all.
translations.ko: 물고기 제일 많이 먹는 분, 당신은요? 이런 경험 있나요? 그런 경험 있어요? 뱀을 만나면 잡아먹었을 걸요. 물속에 있는 거라면 뭐든 다 먹어치우셨을걸요.
translations.zh-TW: 那位最愛吃魚的先生，你呢？有過這種經驗嗎？有過那種經驗嗎？如果你遇到海蛇，你也會把它吃掉。水裡有的東西，你全都吃光光。
translations.id: Tuan Pemakan-Ikan-Terbanyak, bagaimana denganmu? Punya pengalaman seperti ini? Pengalaman seperti itu? Jika kamu bertemu ular, kamu pasti memakannya. Apa pun yang ada di dalam air, kamu pasti memakannya semua.
translations.pt: Senhor Come-mais-peixe, e você? Alguma experiência assim? Alguma experiência parecida? Se você encontrasse uma serpente, você a comeria. Qualquer coisa que estivesse na água, você comeria tudo.

transcript.text: As I was a dancer before, I danced into the blocking and got all the moves precisely, but when you become an artist, you need to add feeling to it, which I didn't have at the time.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ドゥアイ・クワーム・ティー・ポム・クーイ・ペン・デーンサー・マー・ゴーン・ポム・ゴー・テン・ターム・ブロッキング・レーオ・ター・ペ・モット・テー・ポー・マー・ペン・シラピン・マン・トン・サイ・アーロム・カオ・パイ・ドゥアイ・スン・トン・ナン・ポム・ヤン・マイ・ミー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: As I was a dancer before , I danced into the blocking and got all the moves precisely , but when you become an artist , you need to add feeling to it , which I didn 't have at the time .

translations.ja: 僕は以前ダンサーをやっていたので、立ち位置通りに踊って振付も完璧にこなせていたんですが、アーティストになると感情を込めなきゃいけなくて、当時の僕にはそれがまだ足りなかったんです。
translations.en: As I was a dancer before, I danced into the blocking and got all the moves precisely, but when you become an artist, you need to add feeling to it, which I didn't have at the time.
translations.ko: 저는 원래 댄서여서 동선에 맞춰 춤을 추고 동작을 정확히 해냈지만, 아티스트가 되면 거기에 감정을 더해야 하는데 당시에는 그게 없었거든요.
translations.zh-TW: 因為我以前是舞者，我跳舞時會精準地走到定位，把每個動作做到位，但當你成為藝人時，你需要在舞蹈中注入情感，而我當時並沒有那種感覺。
translations.id: Karena aku dulunya seorang penari, aku menari masuk ke area blocking dan mendapatkan semua gerakan dengan presisi, tetapi ketika kamu menjadi seorang artis, kamu harus menambahkan perasaan ke dalamnya, yang saat itu belum kumiliki.
translations.pt: Como eu já era dançarino antes, eu entrava na marcação dançando e acertava todos os passos com precisão, mas quando você se torna um artista, você precisa adicionar sentimento a isso, o que eu não tinha na época.

transcript.text: I want to know, when you dance together, I think your group is really talented at doing this at the end of the show.

translations.ko: 궁금한 게 있는데요, 다 같이 춤출 때 보면 쇼가 끝날 때 이걸 정말 잘하는 것 같아요.
translations.zh-TW: 我很想知道，當你們一起跳舞時，我覺得你們團體在表演結束時，這部分的表現真的很厲害。
translations.id: Aku ingin tahu, saat kalian menari bersama, kurasa grup kalian sangat berbakat dalam melakukan hal ini di akhir pertunjukan.
translations.pt: Eu quero saber, quando vocês dançam juntos, eu acho que o grupo de vocês é muito talentoso em fazer isso no final do show.

translations.ko: 엔딩 요정. / 이게 배우는 건지 정말 알고 싶어요. 어떻게 그 과정 내내 엄청 잘생기고 멋진 모습을 유지하는 거죠? 어떻게 하는 거예요? 우리에게 보여줄 수 있나요?
translations.zh-TW: Ending Fairy（結語妖精）。／我真的很想知道這是學來的嗎？你們怎麼能一直保持超級帥氣和冷酷的樣子？你們是怎麼做到的？可以示範一下嗎？
translations.id: Ending Fairy (Peri Penutup). / Aku sangat ingin tahu apakah itu sesuatu yang kalian pelajari atau bukan. Bagaimana kalian bisa tetap terlihat sangat tampan dan keren sepanjang waktu? Bagaimana caranya? Bisakah kalian menunjukkannya kepada kami?
translations.pt: Ending Fairy. / Eu realmente quero saber se isso é algo que você aprende ou não. Como vocês continuam parecendo super bonitos e legais o tempo todo? Como vocês fazem isso? Podem nos mostrar?

translations.en: Apart from picking your nails, what did you do? / Lately, I've enjoyed rock climbing. It feels right, and I enjoy it a lot. / What kind of fun is it for people who enjoy rock climbing?
translations.ko: 손톱 뜯는 거 말고, 뭐 하셨나요? / 최근에는 암벽 등반을 즐기고 있어요. 딱 제 취향이고 정말 재밌더라고요. / 암벽 등반을 좋아하는 사람들에게는 어떤 재미가 있나요?
translations.zh-TW: 除了摳指甲，你還做了什麼？／最近我很喜歡攀岩。這感覺很對，我非常享受。／對於喜歡攀岩的人來說，樂趣在哪裡？
translations.id: Selain mencabuti kuku jarimu, apa yang kamu lakukan? / Belakangan ini, aku menikmati panjat tebing. Rasanya pas, dan aku sangat menikmatinya. / Apa serunya bagi orang yang menikmati panjat tebing?
translations.pt: Além de roer as unhas, o que você fez? / Ultimamente, tenho gostado de escalada. Parece a escolha certa e eu curto muito. / Qual é a graça para quem gosta de escalar?

transcript.text: What was that again? / What's the fun in rock climbing?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: アライ・ナ・ピーン・パー・マン・サヌック・ヤンガイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: What was that again ? / What 's the fun in rock climbing ?

translations.ja: 何て？「ボルダリングの何が楽しいの？」
translations.en: What was that again? / What's the fun in rock climbing?
translations.ko: 방금 뭐라고요? / 암벽 등반의 재미가 뭔가요?
translations.zh-TW: 剛才那是什麼？／攀岩的樂趣是什麼？
translations.id: Apa tadi? / Apa yang seru dari panjat tebing?
translations.pt: Como é que é? / Qual é a graça da escalada?

transcript.text: I think it's a sport where we get to use our brains and our thinking process, like a puzzle we need to solve, but it's a sport that requires physical strength to solve it.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ポム・キット・ワー・マン・ペン・ギーラー・ティー・ラオ・ダイ・チャイ・サモーン・チャイ・グラブアンガーン・キット・ムアン・ペン・パッスル・ティー・ラオ・トン・ゲー・テー・ペン・ギーラー・ティー・トン・チャイ・レン・ガーイ・ナイ・ガーン・ゲー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I think it 's a sport where we get to use our brains and our thinking process , like a puzzle we need to solve , but it 's a sport that requires physical strength to solve it .

translations.ja: 頭を使って考えるプロセスがあるスポーツだと思うんです。解かなきゃいけないパズルみたいで、でもそれを解くには体力も必要なスポーツなんですよね。
translations.en: I think it's a sport where we get to use our brains and our thinking process, like a puzzle we need to solve, but it's a sport that requires physical strength to solve it.
translations.ko: 머리와 사고 과정을 써야 하는 스포츠인 것 같아요. 풀어야 할 퍼즐 같지만, 그걸 해결하기 위해 신체적인 힘도 필요한 스포츠죠.
translations.zh-TW: 我覺得這是一項需要動腦筋、需要思考過程的運動，就像我們需要解開拼圖一樣，但它是一項需要體力才能解開的運動。
translations.id: Menurutku itu adalah olahraga di mana kita harus menggunakan otak dan proses berpikir kita, seperti teka-teki yang harus kita pecahkan, tetapi itu adalah olahraga yang membutuhkan kekuatan fisik untuk menyelesaikannya.
translations.pt: Eu acho que é um esporte onde usamos nosso cérebro e nosso processo de pensamento, como um quebra-cabeça que precisamos resolver, mas é um esporte que exige força física para resolvê-lo.

transcript.text: It's a sport that really requires concentration, picking which rock to grab onto and which body part to use to create friction when climbing. / Yes.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ペン・ギーラー・ティー・トン・ミー・サマーティ・マーク・ルアック・ワー・チャ・チャップ・ヒン・ゴーン・ナイ・チャイ・ラーンガーイ・スワン・ナイ・サーン・レン・シート・ターン・トーン・ピーン・チャイ・クラップ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: It 's a sport that really requires concentration , picking which rock to grab onto and which body part to use to create friction when climbing . / Yes .

translations.ja: どの岩を掴むか、登るときに体のどの部分で摩擦を作るか、本当に集中力が必要なスポーツだよね。「チャイ・クラップ（そうです）」
translations.en: It's a sport that really requires concentration, picking which rock to grab onto and which body part to use to create friction when climbing. / Yes.
translations.ko: 어떤 바위를 잡아야 할지, 클라이밍 할 때 마찰력을 만들기 위해 신체의 어느 부분을 써야 할지 고르며 집중력을 정말 많이 요구하는 스포츠예요. / 네.
translations.zh-TW: 這是一項非常需要專注力的運動，要挑選抓哪個岩塊，以及身體哪個部位來施力以產生攀爬時的摩擦力。／對。
translations.id: Ini adalah olahraga yang benar-benar membutuhkan konsentrasi, memilih batu mana yang harus dipegang dan bagian tubuh mana yang harus digunakan untuk menciptakan gesekan saat memanjat. / Ya.
translations.pt: É um esporte que realmente exige concentração, escolhendo qual pedra segurar e qual parte do corpo usar para criar atrito ao subir. / Sim.

transcript.text: Okay, moving on to the fish-eater. What have you been up to lately besides eating fish? / I'm working on a play for my thesis, and I'm the director.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: オーケー・マー・ティー・コン・ギン・プラー・カン・バーン・チュアン・ニー・ノーク・チャーク・ギン・プラー・レーオ・タム・アライ・ガムラン・タム・ラコーン・ウェーティー・ティーシット・クラップ・レーオ・ポム・ゴー・ペン・プー・カムガップ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Okay , moving on to the fish-eater . What have you been up to lately besides eating fish ? / I 'm working on a play for my thesis , and I 'm the director .

translations.ja: オッケー、次は魚を食べる人いこうか。最近魚を食べる以外には何してるの？「卒業制作（※シージス）の舞台劇をやっていて、僕が演出・監督を務めています」
translations.en: Okay, moving on to the fish-eater. What have you been up to lately besides eating fish? / I'm working on a play for my thesis, and I'm the director.
translations.ko: 좋습니다, 물고기 먹는 분으로 넘어가죠. 최근에 물고기 먹는 것 말고 또 뭘 하셨나요? / 졸업 작품 연극을 준비하고 있는데, 제가 연출을 맡았어요.
translations.zh-TW: 好，接下來輪到那位吃魚達人。除了吃魚，你最近都在忙什麼？／我正在為我的畢業製作排練一齣戲劇，我是導演。
translations.id: Baiklah, beralih ke si pemakan ikan. Apa yang kamu lakukan belakangan ini selain makan ikan? / Aku sedang mengerjakan naskah untuk tesisku, dan aku bertindak sebagai sutradaranya.
translations.pt: Ok, passando para o comedor de peixe. O que você tem feito ultimamente além de comer peixe? / Estou trabalhando em uma peça para o meu TCC e sou o diretor.

transcript.text: Really? You're still in school? / Yes. / What year are you in? / I'm in my 4th year. Where are you studying? / Srinakharinwirot University. / Really?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: チン・ルー・ヤン・リアン・ユー・ルー・クラップ・リアン・ピー・ナイ・ピー・シー・リアン・ティー・ナイ・モー・ソー・ウォー・チン・ルー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Really ? You 're still in school ? / Yes . / What year are you in ? / I 'm in my 4 th year . Where are you studying ? / Srinakharinwirot University . / Really ?

translations.ja: 本当ですか？まだ学生なんですか？／はい。／何年生？／大学4年生です。どこに通ってるの？／シーナカリンウィロート大学です。／本当に？
translations.en: Really? You're still in school? / Yes. / What year are you in? / I'm in my 4th year. Where are you studying? / Srinakharinwirot University. / Really?
translations.ko: 정말요? 아직 학교 다녀요? / 네. / 몇 학년이에요? / 4학년이에요. 어디서 공부해요? / 스리나카린위롯 대학교요. / 정말요?
translations.zh-TW: 真的嗎？你還在讀書？／對。／讀幾年級了？／我大四。你在哪裡讀書？／詩納卡寧威洛大學。／真的嗎？
translations.id: Benarkah? Kamu masih sekolah? / Ya. / Kamu tingkat berapa? / Aku tingkat 4. Di mana kamu kuliah? / Universitas Srinakharinwirot. / Benarkah?
translations.pt: Sério? Você ainda está na escola? / Sim. / Em que ano você está? / Estou no 4º ano. Onde você estuda? / Universidade Srinakharinwirot. / Sério?

transcript.text: He's a fish-eater, while he's a water-drinker. / Probably has a dry throat. / I don't understand at all.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: コン・ニー・キン・プラー・スワン・コン・ナン・キン・ナーム・コン・コー・ヘーン・マイ・カオチャイ・ルーイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: He 's a fish-eater , while he 's a water-drinker . / Probably has a dry throat . / I don 't understand at all .

translations.ja: こっちは魚を食べる人で、あっちは水を飲む人か。／喉が渇いてるんじゃない？／全然意味わかんない555
translations.en: He's a fish-eater, while he's a water-drinker. / Probably has a dry throat. / I don't understand at all.
translations.ko: 한 명은 생선을 먹고, 한 명은 물을 마시네요. / 목이 많이 건조한가 봐요. / 전혀 이해가 안 가네요.
translations.zh-TW: 他吃魚，而他喝水。／大概是喉嚨乾吧。／我完全聽不懂。
translations.id: Dia pemakan ikan, sementara yang satu itu peminum air. / Mungkin tenggorokannya kering. / Aku sama sekali tidak mengerti.
translations.pt: Ele é um comedor de peixe, enquanto o outro é um bebedor de água. / Provavelmente está com a garganta seca. / Não entendo nada.

transcript.text: What have you been up to, apart from eating ice? / If I have free time, I'll be in my room not doing much. I feel like work is tiring enough, so my days off are spent doing nothing.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: チュアン・ニー・タム・アライ・バーン・ノーク・チャーク・キン・ナムケン・ター・ワーン・ゴー・ユー・ナイ・ホーン・マイ・コイ・タム・アライ・ルー・スック・ワー・タムガーン・ヌアイ・ポー・レオ・ワン・ユット・ゴー・ユー・チューイ・チューイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: What have you been up to , apart from eating ice ? / If I have free time , I 'll be in my room not doing much . I feel like work is tiring enough , so my days off are spent doing nothing .

translations.ja: 氷を食べる以外に、最近は何をしてるの？／オフの時は、部屋で何もしないで過ごしてますね。仕事で十分疲れてる気がして、休みの日くらいはボーッとしてたくて。
translations.en: What have you been up to, apart from eating ice? / If I have free time, I'll be in my room not doing much. I feel like work is tiring enough, so my days off are spent doing nothing.
translations.ko: 얼음 먹는 것 말고 요즘 뭐 하고 지냈어요? / 시간 날 때는 방에서 별거 안 하고 지내요. 일하는 것만으로도 충분히 피곤해서 쉬는 날엔 아무것도 안 해요.
translations.zh-TW: 除了吃冰，你最近都在忙什麼？／如果我有空閒時間，我會待在房間裡什麼都不做。我覺得工作已經夠累了，所以休假日就是什麼都不做。
translations.id: Apa yang kamu lakukan akhir-akhir ini, selain makan es? / Kalau aku punya waktu luang, aku akan berada di kamarku dan tidak banyak berbuat apa-apa. Rasanya pekerjaan sudah cukup melelahkan, jadi hari liburku dihabiskan untuk tidak melakukan apa pun.
translations.pt: O que você tem feito, além de comer gelo? / Se eu tiver tempo livre, fico no meu quarto sem fazer muita coisa. Sinto que o trabalho já é cansativo o suficiente, então meus dias de folga passo sem fazer nada.

transcript.text: I don't go anywhere, I just stay in my room. Yeah. Lately, I've been focusing on getting my body back in shape. / Damn! / By going to physical therapy. / Why? / I've been having back pain lately.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: マイ・オーク・パイ・ナイ・ユー・テー・ナイ・ホーン・チャイ・チュアン・ニー・フーン・フー・ラーンカーイ・チェート・ドゥアイ・ガーン・パイ・ガーヤパープ・タムマイ・チュアン・ニー・プワット・ラン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I don 't go anywhere , I just stay in my room . Yeah . Lately , I 've been focusing on getting my body back in shape . / Damn ! / By going to physical therapy . / Why ? / I 've been having back pain lately .

translations.ja: どこにも出かけず、ずっと部屋にいますね。うん。最近は体のリカバリーに専念してて。／うわっ！／理学療法に通ってるんだ。／どうして？／最近腰（背中）が痛くて。
translations.en: I don't go anywhere, I just stay in my room. Yeah. Lately, I've been focusing on getting my body back in shape. / Damn! / By going to physical therapy. / Why? / I've been having back pain lately.
translations.ko: 어디 안 가고 그냥 방에만 있어요. 네. 요즘은 몸매를 다시 가꾸는 데 집중하고 있어요. / 대박! / 물리치료 받으면서요. / 왜요? / 요즘 허리가 아프거든요.
translations.zh-TW: 我哪裡都不去，就待在房間裡。對。最近我一直在專門調理身體。／該死！／透過物理治療。／為什麼？／我最近一直背痛。
translations.id: Aku tidak pergi ke mana-mana, hanya di kamar saja. Ya. Akhir-akhir ini, aku fokus mengembalikan bentuk tubuhku. / Sial! / Dengan pergi fisioterapi. / Kenapa? / Akhir-akhir ini punggungku sakit.
translations.pt: Eu não vou a lugar nenhum, apenas fico no meu quarto. Sim. Ultimamente, tenho me concentrado em colocar meu corpo em forma novamente. / Droga! / Indo à fisioterapia. / Por quê? / Tenho sentidores nas costas ultimamente.

transcript.text: Oh, the lyrics in your songs really hit home. How does it go? / My back hurts, and my neck and shoulders are stiff.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: オー・ヌア・プレーン・カオ・ルーイ・ロン・ヤンガイ・ナ・プワット・ラン・コ・バー・ライ・トゥエン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: Oh , the lyrics in your songs really hit home . How does it go ? / My back hurts , and my neck and shoulders are stiff .

translations.ja: うわ、曲の歌詞そのまんまだね。どんなのだっけ？／背中が痛いし、首も肩もバキバキ〜♪
translations.en: Oh, the lyrics in your songs really hit home. How does it go? / My back hurts, and my neck and shoulders are stiff.
translations.ko: 아, 노래 가사가 아주 뼈를 때리네요. 어떻게 되죠? / 허리가 아프고, 목이랑 어깨가 뻐근해요.
translations.zh-TW: 哦，你們歌裡的歌詞真的超貼切。是怎麼唱的？／我背痛，而且脖子和肩膀都很僵硬。
translations.id: Oh, lirik di lagu kalian sangat mengena. Bagaimana bunyinya? / Punggungku sakit, serta leher dan bahuku kaku.
translations.pt: Ah, a letra das suas músicas realmente toca o coração. Como é mesmo? / Minha lombar dói, e meu pescoço e ombros estão rígidos.

transcript.text: How's physical therapy? How do they treat it? Do you go see a doctor? / Yeah, because my lower back hurts now.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ガーヤパープ・ペン・ヤンガイ・バーン・タム・ヤンガイ・パイ・ハー・モー・マイ・チャイ・プロ・トーン・ニー・プワット・ラン・スワン・ラーン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: How 's physical therapy ? How do they treat it ? Do you go see a doctor ? / Yeah , because my lower back hurts now .

translations.ja: 理学療法ってどんな感じ？どんな治療するの？病院には行ってる？／はい、今は腰が痛いので。
translations.en: How's physical therapy? How do they treat it? Do you go see a doctor? / Yeah, because my lower back hurts now.
translations.ko: 물리치료는 어때요? 어떻게 치료해요? 병원 가요? / 네, 요즘 허리가 아프거든요.
translations.zh-TW: 物理治療怎麼樣？他們是怎麼治療的？你有去看醫生嗎？／對啊，因為我現在下背痛。
translations.id: Bagaimana fisioterapinya? Bagaimana mereka mengobatinya? Apakah kamu pergi ke dokter? / Ya, karena punggung bawahku sakit sekarang.
translations.pt: Como está a fisioterapia? Como eles tratam isso? Você vai ao médico? / Sim, porque minha lombar dói agora.

transcript.text: What did you do to hurt your lower back? / I just landed in a slightly wrong position. / Is lower back pain usually from walking or sleeping in the wrong position?
transcript.pronunciation_kana: パイ・タム・アライ・マー・トゥン・プワット・ラン・スワン・ラーン・ロン・ピット・ター・ニットノイ・プワット・ラン・スワン・ラーン・ポカティ・チャーク・ガーン・ドゥン・ルー・ガーン・ノーン・ピット・ター・チャイ・マイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: What did you do to hurt your lower back ? / I just landed in a slightly wrong position . / Is lower back pain usually from walking or sleeping in the wrong position ?

translations.ja: 腰を痛めるようなこと、何かしたの？／着地の姿勢をちょっと失敗しちゃって。／腰の痛みって普通、歩き方とか寝相が悪くてなるもんじゃないの？
translations.en: What did you do to hurt your lower back? / I just landed in a slightly wrong position. / Is lower back pain usually from walking or sleeping in the wrong position?
translations.ko: 허리는 왜 다쳤어요? / 그냥 착지할 때 자세가 약간 잘못됐어요. / 허리 통증은 보통 걷거나 잘 때 자세가 안 좋아서 생기는 건가요?
translations.zh-TW: 你對下背痛做了什麼？／我落地時姿勢稍微有點不對。／下背痛通常是因為走路還是睡覺姿勢不對？
translations.id: Apa yang kamu lakukan sampai punggung bawahmu sakit? / Aku baru saja mendarat dengan posisi yang sedikit salah. / Apakah nyeri punggung bawah biasanya karena berjalan atau tidur dengan posisi yang salah?
translations.pt: O que você fez para machucar a lombar? / Eu apenas pousei em uma posição ligeiramente errada. / A dor lombar geralmente é causada por caminhar ou dormir na posição errada?

transcript.text: I went cliff jumping. / Really? / I went to Türkiye, and there was a cliff where you could jump into the sea. Very Western vibe. So I jumped off.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: パイ・ドド・パー・マー・チン・ルー・パイ・トゥルキー・マー・ミー・パー・ハイ・ドド・ロン・タレー・フィーリング・ファラン・マーク・ゴー・ルーイ・ドド・ロン・パイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: I went cliff jumping . / Really ? / I went to T ürkiye, and there was a cliff where you could jump into the sea . Very Western vibe . So I jumped off .

translations.ja: 崖から飛び降りたんですよ。／マジで！？／トルコに行った時、海に飛び込めるクリフ（崖）があって。めちゃくちゃ欧米っぽい雰囲気で、それで飛び込んじゃって。
translations.en: I went cliff jumping. / Really? / I went to Türkiye, and there was a cliff where you could jump into the sea. Very Western vibe. So I jumped off.
translations.ko: 클리프 점프(다이빙)를 하러 갔어요. / 정말요? / 튀르키예에 갔는데, 바다로 뛰어내릴 수 있는 절벽이 있더라고요. 아주 서구적인 분위기였어요. 그래서 뛰어내렸죠.
translations.zh-TW: 我去懸崖跳水。／真的嗎？／我去土耳其的時候，那裡有一個可以跳進海裡的懸崖。很有西方風情。所以我跳下去了。
translations.id: Aku pergi cliff jumping (loncat tebing). / Benarkah? / Aku pergi ke Turki, dan ada tebing tempatmu bisa melompat ke laut. Nuansanya sangat kebarat-baratan. Jadi aku melompat.
translations.pt: Fui saltar de penhasco. / Sério? / Fui para a Turquia, e havia um penhasco de onde você podia pulat para o mar. Uma vibe muito ocidental. Então eu pulei.

transcript.text: You jumped off a cliff? / Yeah, and I went straight down. But when I landed, my posture was wrong, so my back arched. / Damn!
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ドド・パー・ルー・クラップ・チャイ・プン・ロン・パイ・トロン・トロン・テー・トーン・ロン・ピット・ター・ラン・ゴー・ルーイ・エーン・チェート

transcript.text: Like an arch? / Yeah, and did it hurt right away when you got out? / Like a scorpion. Pardon me? / Did you feel it once you got out of the water?

translations.en: Like an arch? / Yeah, and did it hurt right away when you got out? / Like a scorpion. Pardon me? / Did you feel it once you got out of the water?

translations.zh-TW: 像拱橋一樣？／對，你一上岸馬上就痛嗎？／像一隻蠍子。不好意思？／你一出水面就感覺到了嗎？
translations.id: Seperti melengkung? / Ya, dan apakah langsung sakit saat kamu keluar? / Seperti kalajengking. Maaf? / Apakah kamu langsung merasakannya begitu keluar dari air?

translations.en: It's so long! An 8 minute song, while Meron is 2 minutes 30 seconds. / Yeah, and it's a medley of sad songs by Potato and Bodyslam, old songs from my time. Damn, that sounds old. / Yeah, grandpa.

translations.id: Panjang banget! Lagu 8 menit, sementara Meron durasinya 2 menit 30 detik. / Ya, dan itu adalah medley lagu-lagu sedih dari Potato dan Bodyslam, lagu-lagu lama dari zamanku. Sial, kedengarannya tua banget. / Ya, kakek.
translations.pt: É muito longa! Uma música de 8 minutos, enquanto a da Meron tem 2 minutos e 30 segundos. / Sim, e é um medley de músicas tristes de Potato e Bodyslam, músicas antigas da minha época. Caramba, isso soa antigo. / Sim, vovô.

transcript.pronunciation_roman: When we first made the song , it was originally called 'Swaggy,' but considering the members ' personalities , it felt like we weren 't that cool since we 're more into cutesy stuff .

translations.ko: 처음 곡을 만들었을 때는 원래 '스웨기(Swaggy)'였는데, 멤버들 성격을 고려해보니 우리는 귀여운 걸 더 좋아해서 그렇게 멋진 콘셉트랑은 안 맞는 것 같더라고요.
translations.zh-TW: 我們剛做這首歌時，原本叫做「Swaggy」，但考慮到成員們的個性，感覺我們沒那麼酷，因為我們比較喜歡可愛風。
translations.id: Saat pertama kali membuat lagu ini, aslinya berjudul 'Swaggy,' tapi mengingat kepribadian para member, rasanya kami tidak begitu keren karena kami lebih menyukai hal-hal yang imut.
translations.pt: Quando fizemos a música pela primeira vez, o nome original era 'Swaggy', mas considerando a personalidade dos membros, parecia que não éramos tão descolados já que curtimos coisas mais fofas.

transcript.text: So that's why it became 'Kitty Swag.' / Very cute.

translations.zh-TW: 所以它才變成了「Kitty Swag」。／非常可愛。

translations.zh-TW: 期待看到你們的成功！／謝謝！／非常感謝。最重要的是，希望你們的粉絲永遠深愛著你們，並且希望你們的所有粉絲都能一直對你們溫柔以待。
translations.id: Menantikan semua kesuksesan kalian! / Terima kasih! / Terima kasih banyak. Yang terpenting, kuharap para penggemar kalian akan mencintai kalian tanpa henti, dan semoga semua penggemar kalian selalu baik kepada kalian.
translations.pt: Ansioso para ver todo o sucesso de vocês! / Obrigado! / Muito obrigado. Mais importante ainda, espero que os fãs de vocês os amem infinitamente e que todos os fãs sejam sempre gentis com vocês.

transcript.text: That's it for today, guys! We really gave it our all for this episode. We had so many laughs, and we hope you enjoyed it.

translations.pt: É isso por hoje, pessoal! Nós realmente demos o nosso melhor neste episódio. Rimos muito e esperamos que vocês tenham gostado.

translations.en: Don't forget to like and share, but most importantly, don't forget to subscribe. You don't even need to ring the notification bell, just hitting subscribe would be wonderful.

translations.id: Jangan lupa untuk menyukai dan membagikan, tapi yang terpenting, jangan lupa untuk berlangganan. Kalian bahkan tidak perlu menekan lonceng notifikasi, cukup dengan menekan tombol berlangganan saja sudah luar biasa.
translations.pt: Não se esqueçam de curtir e compartilhar, mas o mais importante, não se esqueçam de se inscrever. Vocês nem precisam tocar no sininho de notificações, apenas clicar em inscrever-se já seria maravilhoso.

translations.zh-TW: 我懂，有些人覺得很煩人。所以就讓訂閱數的增加作為對我們的一點鼓勵吧。如果你們看得很開心，可以分享出去。
translations.id: Aku mengerti, beberapa orang merasa itu mengganggu. Jadi biarkan peningkatan jumlah pelanggan menjadi sedikit dorongan bagi kami. Kalian bisa membagikannya jika kalian senang menonton ini.
translations.pt: Eu entendo, algumas pessoas acham chato. Então, que o aumento de inscritos seja um pequeno incentivo para nós. Vocês podem compartilhar se se divertiram assistindo a isso.
